42_19_25: (But they said to him, 'Master, he has ten minas.')
42_19_26: 'For I say to you, that to everyone who has will be given; and from him who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
42_19_27: But bring here those enemies of mine, who did not want me to reign over them, and slay them before me.' "
42_19_28: When He had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
42_19_29: And it came to pass, when He drew near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mountain called Olivet, that He sent two of His disciples,
42_19_30: saying, "Go into the village opposite you, where as you enter you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Loose it and bring it here.
42_19_31: And if anyone asks you, 'Why are you loosing it?' thus you shall say to him, 'Because the Lord has need of it.' "
42_19_32: So those who were sent went their way and found it just as He had said to them.
42_19_33: But as they were loosing the colt, the owners of it said to them, "Why are you loosing the colt?"
42_19_34: And they said, "The Lord has need of it."
42_19_35: Then they brought him to Jesus. And they threw their own clothes on the colt, and they set Jesus on him.
42_19_36: And as He went, many spread their clothes on the road.
42_19_37: Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen,
42_19_38: saying: "'Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the LORD!' Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
42_19_39: And some of the Pharisees called to Him from the crowd, "Teacher, rebuke Your disciples."
42_19_40: But He answered and said to them, "I tell you that if these should keep silent, the stones would immediately cry out."
42_19_41: Now as He drew near, He saw the city and wept over it,
42_19_42: saying, "If you had known, even you, especially in this your day, the things that make for your peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
42_19_43: For days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment around you, surround you and hem you in on every side,
42_19_44: and level you, and your children within you, to the ground; and they will not leave in you one stone upon another, because you did not know the time of your visitation.
42_19_45: Then He went into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
42_19_46: saying to them, "It is written, 'My house is a house of prayer,' but you have made it a 'den of thieves.'"
42_19_47: And He was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests, the scribes, and the leaders of the people sought to destroy Him,
42_19_48: and were unable to do anything; for all the people were hanging on to every word He said.
42_20_1: Now it happened on one of those days, as He taught the people in the temple and preached the gospel, that the chief priests and the scribes, together with the elders, confronted Him
42_20_2: and spoke to Him, saying, "Tell us, by what authority are You doing these things? Or who is he who gave You this authority?"
42_20_3: But He answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, and answer Me:"
42_20_4: The baptism of John—was it from heaven or from men?"
42_20_5: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'"
42_20_6: But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet."
42_20_7: So they answered that they did not know where it was from.
42_20_8: And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
42_20_9: Then He began to tell the people this parable: "A certain man planted a vineyard, leased it to vinedressers, and went into a far country for a long time.
42_20_10: Now at vintage-time he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that they might give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the vinedressers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
42_20_11: Again he sent another servant; and they beat him also, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
42_20_12: And again he sent a third; and they wounded him also and cast him out.
42_20_13: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. Probably they will respect him when they see him.'"
42_20_14: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, 'This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.'"
42_20_15: So they cast him out of the vineyard and killed him. Therefore what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?"
42_20_16: He will come and destroy those vinedressers and give the vineyard to others." And when they heard it they said, "Certainly not!"
42_20_17: Then He looked at them and said, "What then is this that is written: 'The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone'?"
42_20_18: Whoever falls on that stone will be broken; but on whomever it falls, it will crush him."
42_20_19: And the chief priests and the scribes that very hour sought to lay hands on Him, but they feared the people—for they knew He had spoken this parable against them.
42_20_20: So they watched Him, and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, that they might seize on His words, in order to deliver Him to the power and the authority of the governor.
42_20_21: Then they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, we know that You speak and teach rightly, and You do not show personal favoritism, but teach the way of God in truth:"
42_20_22: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
42_20_23: But He perceived their craftiness, and said to them, "Why do you test Me?"
42_20_24: Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?" They answered and said, "Caesar's."
42_20_25: And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."
42_20_26: But they could not catch Him in His words in the presence of the people. And they marveled at His answer and kept silent.
42_20_27: Then some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came to Him and asked Him,
42_20_28: saying: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man's brother dies, having a wife, and he dies without children, his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother."
42_20_29: Now there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife, and died without children.
42_20_30: And the second took her as wife, and he died childless.
42_20_31: Then the third took her, and in like manner the seven also; and they left no children, and died.
42_20_32: Last of all the woman died also.
42_20_33: Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife does she become? For all seven had her as wife."
42_20_34: Jesus answered and said to them, "The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage."
42_20_35: But those who are counted worthy to attain that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage;
42_20_36: nor can they die anymore, for they are equal to the angels and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
42_20_37: But even Moses showed in the burning bush passage that the dead are raised, when he called the Lord 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'
42_20_38: For He is not the God of the dead but of the living, for all live to Him."
42_20_39: Then some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, You have spoken well."
42_20_40: But after that they dared not question Him anymore.
42_20_41: And He said to them, "How can they say that the Christ is the Son of David?
42_20_42: Now David himself said in the Book of Psalms: 'The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand,
42_20_43: Till I make Your enemies Your footstool.'"
42_20_44: Therefore David calls Him 'Lord'; how is He then his Son?"
42_20_45: Then, in the hearing of all the people, He said to His disciples,
42_20_46: "Beware of the scribes, who desire to go around in long robes, love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts,
42_20_47: who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation."
42_21_1: And He looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,
42_21_2: and He saw also a certain poor widow putting in two small copper coins.
42_21_3: So He said, "Truly I say to you that this poor widow has put in more than all;
42_21_4: for all these out of their abundance have put in offerings for God, but she out of her poverty put in all the livelihood that she had."
42_21_5: Then, as some spoke of the temple, how it was adorned with beautiful stones and donations, He said,
42_21_6: "These things which you see—the days will come in which not one stone shall be left upon another that shall not be thrown down."
42_21_7: So they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, but when will these things be? And what sign will there be when these things are about to take place?"
42_21_8: And He said: "Take heed that you not be deceived. For many will come in My name, saying, 'I am He,' and, 'The time has drawn near.' Therefore do not go after them.
42_21_9: But when you hear of wars and commotions, do not be terrified; for these things must come to pass first, but the end will not come immediately."
42_21_10: Then He said to them, "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
42_21_11: And there will be great earthquakes in various places, and famines and pestilences; and there will be fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
42_21_12: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and prisons. You will be brought before kings and rulers for My name's sake.
42_21_13: But it will turn out for you as an occasion for testimony.
42_21_14: Therefore settle it in your hearts not to meditate beforehand on what you will answer;
42_21_15: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to contradict or resist.
42_21_16: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers, relatives and friends; and they will put some of you to death.
42_21_17: And you will be hated by all for My name's sake.
42_21_18: But not a hair of your head shall be lost.
42_21_19: By your endurance possess your souls.
42_21_20: "But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is near.
42_21_21: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those who are in the midst of her depart, and let not those who are in the country enter her.
42_21_22: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
42_21_23: But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing babies in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath upon this people.
42_21_24: And they will fall by the edge of the sword, and be led away captive into all nations. And Jerusalem will be trampled by Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
42_21_25: "And there will be signs in the sun, in the moon, and in the stars; and on the earth distress of nations, with perplexity, the sea and the waves roaring;
42_21_26: men's hearts failing them from fear and the expectation of those things which are coming on the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
42_21_27: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
42_21_28: Now when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption draws near.
42_21_29: Then He spoke to them a parable: "Look at the fig tree, and all the trees."
42_21_30: When they are already budding, you see and know for yourselves that summer is now near.
42_21_31: So you also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
42_21_32: Assuredly, I say to you, this generation will by no means pass away till all things take place.
42_21_33: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.
42_21_34: But take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that Day come on you unexpectedly.
42_21_35: For it will come as a snare on all those who dwell on the face of the whole earth.
42_21_36: Watch therefore, and pray always that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Man.
42_21_37: And in the daytime He was teaching in the temple, but at night He went out and stayed on the mountain called Olivet.
42_21_38: Then early in the morning all the people came to Him in the temple to hear Him.
42_22_1: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread drew near, which is called Passover.
42_22_2: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might kill Him, for they feared the people.
42_22_3: Then Satan entered Judas, surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered among the twelve.
42_22_4: So he went his way and conferred with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray Him to them.
42_22_5: And they were glad, and agreed to give him money.
42_22_6: So he promised and sought opportunity to betray Him to them in the absence of the multitude.
42_22_7: Then came the Day of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb must be sacrificed.
42_22_8: And He sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat it."
42_22_9: So they said to Him, "Where do You want us to prepare it?"
42_22_10: And He said to them, "Behold, when you have entered the city, a man will meet you carrying a pitcher of water; follow him into the house which he enters."
42_22_11: Then you shall say to the master of the house, 'The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?"'
42_22_12: Then he will show you a large, furnished upper room; there make ready."
42_22_13: So they went and found it just as He had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
42_22_14: When the hour had come, He sat down, and the twelve apostles with Him.
42_22_15: Then He said to them, "With fervent desire I have desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer;"
42_22_16: for I say to you, I will no longer eat of it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
42_22_17: Then He took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, "Take this and divide it among yourselves;"
42_22_18: for I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
42_22_19: And He took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is My body which is given for you; do this in remembrance of Me."
42_22_20: Likewise He also took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you."
42_22_21: But behold, the hand of My betrayer is with Me on the table.
42_22_22: And truly the Son of Man goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!"
42_22_23: Then they began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
42_22_24: Now there was also a dispute among them, as to which of them should be considered the greatest.
42_22_25: And He said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them, and those who exercise authority over them are called 'benefactors.'"
42_22_26: But not so among you; on the contrary, he who is greatest among you, let him be as the younger, and he who governs as he who serves.
42_22_27: For who is greater, he who sits at the table, or he who serves? Is it not he who sits at the table? Yet I am among you as the One who serves.
42_22_28: But you are those who have continued with Me in My trials.
42_22_29: And I bestow upon you a kingdom, just as My Father bestowed one upon Me,
42_22_30: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
42_22_31: And the Lord said, "Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you like wheat.
42_22_32: But I have prayed for you, that your faith may not fail; and when you have turned again, strengthen your brethren.
42_22_33: But he said to Him, "Lord, I am ready to go with You, both to prison and to death."
42_22_34: Then He said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster shall not crow this day before you will deny three times that you know Me."
42_22_35: And He said to them, "When I sent you without money bag, knapsack, and sandals, did you lack anything?" So they said, "Nothing."
42_22_36: Then He said to them, "But now, he who has a money bag, let him take it, and likewise a knapsack; and he who has no sword, let him sell his garment and buy one."
42_22_37: For I say to you that this which is written must still be accomplished in Me: 'And He was numbered with the transgressors.' For the things concerning Me have their fulfillment."
42_22_38: So they said, "Lord, look, here are two swords." And He said to them, "It is enough."
42_22_39: Coming out, He went to the Mount of Olives, as He was accustomed, and His disciples also followed Him.
42_22_40: When He came to the place, He said to them, "Pray that you may not enter into temptation."
42_22_41: And He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and He knelt down and prayed,
42_22_42: saying, "Father, if it is Your will, take this cup away from Me; nevertheless not My will, but Yours, be done."
42_22_43: Then an angel appeared to Him from heaven, strengthening Him.
42_22_44: And being in agony, He prayed more earnestly. Then His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
42_22_45: When He rose up from prayer, and had come to His disciples, He found them sleeping from sorrow.
42_22_46: Then He said to them, "Why do you sleep? Rise and pray, lest you enter into temptation."
42_22_47: And while He was still speaking, behold, a multitude; and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them and drew near to Jesus to kiss Him.
42_22_48: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
42_22_49: When those around Him saw what was going to happen, they said to Him, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"
42_22_50: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
42_22_51: But Jesus answered and said, "No more of this." And He touched his ear and healed him.
42_22_52: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and the elders who had come to Him, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs?"
42_22_53: When I was with you daily in the temple, you did not try to seize Me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness."
42_22_54: Having arrested Him, they led Him and brought Him into the high priest's house. But Peter followed at a distance.
42_22_55: Now when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.
42_22_56: And a certain servant girl, seeing him as he sat by the fire, looked intently at him and said, "This man was also with Him."
42_22_57: But he denied Him, saying, "Woman, I do not know Him."
42_22_58: And after a little while another saw him and said, "You also are of them." But Peter said, "Man, I am not!"
42_22_59: Then after about an hour had passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, "Surely this fellow also was with Him, for he is a Galilean."
42_22_60: But Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are saying!" Immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
42_22_61: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, "Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times."
42_22_62: So Peter went out and wept bitterly.
42_22_63: Now the men who held Jesus mocked Him and beat Him.
42_22_64: And having blindfolded Him, they struck Him on the face and asked Him, saying, "Prophesy! Who is the one who struck You?"
42_22_65: And many other things they blasphemously spoke against Him.
42_22_66: As soon as it was day, the elders of the people, both chief priests and scribes, came together and led Him into their council, saying,
42_22_67: "If You are the Christ, tell us." But He said to them, "If I tell you, you will by no means believe."
42_22_68: And if I also ask you, you will by no means answer Me or let Me go."
42_22_69: Hereafter the Son of Man will sit on the right hand of the power of God."
42_22_70: Then they all said, "Are You then the Son of God?" So He said to them, "You rightly say that I am."
42_22_71: And they said, "What further testimony do we need? For we have heard it ourselves from His own mouth."
42_23_1: Then the whole multitude of them arose and led Him to Pilate.
42_23_2: And they began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to pay taxes to Caesar, saying that He Himself is Christ, a King."
42_23_3: Then Pilate asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him and said, "It is as you say."
42_23_4: So Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no fault in this Man."
42_23_5: But they were the more fierce, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place."
42_23_6: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked if the Man were a Galilean.
42_23_7: And as soon as he knew that He belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
42_23_8: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad; for he had desired for a long time to see Him, because he had heard many things about Him, and he was hoping to see some miracle done by Him.
42_23_9: Then he questioned Him with many words, but He answered him nothing.
42_23_10: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.
42_23_11: Then Herod, with his men of war, treated Him with contempt and mocked Him, arrayed Him in a gorgeous robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.
42_23_12: That very day Pilate and Herod became friends with each other, for previously they had been at enmity with each other.
42_23_13: Then Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
42_23_14: said to them, "You have brought this Man to me, as one who misleads the people. And indeed, having examined Him in your presence, I have found no fault in this Man concerning those things of which you accuse Him;"
42_23_15: no, neither did Herod, for I sent you back to him; and indeed nothing deserving of death has been done by Him."
42_23_16: I will therefore chastise Him and release Him."
42_23_17: (for it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast).
42_23_18: And they all cried out at once, saying, "Away with this Man, and release to us Barabbas"—
42_23_19: who had been thrown into prison for a certain rebellion made in the city, and for murder.
42_23_20: Pilate, therefore, wishing to release Jesus, again called out to them.
42_23_21: But they shouted, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!"
42_23_22: Then he said to them the third time, "Why, what evil has He done? I have found no reason for death in Him. I will therefore chastise Him and let Him go."
42_23_23: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. And the voices of these men and of the chief priests prevailed.
42_23_24: So Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they requested.
42_23_25: And he released to them the one they requested, who for rebellion and murder had been thrown into prison; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
42_23_26: Now as they led Him away, they laid hold of a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, who was coming from the country, and on him they laid the cross that he might bear it after Jesus.
42_23_27: And a great multitude of the people followed Him, and women who also mourned and lamented Him.
42_23_28: But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children."
42_23_29: For indeed the days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, wombs that never bore, and breasts which never nursed!'"
42_23_30: Then they will begin to say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!"
42_23_31: For if they do these things in the green wood, what will be done in the dry?"
42_23_32: There were also two others, criminals, led with Him to be put to death.
42_23_33: And when they had come to the place called Calvary, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
42_23_34: Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do." And they divided His garments and cast lots.
42_23_35: And the people stood looking on. But even the rulers with them sneered, saying, "He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ, the chosen of God."
42_23_36: The soldiers also mocked Him, coming and offering Him sour wine,
42_23_37: and saying, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself."
42_23_38: And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
42_23_39: Then one of the criminals who were hanged blasphemed Him, saying, "If You are the Christ, save Yourself and us."
42_23_40: But the other, answering, rebuked him, saying, "Do you not even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?"
42_23_41: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward of our deeds; but this Man has done nothing wrong."
42_23_42: Then he said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom."
42_23_43: And Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise."
42_23_44: Now it was about the sixth hour, and darkness fell over all the earth until the ninth hour.
42_23_45: Then the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
42_23_46: And when Jesus had cried out with a loud voice, He said, "Father, 'into Your hands I commit My spirit.'" Having said this, He breathed His last.
42_23_47: So when the centurion saw what had happened, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous Man!"
42_23_48: And the whole crowd who came together to that sight, seeing what had been done, beat their breasts and returned.
42_23_49: But all His acquaintances, and the women who followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
42_23_50: Now behold, there was a man named Joseph, a council member, a good and righteous man.
42_23_51: He had not consented to their decision and deed. He was from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who himself was also waiting for the kingdom of God.
42_23_52: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
42_23_53: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a tomb that was hewn out of the rock, where no one had ever lain before.
42_23_54: That day was the Preparation, and the Sabbath drew near.
42_23_55: And the women who had come with Him from Galilee followed after, and they observed the tomb and how His body was laid.
42_23_56: Then they returned and prepared spices and fragrant oils. And they rested on the Sabbath according to the commandment.
42_24_1: Now on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they, and certain other women with them, came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared.
42_24_2: But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
42_24_3: Then they went in and did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
42_24_4: And it happened, as they were greatly perplexed about this, that behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.
42_24_5: Then, as they were afraid and bowed their faces to the earth, they said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?"
42_24_6: He is not here, but is risen! Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,
42_24_7: saying, 'The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.'"
42_24_9: Then they returned from the tomb and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
42_24_10: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them, who told these things to the apostles.
42_24_11: And their words seemed to them like idle tales, and they did not believe them.
42_24_12: But Peter arose and ran to the tomb; and stooping down, he saw the linen cloths lying by themselves; and he departed, marveling to himself at what had happened.
42_24_13: Now behold, two of them were traveling that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was seven miles from Jerusalem.
42_24_14: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
42_24_15: So it was, while they conversed and reasoned, that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.
42_24_16: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.
42_24_17: And He said to them, "What kind of conversation is this that you have with one another as you walk and are sad?"
42_24_18: Then the one whose name was Cleopas answered and said to Him, "Are You the only stranger in Jerusalem, and have You not known the things which happened there in these days?"
42_24_19: And He said to them, "What things?" So they said to Him, "The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a Prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,"
42_24_20: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to be condemned to death, and crucified Him.
42_24_21: But we were hoping that it was He who was going to redeem Israel. Indeed, besides all this, today is the third day since these things happened.
42_24_22: Yes, and certain women of our company, who arrived at the tomb early, astonished us.
42_24_23: When they did not find His body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who said He was alive.
42_24_24: And certain of those who were with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said; but Him they did not see.
42_24_25: Then He said to them, 'O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!'
42_24_26: Ought not the Christ to have suffered these things and to enter into His glory?
42_24_27: And beginning at Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.
42_24_28: Then they drew near to the village where they were going, and He acted as if He were going farther.
42_24_29: But they urged Him, saying, 'Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent.' And He went in to stay with them.
42_24_30: Now it came to pass, as He sat at the table with them, that He took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.
42_24_31: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Him; and He vanished from their sight.
42_24_32: And they said to one another, 'Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us on the road, and while He opened the Scriptures to us?'
42_24_33: So they rose up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and those who were with them gathered together,
42_24_34: saying, 'The Lord has risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!'
42_24_35: And they told what had happened on the road, and how He was known to them in the breaking of bread.
42_24_36: Now as they said these things, Jesus Himself stood in the midst of them, and said to them, 'Peace to you.'
42_24_37: But they were startled and terrified, and supposed they had seen a spirit.
42_24_38: And He said to them, 'Why are you troubled? And why do doubts arise in your hearts?'
42_24_39: Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Touch Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have.'
42_24_40: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.
42_24_41: But while they still did not believe for joy, and marveled, He said to them, 'Have you any food here?'
42_24_42: So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish and some honeycomb.
42_24_43: And He took it and ate in their presence.
42_24_44: Then He said to them, 'These are the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms concerning Me.'
42_24_45: And He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
42_24_46: Then He said to them, 'Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,'
42_24_47: and that repentance and remission of sins should be proclaimed in His name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
42_24_48: And you are witnesses of these things.
42_24_49: Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but stay in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.'
42_24_50: And He led them out as far as Bethany, and lifting up His hands He blessed them.
42_24_51: Now it came to pass, while He blessed them, that He was parted from them and was carried up into heaven.
42_24_52: And they worshiped Him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
42_24_53: and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God.
42_10_11: 'Even the dust of your city which clings to our feet we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.'
42_10_12: But I say to you that it will be more tolerable in that Day for Sodom than for that city.
42_10_13: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
42_10_14: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
42_10_15: And you, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
42_10_16: He who hears you hears Me, he who rejects you rejects Me, and he who rejects Me rejects Him who sent Me.
42_10_17: Then the seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name."
42_10_18: And He said to them, "I saw Satan fall from heaven like lightning."
42_10_19: Behold, I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing at all shall hurt you.
42_10_20: Nevertheless do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rather rejoice because your names are written in heaven.
42_10_21: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and revealed them to babes. Yes, Father, for so it pleased You to do it this way."
42_10_22: All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and anyone to whom the Son wills to reveal Him.
42_10_23: Then turning to His disciples He said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see the things you see;"
42_10_24: for I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen it, and to hear what you hear, and have not heard it.
42_10_25: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested Him, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
42_10_26: He said to him, "What is written in the law? How do you read it?"
42_10_27: So he answered and said, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself."
42_10_28: And He said to him, "You have answered correctly; do this and you will live."
42_10_29: But he, wanting to justify himself, said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
42_10_30: Then Jesus answered and said: "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among robbers, who stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead."
42_10_31: Now by chance a certain priest came down that road, and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
42_10_32: Likewise a Levite, when he arrived at the place and saw him, came and passed by on the other side.
42_10_33: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was. And when he saw him, he had compassion.
42_10_34: So he went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine; and he set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
42_10_35: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper, and said to him, 'Take care of him; and whatever more you spend, when I come again, I will repay you.'
42_10_36: So which of these three do you think proved to be a neighbor to him who fell among the thieves?
42_10_37: And he said, "The one who showed mercy toward him." Then Jesus said to him, "Go and do likewise."
42_10_38: Now as they went on their way, He entered a certain village; and a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
42_10_39: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet and listened to His word.
42_10_40: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came to Him and said, "Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Therefore tell her to help me."
42_10_41: And Jesus answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are worried and troubled about many things."
42_10_42: But one thing is necessary, and Mary has chosen that good part, which will not be taken away from her.
42_11_1: Now it came to pass, as Jesus was praying in a certain place, when He finished, that one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples."
42_11_2: So He said to them, "When you pray, say: Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven."
42_11_3: Give us each day our daily bread.
42_11_4: And forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
42_11_5: And He said to them, "Which of you shall have a friend and go to him at midnight and say to him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves;
42_11_6: for a friend of mine has come to me on his journey, and I have nothing to set before him';
42_11_7: and he will answer from within and say, 'Do not bother me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give to you'?
42_11_8: I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his shameless persistence he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
43_1_1: In the beginning, the Word already was — face-to-face with God, and Himself God.
43_1_2: He was there, in the beginning, with God.
43_1_3: Through Him everything came to be. Without Him, not one thing that exists came into being.
43_1_4: In Him was life, and that life was the light of every person.
43_1_5: The light keeps shining into the darkness, and the darkness has never overcome it — nor understood it.
43_1_6: A man came, sent from God. His name was John.
43_1_7: He came as a witness — to testify about the Light, so that through him, everyone might come to believe.
43_1_8: He himself was not the Light; he was sent to bear witness to the Light.
43_1_9: The true Light — the Light that gives light to every person — was now coming into the world.
43_1_10: He was in the world, and the world came into being through Him, yet the world did not recognize Him.
43_1_11: He came to what was His own, and His own people did not receive Him.
43_1_12: But to all who received Him — all who believed on His name — He gave the right to become children of God,
43_1_13: born not from bloodlines, nor from human desire, nor from a husband's will, but born of God Himself.
43_1_14: And the Word became flesh. He pitched His tent among us, and we saw His glory with our own eyes — the glory of the Father's one-and-only Son, full of grace and full of truth.
43_1_15: John testified about Him and called out: "This is the One I was speaking of when I said, 'The One coming after me has outranked me, because He existed before me.'"
43_1_16: From His fullness we have all received — one grace piled on another, grace in exchange for grace.
43_1_17: The law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
43_1_18: No one has ever seen God. The one-and-only Son, Himself God, who rests at the Father's side — He is the One who has made Him known.
43_1_19: This is the testimony of John, when the Jewish leaders sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"
43_1_20: He confessed it openly; he did not deny, but confessed: "I am not the Christ."
43_1_21: So they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."
43_1_22: Then they said, "Who are you — so we can give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"
43_1_23: He said, "I am the voice of one calling out in the wilderness: 'Make the way of the Lord straight,' just as the prophet Isaiah said."
43_1_24: Now those who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
43_1_25: They pressed him: "Why then are you baptizing — if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
43_1_26: John answered them, "I baptize with water. But standing among you is One you do not know —
43_1_27: the One coming after me, whose sandal-strap I am not worthy to untie."
43_1_28: These things happened in Bethany, across the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
43_1_29: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look! — the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
43_1_30: This is the One I was speaking of when I said, 'A man is coming after me who has outranked me, because He existed before me.'
43_1_31: I myself did not know who He was — but the reason I came baptizing with water was so that He might be revealed to Israel."
43_1_32: Then John testified: "I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and He remained on Him.
43_1_33: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water said to me, 'The One on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain — He is the One who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.'
43_1_34: And I have seen it. I testify: this is the Son of God."
43_1_35: The next day, John was standing there again with two of his disciples,
43_1_36: and as he watched Jesus walking by, he said, "Look — the Lamb of God!"
43_1_37: The two disciples heard him say it and followed Jesus.
43_1_38: Jesus turned and saw them following, and asked them, "What are you looking for?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which translates 'Teacher'), "where are You staying?"
43_1_39: He told them, "Come, and you will see." So they came and saw where He was staying, and they stayed with Him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
43_1_40: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who had heard John and followed Jesus.
43_1_41: He first found his own brother Simon and told him, "We have found the Messiah" (which translates 'the Christ').
43_1_42: He brought him to Jesus. Looking at him, Jesus said, "You are Simon, son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which translates 'Peter').
43_1_43: The next day, Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and told him, "Follow Me."
43_1_44: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the town of Andrew and Peter.
43_1_45: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law — and the Prophets, too — Jesus of Nazareth, son of Joseph."
43_1_46: Nathanael said to him, "From Nazareth? Can anything good come out of there?" Philip said, "Come and see."
43_1_47: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him and said about him, "Look — a true Israelite, a man in whom there is no deceit!"
43_1_48: Nathanael said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered, "Before Philip called you, when you were still under the fig tree, I saw you."
43_1_49: Nathanael answered, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"
43_1_50: Jesus answered him, "You believe because I said I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these."
43_1_51: And He said to him, "Truly, truly, I tell you — you will all see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."
43_2_1: On the third day, there was a wedding at Cana in Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.
43_2_2: Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
43_2_3: When the wine ran out, the mother of Jesus said to Him, "They have no wine."
43_2_4: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why does that involve Me? My hour has not yet come."
43_2_5: His mother told the servants, "Whatever He tells you to do, do it."
43_2_6: Now six stone water jars were standing there, used for the Jewish purification rites, each holding twenty or thirty gallons.
43_2_7: Jesus told the servants, "Fill the jars with water." And they filled them to the brim.
43_2_8: Then He said, "Now draw some out and take it to the head steward." So they took it.
43_2_9: When the head steward tasted the water — now become wine — and he did not know where it came from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew, he called the bridegroom
43_2_10: and said to him, "Everyone serves the good wine first, and then, after the guests have had plenty to drink, the lesser wine. But you have saved the best wine until now!"
43_2_11: This — the first of His signs — Jesus performed in Cana of Galilee. He revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
43_2_12: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother, His brothers, and His disciples — and they stayed there a few days.
43_2_13: The Passover of the Jews was near, so Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
43_2_14: In the temple He found those selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and the money-changers sitting at their tables.
43_2_15: So He made a whip out of cords and drove them all out of the temple — the sheep and the oxen too. He scattered the coins of the money-changers and overturned their tables.
43_2_16: To those selling doves He said, "Get these things out of here! Do not turn My Father's house into a marketplace!"
43_2_17: His disciples remembered that it is written: "Zeal for Your house will consume Me."
43_2_18: The Jewish leaders responded, "What sign can You show us to prove You have the authority to do this?"
43_2_19: Jesus answered them, "Tear down this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
43_2_20: The Jewish leaders said, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and You will raise it up in three days?"
43_2_21: But He was speaking about the temple of His body.
43_2_22: So when He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word that Jesus had spoken.
43_2_23: While He was in Jerusalem during the Passover feast, many believed in His name when they saw the signs He was doing.
43_2_24: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, because He knew them all,
43_2_25: and because He did not need anyone to testify about what was in a person — He Himself knew what was in every person.
43_3_1: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
43_3_2: This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know You are a teacher who has come from God — for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him."
43_3_3: Jesus answered him, "Truly, truly, I tell you — unless a person is born from above, he cannot see the kingdom of God."
43_3_4: Nicodemus said to Him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter his mother's womb a second time and be born?"
43_3_5: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I tell you — unless a person is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
43_3_6: What is born of the flesh is flesh; what is born of the Spirit is spirit.
43_3_7: Do not be amazed that I said to you, 'You must be born from above.'
43_3_8: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit."
43_3_9: Nicodemus answered, "How can these things be?"
43_3_10: Jesus answered, "You are the teacher of Israel, and you do not know these things?
43_3_11: Truly, truly, I tell you — We speak of what We know and bear witness to what We have seen, and yet you do not receive Our testimony.
43_3_12: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
43_3_13: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven — the Son of Man.
43_3_14: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
43_3_15: so that whoever believes in Him may have eternal life."
43_3_16: For God so loved the world that He gave His one-and-only Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not perish but have eternal life.
43_3_17: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but so that the world might be saved through Him.
43_3_18: The one who believes in Him is not condemned; but the one who does not believe stands already condemned, because he has not believed in the name of the one-and-only Son of God.
43_3_19: And this is the verdict: the Light has come into the world, but people loved the darkness rather than the Light — because their deeds were evil.
43_3_20: Everyone who practices evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light, so that his deeds may not be exposed.
43_3_21: But the one who does what is true comes into the Light, so that his deeds may be clearly seen — that they have been carried out in God.
43_3_22: After these things, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, and He stayed there with them and was baptizing.
43_3_23: John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water there, and people were coming and being baptized —
43_3_24: for John had not yet been thrown into prison.
43_3_25: A dispute arose between some of John's disciples and a Jew over ritual purification.
43_3_26: They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, the One who was with you on the other side of the Jordan — the One you testified about — look, He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him!"
43_3_27: John answered, "A person can receive nothing unless it has been given to him from heaven.
43_3_28: You yourselves are my witnesses that I said, 'I am not the Christ — I have been sent ahead of Him.'
43_3_29: The one who has the bride is the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom, who stands by and listens to him, rejoices with great joy at the bridegroom's voice. So this joy of mine is now made full.
43_3_30: He must increase; I must decrease."
43_3_31: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
43_3_32: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, and yet no one receives His testimony.
43_3_33: Whoever has received His testimony has set his seal to this: that God is true.
43_3_34: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God — for God gives the Spirit without measure.
43_3_35: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into His hand.
43_3_36: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life, but the one who refuses to believe the Son will not see life — for the wrath of God remains on him.
43_4_1: Now the Lord became aware that the Pharisees had heard He was making and baptizing more disciples than John —
43_4_2: though Jesus Himself was not baptizing; His disciples were —
43_4_3: so He left Judea and went back into Galilee.
43_4_4: And He had to pass through Samaria.
43_4_5: So He came to a Samaritan town called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
43_4_6: Jacob's well was there. Jesus, worn out from the journey, sat down just as He was, beside the well. It was about the sixth hour.
43_4_7: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give Me a drink" —
43_4_8: for His disciples had gone off into the town to buy food.
43_4_9: So the Samaritan woman said to Him, "How is it that You, a Jew, are asking me for a drink — a Samaritan woman?" (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
43_4_10: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to you, 'Give Me a drink,' you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water."
43_4_11: "Sir," she said to Him, "You have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. Where then would You get this living water?
43_4_12: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself — along with his sons and his livestock?"
43_4_13: Jesus answered her, "Everyone who drinks of this water will be thirsty again.
43_4_14: But whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again — ever. The water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life."
43_4_15: The woman said to Him, "Sir, give me this water, so I will not be thirsty — and so I will not have to keep coming here to draw."
43_4_16: He told her, "Go, call your husband, and come back here."
43_4_17: The woman answered, "I do not have a husband." Jesus said to her, "You are right in saying, 'I do not have a husband' —
43_4_18: for you have had five husbands, and the one you have now is not your husband. What you have said is true."
43_4_19: "Sir," the woman said to Him, "I see that You are a prophet.
43_4_20: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where people must worship is in Jerusalem."
43_4_21: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe Me — an hour is coming when neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
43_4_22: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know — for salvation is from the Jews.
43_4_23: But an hour is coming, and is already here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth — for these are the worshipers the Father is seeking.
43_4_24: God is spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and in truth."
43_4_25: The woman said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming — the one called 'Christ.' When He comes, He will explain everything to us."
43_4_26: Jesus said to her, "I am He — the One speaking to you."
43_4_27: Just then, His disciples came back. They were amazed that He was speaking with a woman. But none of them asked, "What do You want?" or "Why are You talking with her?"
43_4_28: So the woman left her water jar, went off into the town, and said to the people,
43_4_29: "Come — see a Man who told me everything I have ever done! Could this possibly be the Christ?"
43_4_30: They went out of the town and were coming toward Him.
43_4_31: Meanwhile, the disciples were urging Him, "Rabbi, eat something."
43_4_32: But He told them, "I have food to eat that you do not know about."
43_4_33: So the disciples said to one another, "Could someone have brought Him something to eat?"
43_4_34: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of the One who sent Me, and to finish His work.
43_4_35: Do you not say, 'Four more months, and then the harvest'? Look — I tell you — lift up your eyes and see the fields: they are already white, ready for harvest.
43_4_36: The reaper is already being paid; he is gathering fruit for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
43_4_37: For in this the saying rings true: 'One sows, and another reaps.'
43_4_38: I sent you to reap what you did not labor for. Others have labored, and you have come into the benefit of their labor."
43_4_39: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Him because of the word of the woman who testified, "He told me everything I ever did."
43_4_40: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they urged Him to stay with them — and He stayed there two days.
43_4_41: And many more believed because of His word.
43_4_42: They said to the woman, "It is no longer because of what you said that we believe — now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this truly is the Savior of the world."
43_4_43: After the two days, He left there for Galilee.
43_4_44: For Jesus Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
43_4_45: So when He came into Galilee, the Galileans welcomed Him — they had seen everything He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they too had gone to the feast.
43_4_46: He came again to Cana in Galilee, where He had made the water wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son was sick in Capernaum.
43_4_47: When this man heard that Jesus had come from Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and begged Him to come down and heal his son — for he was at the point of death.
43_4_48: So Jesus said to him, "Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe."
43_4_49: The royal official said to Him, "Sir, come down before my little boy dies!"
43_4_50: Jesus said to him, "Go — your son lives." The man believed the word Jesus had spoken to him, and went on his way.
43_4_51: As he was going down, his servants met him and told him that his boy was alive.
43_4_52: So he asked them what hour he began to get better. They told him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."
43_4_53: Then the father knew that it was at that very hour Jesus had said to him, "Your son lives." And he himself believed — and his whole household.
43_4_54: This was now the second sign Jesus performed, when He had come from Judea into Galilee.
43_5_1: After this, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
43_5_2: Now in Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, there is a pool — called Bethesda in Hebrew — which has five covered colonnades.
43_5_3: In these lay a crowd of disabled people — blind, lame, paralyzed — waiting for the water to be stirred.
43_5_4: For at certain times an angel of the Lord went down into the pool and stirred the water. Whoever stepped in first, after the water was stirred, was healed of whatever ailment he had.
43_5_5: And there was a certain man there who had been in his sickness for thirty-eight years.
43_5_6: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had already been there a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to be healed?"
43_5_7: The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred. And while I am trying to get there, someone else steps down ahead of me."
43_5_8: Jesus said to him, "Get up. Pick up your mat and walk."
43_5_9: At once the man was made whole — he picked up his mat and began walking. Now that day was a Sabbath.
43_5_10: So the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry your mat."
43_5_11: He answered them, "The one who made me whole — He Himself said to me, 'Pick up your mat and walk.'"
43_5_12: They asked him, "Who is this Man who told you, 'Pick up your mat and walk'?"
43_5_13: But the healed man did not know who it was — Jesus had slipped away, for there was a crowd in the place.
43_5_14: Afterward, Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, "Look — you have been made whole. Do not sin anymore, so that nothing worse happens to you."
43_5_15: The man went off and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him whole.
43_5_16: So the Jewish leaders began to persecute Jesus, because He was doing these things on the Sabbath.
43_5_17: But Jesus answered them, "My Father has been working until now, and I too am working."
43_5_18: This was why the Jewish leaders were all the more trying to kill Him — because He had not only broken the Sabbath, but was also calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
43_5_19: So Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I tell you — the Son can do nothing on His own initiative; He can do only what He sees the Father doing. For whatever the Father does, the Son does likewise.
43_5_20: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him everything He Himself is doing. And He will show Him greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.
43_5_21: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whomever He wills.
43_5_22: For the Father judges no one; instead, He has given all judgment into the hands of the Son,
43_5_23: so that everyone may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. The one who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
43_5_24: Truly, truly, I tell you — the one who hears My word and believes the One who sent Me has eternal life. He does not come into judgment, but has crossed over from death into life.
43_5_25: Truly, truly, I tell you — an hour is coming, and is already here, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
43_5_26: For just as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
43_5_27: And He has given Him the authority to carry out judgment — because He is the Son of Man.
43_5_28: Do not be amazed at this, for an hour is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear His voice
43_5_29: and will come out — those who have done good into a resurrection of life, and those who have practiced evil into a resurrection of judgment.
43_5_30: I can do nothing on My own initiative. As I hear, I judge — and My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will but the will of the One who sent Me.
43_5_31: If I bear witness about Myself, My testimony does not stand as proof.
43_5_32: There is another who bears witness about Me, and I know that the testimony He bears about Me is true.
43_5_33: You yourselves sent to John, and he has borne witness to the truth.
43_5_34: Not that I rely on human testimony — but I say these things so that you may be saved.
43_5_35: He was the lamp that was burning and shining, and you were willing for a while to rejoice in his light.
43_5_36: But the witness I have is greater than John's. For the very works the Father has given Me to finish — the works I am doing — bear witness about Me, that the Father has sent Me.
43_5_37: And the Father who sent Me — He Himself has borne witness about Me. You have never heard His voice, nor seen His form,
43_5_38: and you do not have His word abiding in you — because you do not believe the One He sent.
43_5_39: You search the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life. And these very Scriptures bear witness about Me.
43_5_40: Yet you are not willing to come to Me, that you may have life.
43_5_41: I do not receive glory from people.
43_5_42: But I know you — you do not have the love of God within you.
43_5_43: I have come in My Father's name, and you do not receive Me. If another comes in his own name, him you will receive.
43_5_44: How can you believe, when you receive glory from one another, but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
43_5_45: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. The one who accuses you is Moses — the one in whom you have set your hope.
43_5_46: If you believed Moses, you would believe Me — for he wrote about Me.
43_5_47: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"
43_6_1: After this, Jesus went off to the other side of the Sea of Galilee — also called the Sea of Tiberias.
43_6_2: A great crowd followed Him, because they had seen the signs He was performing on those who were sick.
43_6_3: Jesus went up on the mountainside and sat down there with His disciples.
43_6_4: The Passover — the feast of the Jews — was near.
43_6_5: So Jesus lifted up His eyes, and seeing that a huge crowd was coming toward Him, He said to Philip, "Where are we to buy bread so that these people may eat?"
43_6_6: He said this to test him, for He Himself knew what He was about to do.
43_6_7: Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii's worth of bread would not be enough for each of them to get a little!"
43_6_8: One of His disciples — Andrew, Simon Peter's brother — said to Him,
43_6_9: "There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fish. But what is that among so many?"
43_6_10: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down — about five thousand of them.
43_6_11: Then Jesus took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed them to those sitting down — as much as they wanted — and likewise with the fish.
43_6_12: When they had eaten their fill, He said to His disciples, "Gather up the leftover pieces, so that nothing is wasted."
43_6_13: So they gathered them up and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves, left over by those who had eaten.
43_6_14: When the people saw the sign Jesus had performed, they began saying, "Truly — this is the Prophet who is to come into the world!"
43_6_15: Then Jesus, knowing that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, withdrew again to the mountain — alone.
43_6_16: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea.
43_6_17: They got into a boat and started across the sea toward Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
43_6_18: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew rough.
43_6_19: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, drawing near to the boat — and they were afraid.
43_6_20: But He said to them, "It is I — do not be afraid."
43_6_21: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the land for which they had been heading.
43_6_22: The next day, the crowd that had stayed on the other side of the sea realized that only one small boat had been there, and that Jesus had not gotten into the boat with His disciples — but His disciples had gone away alone.
43_6_23: Other small boats from Tiberias came near the place where they had eaten the bread, after the Lord had given thanks.
43_6_24: So when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there — and neither were His disciples — they got into the boats and came to Capernaum, looking for Jesus.
43_6_25: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You get here?"
43_6_26: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I tell you — you are looking for Me not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and had your fill.
43_6_27: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures into eternal life — the food which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has set His seal."
43_6_28: So they said to Him, "What must we do to carry out the works of God?"
43_6_29: Jesus answered them, "This is the work of God — that you believe in the One He has sent."
43_6_30: So they said to Him, "Then what sign are You going to do, so we may see it and believe You? What work will You perform?
43_6_31: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness — as it is written, 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'"
43_6_32: Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I tell you — it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven; My Father is giving you the true bread from heaven.
43_6_33: For the bread of God is the One who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
43_6_34: So they said to Him, "Sir, give us this bread always."
43_6_35: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. The one who comes to Me will never hunger, and the one who believes in Me will never thirst.
43_6_36: But as I told you, you have seen Me — and still you do not believe.
43_6_37: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never cast out.
43_6_38: For I have come down from heaven — not to do My own will, but the will of the One who sent Me.
43_6_39: And this is the will of the One who sent Me: that I should lose nothing of all He has given Me, but raise it up on the last day.
43_6_40: For this is the will of My Father: that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him should have eternal life — and I Myself will raise him up on the last day."
43_6_41: So the Jewish leaders grumbled about Him, because He had said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."
43_6_42: They said, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, 'I have come down from heaven'?"
43_6_43: Jesus answered them, "Stop grumbling among yourselves.
43_6_44: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him — and I Myself will raise him up on the last day.
43_6_45: It is written in the Prophets, 'And they will all be taught by God.' Everyone who has heard the Father and has learned from Him comes to Me.
43_6_46: Not that anyone has seen the Father — except the One who is from God. He has seen the Father.
43_6_47: Truly, truly, I tell you — the one who believes has eternal life.
43_6_48: I am the bread of life.
43_6_49: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
43_6_50: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
43_6_51: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And the bread I will give for the life of the world is My flesh."
43_6_52: The Jewish leaders then argued with one another, saying, "How can this Man give us His flesh to eat?"
43_6_53: So Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I tell you — unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in yourselves.
43_6_54: The one who feeds on My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.
43_6_55: For My flesh is true food, and My blood is true drink.
43_6_56: The one who feeds on My flesh and drinks My blood abides in Me, and I in him.
43_6_57: Just as the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father — so the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
43_6_58: This is the bread that came down from heaven — not as the fathers ate and died. The one who feeds on this bread will live forever."
43_6_59: He said these things while teaching in the synagogue at Capernaum.
43_6_60: When many of His disciples heard this, they said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can listen to it?"
43_6_61: But Jesus, knowing in Himself that His disciples were grumbling about this, said to them, "Does this offend you?
43_6_62: What then — if you should see the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?
43_6_63: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I have spoken to you — they are spirit, and they are life.
43_6_64: But there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning which ones did not believe, and who was going to betray Him.
43_6_65: And He said, "This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted to him by the Father."
43_6_66: From that point on, many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.
43_6_67: So Jesus said to the twelve, "You do not want to go away also, do you?"
43_6_68: Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
43_6_69: We have come to believe — and we know — that You are the Holy One of God."
43_6_70: Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve? And yet one of you is a devil."
43_6_71: He was speaking of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot — for it was he, though one of the twelve, who was going to betray Him.
43_7_1: After these things, Jesus went about in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea, because the Jewish leaders were looking to kill Him.
43_7_2: Now the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was at hand.
43_7_3: So His brothers said to Him, "Leave here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples may see the works You are doing.
43_7_4: For no one does anything in secret who wants to be known in the open. If You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world!"
43_7_5: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.
43_7_6: Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet come — but for you, the time is always right.
43_7_7: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify about it that its works are evil.
43_7_8: You yourselves go up to the feast. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet fully come."
43_7_9: Having said this, He remained in Galilee.
43_7_10: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, then He Himself also went up — not openly, but as though in secret.
43_7_11: So the Jewish leaders were looking for Him at the feast, and asking, "Where is that Man?"
43_7_12: And there was much muttering about Him among the crowds. Some were saying, "He is a good man." Others were saying, "No — He is leading the people astray."
43_7_13: But no one spoke openly about Him, for fear of the Jewish leaders.
43_7_14: Now about the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and began teaching.
43_7_15: The Jewish leaders were astonished and said, "How does this Man know the Scriptures, when He has never studied?"
43_7_16: Jesus answered them, "My teaching is not My own; it comes from the One who sent Me.
43_7_17: If anyone wants to do His will, he will know about the teaching — whether it is from God, or I am speaking on My own authority.
43_7_18: The one who speaks on his own seeks his own glory; but the One who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him — He is true, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
43_7_19: Did not Moses give you the law? And yet none of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill Me?
43_7_20: The crowd answered, "You have a demon! Who is trying to kill You?"
43_7_21: Jesus answered them, "I did one work, and you all marvel.
43_7_22: Moses gave you circumcision — not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers — and on the Sabbath you circumcise a man.
43_7_23: If a man is circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with Me because I made a whole man well on the Sabbath?
43_7_24: Stop judging by outward appearance — judge with right judgment."
43_7_25: Then some from Jerusalem began saying, "Is not this the Man they are trying to kill?
43_7_26: And look — He is speaking openly, and they say nothing to Him! Have the rulers truly come to know that this is the Christ?
43_7_27: But we know where this Man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from."
43_7_28: Then Jesus, teaching in the temple, cried out: "You know Me, and you know where I am from. And yet I have not come on My own — but the One who sent Me is true, and you do not know Him.
43_7_29: I know Him, because I am from Him, and He sent Me."
43_7_30: Then they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him — because His hour had not yet come.
43_7_31: Yet many in the crowd believed in Him, and they said, "When the Christ comes, will He do more signs than this Man has done?"
43_7_32: The Pharisees heard the crowd muttering these things about Him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to arrest Him.
43_7_33: Then Jesus said, "A little while longer I am with you, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
43_7_34: You will look for Me and will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come."
43_7_35: So the Jewish leaders said to one another, "Where is He about to go, that we will not find Him? Is He about to go to the dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
43_7_36: What did He mean when He said, 'You will look for Me and will not find Me,' and, 'Where I am, you cannot come'?"
43_7_37: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and cried out, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink!
43_7_38: Whoever believes in Me — as the Scripture has said — 'Out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.'"
43_7_39: Now He said this about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were about to receive. For as yet the Spirit had not been given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
43_7_40: When they heard these words, some of the crowd began saying, "This truly is the Prophet."
43_7_41: Others said, "This is the Christ." But some were saying, "Surely the Christ is not going to come out of Galilee, is He?
43_7_42: Has not the Scripture said that the Christ is to come from the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?
43_7_43: So there was a division in the crowd because of Him.
43_7_44: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid hands on Him.
43_7_45: The officers then came to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, "Why did you not bring Him?"
43_7_46: The officers answered, "Never has any man spoken like this!"
43_7_47: So the Pharisees answered them, "Have you been led astray too?
43_7_48: Have any of the rulers believed in Him? Or any of the Pharisees?
43_7_49: But this crowd that does not know the law — they are accursed!"
43_7_50: Nicodemus — who had come to Him earlier, and was one of them — said to them,
43_7_51: "Does our law judge a man before it first hears him and knows what he is doing?"
43_7_52: They answered him, "Are you also from Galilee? Search and see — no prophet arises from Galilee."
43_7_53: And everyone went off to his own house.
43_8_1: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
43_8_2: Early in the morning, He came again into the temple. All the people came to Him, and He sat down and began teaching them.
43_8_3: Then the scribes and Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They stood her in the middle of the assembly
43_8_4: and said to Him, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act of adultery.
43_8_5: In the Law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do You say?"
43_8_6: They said this to test Him, so that they would have grounds to accuse Him. But Jesus stooped down and began writing on the ground with His finger.
43_8_7: When they kept on questioning Him, He straightened up and said to them, "Let the one among you without sin be the first to throw a stone at her."
43_8_8: And He stooped down again and went on writing on the ground.
43_8_9: When they heard it, they went out one by one, beginning with the eldest — down to the last one. Jesus was left alone, with the woman standing there in the middle.
43_8_10: Jesus straightened up and said to her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"
43_8_11: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you. Go, and from now on sin no more."
43_8_12: Then Jesus spoke to them again and said, "I am the Light of the world. The one who follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life."
43_8_13: So the Pharisees said to Him, "You are bearing witness about Yourself. Your testimony is not true."
43_8_14: Jesus answered them, "Even if I bear witness about Myself, My testimony is true — because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
43_8_15: You judge by the flesh; I judge no one.
43_8_16: And even if I judge, My judgment is true — because I am not alone, but I and the Father who sent Me.
43_8_17: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is true.
43_8_18: I am the One who bears witness about Myself, and the Father who sent Me also bears witness about Me."
43_8_19: So they said to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You do not know Me, nor My Father. If you knew Me, you would know My Father also."
43_8_20: He spoke these words in the treasury, as He was teaching in the temple. But no one arrested Him, because His hour had not yet come.
43_8_21: Then He said to them again, "I am going away, and you will look for Me, and you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come."
43_8_22: So the Jewish leaders were saying, "Will He kill Himself? Is that why He says, 'Where I am going, you cannot come'?"
43_8_23: And He was saying to them, "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
43_8_24: I told you that you would die in your sins — for unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins."
