43_8_25: So they said to Him, "Who are You?" Jesus said to them, "What I have been telling you from the beginning.
43_8_26: I have many things to say about you and to judge. But the One who sent Me is true — and what I have heard from Him, these are the things I speak to the world.
43_8_27: They did not understand that He had been speaking to them about the Father.
43_8_28: So Jesus said, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He — and that I do nothing on My own authority, but speak just as the Father taught Me.
43_8_29: And the One who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone — for I always do what is pleasing to Him."
43_8_30: As He was saying these things, many believed in Him.
43_8_31: So Jesus said to the Jews who had believed in Him, "If you abide in My word, you are truly My disciples.
43_8_32: And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
43_8_33: They answered Him, "We are Abraham's offspring, and we have never been slaves to anyone! How is it that You say, 'You will be made free'?"
43_8_34: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I tell you — everyone who commits sin is a slave to sin.
43_8_35: A slave does not remain in the household forever; a son remains forever.
43_8_36: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
43_8_37: I know that you are Abraham's offspring. Yet you seek to kill Me, because My word finds no place in you.
43_8_38: I speak of what I have seen with My Father, and you do what you have heard from your father."
43_8_39: They answered and said to Him, "Abraham is our father." Jesus said to them, "If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of Abraham.
43_8_40: But now you seek to kill Me — a Man who has told you the truth I heard from God. This is not what Abraham did.
43_8_41: You do the works of your own father." They said to Him, "We are not born of fornication. We have one Father — God."
43_8_42: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love Me — for I came out from God, and I have come here. For I have not come on My own; He sent Me.
43_8_43: Why do you not understand what I am saying? Because you cannot listen to My word.
43_8_44: You are of your father, the devil — and the desires of your father you want to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own nature — for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
43_8_45: But because I tell the truth, you do not believe Me.
43_8_46: Which of you convicts Me of sin? And if I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
43_8_47: The one who is of God listens to God's words. The reason you do not listen is that you are not of God."
43_8_48: The Jewish leaders answered and said to Him, "Are we not right in saying that You are a Samaritan, and have a demon?"
43_8_49: Jesus answered, "I do not have a demon. I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
43_8_50: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it — and He is the Judge.
43_8_51: Truly, truly, I tell you — if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death — ever."
43_8_52: The Jewish leaders said to Him, "Now we know You have a demon! Abraham died, and the prophets too — and You say, 'If anyone keeps My word, he will never taste death.'
43_8_53: Are You greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets died. Who do You make Yourself out to be?"
43_8_54: Jesus answered, "If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing. It is My Father who glorifies Me — the One of whom you say, 'He is our God.'
43_8_55: And yet you have not known Him. But I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
43_8_56: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day. He saw it, and was glad."
43_8_57: So the Jewish leaders said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?"
43_8_58: Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I tell you — before Abraham was, I AM."
43_8_59: So they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple.
43_9_1: As Jesus was passing by, He saw a man who had been blind from birth.
43_9_2: His disciples asked Him, "Rabbi, who sinned — this man, or his parents — that he was born blind?"
43_9_3: Jesus answered, "Neither this man nor his parents sinned. But this happened so that the works of God might be revealed in him.
43_9_4: We must do the works of the One who sent Me while it is day. Night is coming, when no one can work.
43_9_5: While I am in the world, I am the Light of the world."
43_9_6: Having said this, He spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and anointed the man's eyes with the mud.
43_9_7: Then He said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means Sent). So he went and washed, and came back seeing.
43_9_8: The neighbors, and those who had seen him before as a beggar, began saying, "Is this not the man who used to sit and beg?"
43_9_9: Some said, "This is he." Others said, "No, but he is like him." He himself kept saying, "I am the one."
43_9_10: So they said to him, "Then how were your eyes opened?"
43_9_11: He answered, "The Man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to Siloam and wash.' So I went and washed, and I received my sight."
43_9_12: And they said to him, "Where is He?" He said, "I do not know."
43_9_13: They brought him — the one formerly blind — to the Pharisees.
43_9_14: Now it was the Sabbath on the day Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
43_9_15: So the Pharisees also began to ask him how he had received his sight. He said to them, "He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
43_9_16: So some of the Pharisees were saying, "This Man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath." But others were saying, "How can a sinful man perform such signs?" And there was a division among them.
43_9_17: So they said to the blind man again, "What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."
43_9_18: But the Jewish leaders did not believe this about him — that he had been blind and received his sight — until they called the parents of the one who had received his sight.
43_9_19: And they questioned them: "Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"
43_9_20: His parents answered them, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind.
43_9_21: But how he now sees, we do not know. And who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him — he is of age, he will speak for himself."
43_9_22: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, for the leaders had already agreed that if anyone confessed Him to be the Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
43_9_23: That is why his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
43_9_24: So a second time they called the man who had been blind, and said to him, "Give glory to God! We know that this Man is a sinner."
43_9_25: He answered, "Whether He is a sinner, I do not know. One thing I do know — I was blind, and now I see."
43_9_26: They said to him, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"
43_9_27: He answered them, "I told you already, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You do not want to become His disciples also, do you?"
43_9_28: They railed at him and said, "You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses!
43_9_29: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But this Man — we do not know where He comes from."
43_9_30: The man answered and said to them, "Why, this is an amazing thing! You do not know where He is from — and yet He opened my eyes.
43_9_31: We know that God does not listen to sinners. But if anyone is a worshiper of God and does His will, God listens to him.
43_9_32: From the beginning of time it has never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of a man born blind.
43_9_33: If this Man were not from God, He could do nothing."
43_9_34: They answered and said to him, "You were born entirely in sin, and you teach us?" And they cast him out.
43_9_35: Jesus heard that they had cast him out. And when He found him, He said, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"
43_9_36: He answered, "Who is He, sir, that I might believe in Him?"
43_9_37: Jesus said to him, "You have both seen Him — and He is the One speaking to you."
43_9_38: He said, "Lord, I believe!" And he worshiped Him.
43_9_39: And Jesus said, "For judgment I came into this world — so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind."
43_9_40: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this, and said to Him, "Are we blind also?"
43_9_41: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin. But now you say, 'We see' — so your sin remains."
43_10_1: "Truly, truly, I tell you — the one who does not enter the sheepfold by the door, but climbs in another way, he is a thief and a robber.
43_10_2: But the one who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
43_10_3: To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
43_10_4: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and the sheep follow him — because they know his voice.
43_10_5: They will not follow a stranger; they will flee from him — because they do not know the voice of strangers."
43_10_6: Jesus spoke this figure of speech to them, but they did not understand what He was saying to them.
43_10_7: So Jesus said to them again, "Truly, truly, I tell you — I am the door of the sheep.
43_10_8: All who came before Me are thieves and robbers — but the sheep did not listen to them.
43_10_9: I am the door. Whoever enters through Me will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
43_10_10: The thief comes only to steal, and kill, and destroy. I came that they might have life — and have it abundantly.
43_10_11: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
43_10_12: The hired hand, who is not the shepherd — the sheep are not his own — when he sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep and runs away. And the wolf snatches them and scatters them.
43_10_13: He runs because he is a hired hand, and does not care about the sheep.
43_10_14: I am the good shepherd. I know My own, and My own know Me —
43_10_15: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father — and I lay down My life for the sheep.
43_10_16: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear My voice. And there will be one flock, one shepherd.
43_10_17: For this reason the Father loves Me — because I lay down My life so that I may take it up again.
43_10_18: No one takes it from Me; I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. This command I received from My Father."
43_10_19: Again there was a division among the Jewish leaders because of these words.
43_10_20: Many of them were saying, "He has a demon. He is out of His mind. Why listen to Him?"
43_10_21: Others were saying, "These are not the words of one who is demon-possessed. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
43_10_22: Then came the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem. It was winter,
43_10_23: and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's Colonnade.
43_10_24: So the Jewish leaders surrounded Him and said to Him, "How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."
43_10_25: Jesus answered them, "I did tell you — and you do not believe. The works I do in My Father's name — these bear witness about Me.
43_10_26: But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep.
43_10_27: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.
43_10_28: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish — ever. And no one will snatch them out of My hand.
43_10_29: My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all. And no one can snatch them out of the Father's hand.
43_10_30: I and the Father are one."
43_10_31: Again the Jewish leaders picked up stones to stone Him.
43_10_32: Jesus answered them, "I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these works are you stoning Me?"
43_10_33: The Jewish leaders answered Him, "We are not stoning You for a good work, but for blasphemy — because You, being a man, make Yourself God."
43_10_34: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your Law, 'I said, you are gods'?
43_10_35: If He called them 'gods,' to whom the word of God came — and the Scripture cannot be broken —
43_10_36: do you say of the One whom the Father consecrated and sent into the world, 'You are blaspheming' — because I said, 'I am the Son of God'?
43_10_37: If I am not doing the works of My Father, do not believe Me.
43_10_38: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works — so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I in the Father."
43_10_39: Then they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped out of their hand.
43_10_40: He went away again across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing at first, and stayed there.
43_10_41: Many came to Him. And they kept saying, "John did no sign — but everything John said about this Man was true."
43_10_42: And many believed in Him there.
43_11_1: Now a certain man was sick — Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
43_11_2: (Mary was the one who anointed the Lord with perfume and wiped His feet with her hair; it was her brother Lazarus who was sick.)
43_11_3: So the sisters sent to Him, saying, "Lord, look — the one You love is sick."
43_11_4: When Jesus heard it, He said, "This sickness will not end in death. It is for the glory of God — so that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
43_11_5: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
43_11_6: So when He heard that he was sick, He stayed two more days in the place where He was.
43_11_7: Then after this He said to the disciples, "Let us go into Judea again."
43_11_8: The disciples said to Him, "Rabbi, the Jewish leaders were just now trying to stone You — and You are going back there?"
43_11_9: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks during the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
43_11_10: But if anyone walks at night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him.
43_11_11: Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep. But I am going so that I may wake him up."
43_11_12: So the disciples said to Him, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover."
43_11_13: Jesus had been speaking about his death, but they thought He meant sleep — natural rest.
43_11_14: Then Jesus told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead.
43_11_15: And for your sake I am glad I was not there — so that you may believe. But let us go to him."
43_11_16: So Thomas, who was called the Twin, said to the other disciples, "Let us also go, so that we may die with Him."
43_11_17: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
43_11_18: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem — about two miles off —
43_11_19: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
43_11_20: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him — but Mary stayed sitting in the house.
43_11_21: Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
43_11_22: And even now, I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You."
43_11_23: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."
43_11_24: Martha said to Him, "I know that he will rise again — in the resurrection, on the last day."
43_11_25: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in Me — even if he dies — will live.
43_11_26: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die — ever. Do you believe this?"
43_11_27: She said to Him, "Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, the One who is coming into the world."
43_11_28: Having said this, she went off and called her sister Mary in secret, saying, "The Teacher is here, and is calling for you."
43_11_29: When Mary heard it, she got up quickly and came to Him.
43_11_30: Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha had met Him.
43_11_31: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, consoling her, saw her get up quickly and go out, they followed her — thinking she was going to the tomb to weep there.
43_11_32: When Mary came to the place where Jesus was, and saw Him, she fell at His feet, saying to Him, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died."
43_11_33: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit — and troubled.
43_11_34: And He said, "Where have you laid him?" They said to Him, "Lord, come and see."
43_11_36: So the Jews were saying, "See how He loved him!"
43_11_37: But some of them said, "Could not this Man, who opened the eyes of the blind, have kept this man from dying?"
43_11_38: Jesus, again deeply moved in Himself, came to the tomb. It was a cave, with a stone lying against it.
43_11_39: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to Him, "Lord, by now there is a stench — it has been four days."
43_11_40: Jesus said to her, "Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?"
43_11_41: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up His eyes and said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
43_11_42: I knew that You always hear Me — but I said this for the sake of the crowd standing around, so that they may believe that You sent Me."
43_11_43: When He had said this, He cried out with a loud voice: "Lazarus, come out!"
43_11_44: The man who had died came out — his hands and feet bound with strips of linen, his face wrapped with a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Unbind him, and let him go."
43_11_45: Many of the Jews, therefore, who had come with Mary and had seen what He did, believed in Him.
43_11_46: But some of them went off to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
43_11_47: So the chief priests and the Pharisees called a council and said, "What are we doing? For this Man is performing many signs.
43_11_48: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him. Then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."
43_11_49: One of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all!
43_11_50: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man should die for the people, than that the whole nation should perish."
43_11_51: He did not say this on his own — but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was about to die for the nation,
43_11_52: and not for the nation only — but also to gather into one the children of God who had been scattered abroad.
43_11_53: So from that day on, they plotted how to kill Him.
43_11_54: Therefore Jesus no longer walked openly among the Jewish leaders, but went away from there to the region near the wilderness, to a town called Ephraim. And He stayed there with His disciples.
43_11_55: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover to purify themselves.
43_11_56: They were looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple, they were saying to one another, "What do you think? He will not come to the feast at all, will He?"
43_11_57: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where He was, he should report it — so that they might arrest Him.
43_12_1: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was — the one Jesus had raised from the dead.
43_12_2: So they gave a dinner for Him there. Martha was serving; Lazarus was one of those reclining at table with Him.
43_12_3: Then Mary took a pound of pure nard — a very costly perfume — and anointed Jesus' feet. She wiped His feet with her hair, and the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
43_12_4: But Judas Iscariot, one of His disciples, who was about to betray Him, said,
43_12_5: "Why was this perfume not sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?"
43_12_6: He said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief — and being in charge of the money box, he used to steal what was put into it.
43_12_7: So Jesus said, "Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of My burial.
43_12_8: For the poor you always have with you — but you do not always have Me."
43_12_9: A great crowd of the Jews learned that He was there, and they came — not only for the sake of Jesus, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
43_12_10: So the chief priests plotted to kill Lazarus as well,
43_12_11: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away and believing in Jesus.
43_12_12: On the next day, the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming into Jerusalem.
43_12_13: So they took branches of palm trees and went out to meet Him, shouting: "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord — the King of Israel!"
43_12_14: And Jesus, finding a young donkey, sat on it — as it is written:
43_12_15: "Do not be afraid, daughter of Zion. Look — your King is coming, seated on a donkey's colt."
43_12_16: His disciples did not understand these things at first — but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things had been written about Him, and that they had done these things for Him.
43_12_17: So the crowd who had been with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead kept bearing witness.
43_12_18: For this reason the crowd also came out to meet Him — because they had heard that He had performed this sign.
43_12_19: So the Pharisees said to one another, "You see — you are getting nowhere. Look — the whole world has gone after Him!"
43_12_20: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
43_12_21: These came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and asked him, "Sir, we want to see Jesus."
43_12_22: Philip went and told Andrew, and then Andrew and Philip went and told Jesus.
43_12_23: Jesus answered them, saying, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
43_12_24: Truly, truly, I tell you — unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
43_12_25: The one who loves his life loses it, and the one who hates his life in this world will keep it into eternal life.
43_12_26: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me — and where I am, there My servant also will be. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
43_12_27: Now My soul is troubled. And what shall I say? 'Father, save Me from this hour'? But it was for this very reason that I came to this hour.
43_12_28: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came from heaven: "I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again."
43_12_29: The crowd standing by heard it and said, "It has thundered." Others said, "An angel has spoken to Him."
43_12_30: Jesus answered, "This voice came for your sake — not for Mine.
43_12_31: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
43_12_32: And when I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw all people to Myself."
43_12_33: He said this to show by what kind of death He was about to die.
43_12_34: The crowd answered Him, "We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. How can You say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this Son of Man?"
43_12_35: Then Jesus said to them, "The Light is among you for a little while longer. Walk while you have the Light, so that the darkness does not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
43_12_36: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of Light." Jesus spoke these things, and departed, and hid Himself from them.
43_12_37: Although He had performed so many signs before them, they still would not believe in Him —
43_12_38: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: "Lord, who has believed what we have heard? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
43_12_39: For this reason they could not believe — because again, Isaiah said:
43_12_40: "He has blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart — so that they would not see with their eyes, and understand with their heart, and turn — and I would heal them."
43_12_41: Isaiah said these things because he saw His glory, and spoke about Him.
43_12_42: Yet even so, many of the rulers believed in Him. But because of the Pharisees, they would not confess it, for fear of being put out of the synagogue —
43_12_43: for they loved the glory that comes from men more than the glory that comes from God.
43_12_44: Then Jesus cried out and said, "The one who believes in Me believes not in Me, but in the One who sent Me.
43_12_45: And the one who sees Me sees the One who sent Me.
43_12_46: I have come as Light into the world — so that everyone who believes in Me will not remain in the darkness.
43_12_47: If anyone hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him — for I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
43_12_48: The one who rejects Me and does not receive My words has one who judges him: the word I have spoken — that will judge him on the last day.
43_12_49: For I have not spoken on My own. The Father who sent Me — He Himself has given Me a command: what I am to say, and what I am to speak.
43_12_50: And I know that His command is eternal life. So the things I speak — just as the Father has told Me, so I speak."
43_13_1: Now before the Feast of the Passover, Jesus — knowing that His hour had come to depart out of this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world — loved them to the very end.
43_13_2: During supper, the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray Him.
43_13_3: Jesus — knowing that the Father had given all things into His hands, and that He had come from God, and was going back to God —
43_13_4: got up from supper, laid aside His outer garments, took a towel, and tied it around His waist.
43_13_5: Then He poured water into the basin and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to dry them with the towel that was tied around Him.
43_13_6: He came to Simon Peter, who said to Him, "Lord — You are going to wash my feet?"
43_13_7: Jesus answered him, "What I am doing, you do not understand now — but afterward you will understand."
43_13_8: Peter said to Him, "You will never wash my feet — ever!" Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you have no share with Me."
43_13_9: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord — not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!"
43_13_10: Jesus said to him, "The one who has bathed does not need to wash, except for his feet. He is completely clean. And you are clean — though not every one of you."
43_13_11: For He knew the one who would betray Him. That is why He said, "You are not all clean."
43_13_12: So when He had washed their feet, and taken His garments and reclined again, He said to them, "Do you understand what I have done for you?
43_13_13: You call Me 'Teacher' and 'Lord' — and rightly so, for that is what I am.
43_13_14: So if I — your Lord and Teacher — have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.
43_13_15: For I have given you an example — so that you also should do just as I have done for you.
43_13_16: Truly, truly, I tell you — a servant is not greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
43_13_17: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
43_13_18: I am not speaking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But this is so that the Scripture may be fulfilled: 'The one who ate My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.'
43_13_19: From now on I am telling you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you may believe that I am He.
43_13_20: Truly, truly, I tell you — whoever receives anyone I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me."
43_13_21: Having said these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified: "Truly, truly, I tell you — one of you will betray Me."
43_13_22: The disciples began looking at one another, at a loss as to whom He was speaking about.
43_13_23: One of His disciples, the one Jesus loved, was reclining at the table close beside Him.
43_13_24: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask who it was He was speaking about.
43_13_25: Leaning back on Jesus' chest, he said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"
43_13_26: Jesus answered, "It is the one to whom I will give this morsel of bread when I have dipped it." So when He had dipped the bread, He took and gave it to Judas Iscariot, son of Simon.
43_13_27: And after the morsel, then Satan entered him. Jesus said to him, "What you are about to do, do quickly."
43_13_28: None of those reclining at table knew why He said this to him.
43_13_29: Some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus was telling him, 'Buy what we need for the feast,' or that he should give something to the poor.
43_13_30: So after receiving the morsel, Judas went out at once. And it was night.
43_13_31: So when he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
43_13_32: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself — and He will glorify Him at once.
43_13_33: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me — and just as I said to the Jewish leaders, 'Where I am going, you cannot come' — so now I say to you.
43_13_34: A new commandment I give to you: love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also are to love one another.
43_13_35: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples — if you have love for one another."
43_13_36: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, where are You going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now — but you will follow afterward."
43_13_37: Peter said to Him, "Lord, why can I not follow You now? I will lay down my life for You!"
43_13_38: Jesus answered, "You will lay down your life for Me? Truly, truly, I tell you — the rooster will not crow until you have denied Me three times."
43_14_1: "Do not let your heart be troubled. You believe in God — believe also in Me.
43_14_2: In My Father's house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
43_14_3: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and take you to Myself — so that where I am, you may be also.
43_14_4: And where I am going, you know the way."
43_14_5: Thomas said to Him, "Lord, we do not know where You are going. How can we know the way?"
43_14_6: Jesus said to him, "I am the Way, and the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
43_14_7: If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also. From now on, you do know Him — and you have seen Him."
43_14_8: Philip said to Him, "Lord, show us the Father — and that will be enough for us."
43_14_9: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you so long, Philip, and you still do not know Me? The one who has seen Me has seen the Father. How then can you say, 'Show us the Father'?
43_14_10: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own authority — but the Father, living in Me, is doing His works.
43_14_11: Believe Me — I am in the Father and the Father is in Me. Or else, believe on account of the works themselves.
43_14_12: Truly, truly, I tell you — the one who believes in Me, the works that I do, he will do also. And greater works than these he will do, because I am going to the Father.
43_14_13: And whatever you ask in My name, this I will do — so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
43_14_14: If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.
43_14_15: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
43_14_16: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper — the Paraclete — to be with you forever,
43_14_17: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him. You know Him, for He lives with you — and will be in you.
43_14_18: I will not leave you as orphans. I will come to you.
43_14_19: A little while longer, and the world will see Me no more. But you will see Me — because I live, you also will live.
43_14_20: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.
43_14_21: The one who has My commandments and keeps them — he is the one who loves Me. And the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father. And I will love him, and will reveal Myself to him.
43_14_22: Judas (not Iscariot) said to Him, "Lord, how is it that You are about to reveal Yourself to us, and not to the world?"
43_14_23: Jesus answered him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word — and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
43_14_24: The one who does not love Me does not keep My words. And the word you are hearing is not Mine, but the Father's — who sent Me.
43_14_25: I have spoken these things to you while remaining with you.
43_14_26: But the Helper — the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name — He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance everything I have said to you.
43_14_27: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your heart be troubled — and do not be afraid.
43_14_28: You heard Me say to you, 'I am going away, and I will come to you.' If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father — for the Father is greater than I.
43_14_29: And now I have told you before it happens — so that when it does happen, you may believe.
43_14_30: I will no longer talk much with you — for the ruler of this world is coming. He has no hold on Me,
43_14_31: but he comes so that the world may know that I love the Father, and that I do exactly as the Father has commanded Me. Rise — let us go from here.
43_15_1: "I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.
43_15_2: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit, He takes away; and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes — so that it may bear more fruit.
43_15_3: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
43_15_4: Remain in Me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine — neither can you, unless you remain in Me.
43_15_5: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him — he bears much fruit. For apart from Me, you can do nothing.
43_15_6: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is cast out like a branch and withers. They gather them, throw them into the fire — and they are burned.
43_15_7: If you remain in Me, and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish — and it will be done for you.
43_15_8: By this My Father is glorified — that you bear much fruit, and show yourselves to be My disciples.
43_15_9: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
43_15_10: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love — just as I have kept My Father's commandments, and remain in His love.
43_15_11: These things I have spoken to you, so that My joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.
43_15_12: This is My commandment: that you love one another, just as I have loved you.
43_15_13: No one has greater love than this — that one lays down his life for his friends.
43_15_14: You are My friends, if you do what I command you.
43_15_15: No longer do I call you servants — for the servant does not know what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.
43_15_16: You did not choose Me — I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit, fruit that would last — so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He may give you.
43_15_17: These things I command you — that you love one another.
43_15_18: If the world hates you, know this: it hated Me before it hated you.
43_15_19: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, and I chose you out of the world — for this reason the world hates you.
43_15_20: Remember the word I spoke to you: 'A servant is not greater than his master.' If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they kept My word, they will also keep yours.
43_15_21: But all these things they will do to you on account of My name — because they do not know the One who sent Me.
43_15_22: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
43_15_23: The one who hates Me also hates My Father.
43_15_24: If I had not done among them the works no one else has done, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have both seen and hated both Me and My Father.
43_15_25: Yet this happened to fulfill the word written in their Law: 'They hated Me without a cause.'
43_15_26: When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father — the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father — He will bear witness about Me.
43_15_27: And you too will bear witness, because you have been with Me from the beginning."
43_16_1: "These things I have spoken to you so that you will not fall away.
43_16_2: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, an hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
43_16_3: And they will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
43_16_4: But I have spoken these things to you so that, when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I did not say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you.
43_16_5: But now I am going to the One who sent Me — and none of you asks Me, 'Where are You going?'
43_16_6: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
43_16_7: Still, I tell you the truth — it is to your advantage that I go away. For if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you. But if I go, I will send Him to you.
43_16_8: And when He comes, He will convict the world concerning sin, and righteousness, and judgment:
43_16_9: concerning sin — because they do not believe in Me;
43_16_10: concerning righteousness — because I am going to the Father, and you will see Me no more;
43_16_11: concerning judgment — because the ruler of this world has been judged.
43_16_12: I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.
43_16_13: But when He — the Spirit of truth — comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own initiative — He will speak whatever He hears. And He will declare to you the things that are to come.
43_16_14: He will glorify Me, because He will take what is Mine and declare it to you.
43_16_15: Everything the Father has is Mine. That is why I said He will take what is Mine and declare it to you.
43_16_16: A little while, and you will no longer see Me — and again a little while, and you will see Me."
43_16_17: So some of His disciples said to one another, "What does He mean by this — 'A little while, and you will not see Me, and again a little while, and you will see Me,' and, 'because I am going to the Father'?"
43_16_18: They kept saying, "What is this 'little while' He speaks of? We do not know what He is talking about."
43_16_19: Jesus knew they wanted to ask Him — so He said to them, "Are you discussing with one another what I meant by 'A little while and you will not see Me, and again a little while and you will see Me'?
43_16_20: Truly, truly, I tell you — you will weep and mourn, while the world rejoices. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.
43_16_21: A woman in labor has sorrow, because her hour has come. But as soon as she has given birth to the child, she no longer remembers the anguish — for joy that a human being has been born into the world.
43_16_22: So also you have sorrow now. But I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice — and no one will take your joy from you.
43_16_23: In that day you will ask Me nothing. Truly, truly, I tell you — whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
43_16_24: Until now you have asked for nothing in My name. Ask, and you will receive — so that your joy may be made full.
43_16_25: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
43_16_26: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying to you that I will ask the Father on your behalf —
43_16_27: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me, and have believed that I came from God.
43_16_28: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father.
43_16_29: His disciples said, "Look — now You are speaking plainly, not in a figure of speech!
43_16_30: Now we know that You know all things, and do not need anyone to question You. By this we believe that You came from God."
43_16_31: Jesus answered them, "Do you now believe?
43_16_32: Look — an hour is coming, and has already come, when you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave Me alone. Yet I am not alone — for the Father is with Me.
43_16_33: I have spoken these things to you so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have trouble. But take heart — I have overcome the world."
43_17_1: When Jesus had said these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said: "Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, so that the Son may glorify You —
43_17_2: just as You gave Him authority over all flesh, so that He may give eternal life to all whom You have given Him.
43_17_3: And this is eternal life — that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
43_17_4: I have glorified You on the earth, having finished the work You gave Me to do.
43_17_5: And now, Father, glorify Me at Your own side — with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
43_17_6: I have revealed Your name to the ones You gave Me out of the world. They were Yours, and You gave them to Me — and they have kept Your word.
43_17_7: Now they know that everything You have given Me is from You.
43_17_8: For the words You gave Me I have given to them. They received them, and truly understood that I came from You — and they believed that You sent Me.
43_17_9: I am praying for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those You have given Me — because they are Yours.
43_17_10: Everything that is Mine is Yours, and Yours is Mine — and I have been glorified in them.
43_17_11: I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, keep them in Your name — the name You gave Me — so that they may be one, as We are one.
43_17_12: While I was with them, I kept them in Your name — the name You gave Me. I guarded them, and not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction — so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
43_17_13: But now I am coming to You — and I speak these things while still in the world, so that they may have My joy made full in themselves.
43_17_14: I have given them Your word, and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world — just as I am not of the world.
43_17_15: I do not ask You to take them out of the world, but that You would keep them from the evil one.
43_17_16: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
43_17_17: Sanctify them in the truth. Your word is truth.
43_17_18: Just as You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
43_17_19: And for their sake I sanctify Myself — so that they also may be sanctified in truth.
43_17_20: I do not pray for these only, but also for those who will believe in Me through their word —
43_17_21: that they all may be one, just as You, Father, are in Me, and I in You. May they also be in Us — so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
43_17_22: And the glory You have given Me, I have given to them — so that they may be one, just as We are one:
43_17_23: I in them, and You in Me — so that they may be perfected into one, and that the world may know that You sent Me, and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
43_17_24: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am — so that they may see My glory, the glory You have given Me, because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
43_17_25: Righteous Father, the world has not known You, but I have known You. And these have come to know that You sent Me.
43_17_26: I made Your name known to them, and will continue to make it known — so that the love with which You loved Me may be in them, and I in them."
43_18_1: Having said these things, Jesus went out with His disciples across the brook Kidron, where there was a garden — and He and His disciples went into it.
43_18_2: Now Judas, who was betraying Him, also knew the place — because Jesus often met there with His disciples.
43_18_3: So Judas, having obtained a cohort of soldiers and some officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
43_18_4: Jesus, knowing everything that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and said to them, "Whom are you looking for?"
43_18_5: They answered Him, "Jesus the Nazarene." He said to them, "I am He." (Judas, who was betraying Him, was standing with them.)
43_18_6: When He said to them, "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground.
43_18_7: So He asked them again, "Whom are you looking for?" And they said, "Jesus the Nazarene."
43_18_8: Jesus answered, "I told you that I am He. So if you are looking for Me, let these men go."
43_18_9: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: 'Of those You gave Me, I have not lost one.'
43_18_10: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
43_18_11: So Jesus said to Peter, "Put the sword back into its sheath. Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?"
43_18_12: So the cohort, the commander, and the officers of the Jewish leaders arrested Jesus and bound Him.
43_18_13: They led Him first to Annas, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
43_18_14: It was Caiaphas who had advised the Jewish leaders that it was better that one man should die for the people.
43_18_15: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. That disciple was known to the high priest, and entered with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
43_18_16: But Peter stood outside at the door. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
43_18_17: The servant girl at the door said to Peter, "You are not one of this Man's disciples, are you?" He said, "I am not."
43_18_18: Now the servants and the officers had made a charcoal fire because it was cold — and they were standing and warming themselves. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.
43_18_19: The high priest then questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
43_18_20: Jesus answered him, "I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in a synagogue and in the temple, where all the Jews come together — and I said nothing in secret.
43_18_21: Why do you question Me? Question those who heard what I said to them. They know what I said."
43_18_22: When He had said this, one of the officers standing nearby struck Jesus with his hand, saying, "Is that how You answer the high priest?"
43_18_23: Jesus answered him, "If I have spoken wrongly, testify to the wrong. But if rightly, why do you strike Me?"
43_18_24: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
43_18_25: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. So they said to him, "You are not one of His disciples, are you?" He denied it and said, "I am not."
43_18_26: One of the high priest's servants — a relative of the one whose ear Peter had cut off — said, "Did I not see you in the garden with Him?"
43_18_27: Peter again denied it — and at once a rooster crowed.
43_18_28: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor's headquarters. It was early morning. They themselves did not go into the headquarters, so that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover.
43_18_29: So Pilate went out to them and said, "What accusation do you bring against this Man?"
43_18_30: They answered him, "If He were not a criminal, we would not have handed Him over to you."
43_18_31: Pilate said to them, "Take Him yourselves and judge Him by your own law." The Jewish leaders said to him, "We are not permitted to put anyone to death."
43_18_32: This was so that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which He had spoken to show by what kind of death He was about to die.
43_18_33: So Pilate went back into the headquarters, called Jesus, and said to Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?"
43_18_34: Jesus answered, "Are you saying this on your own — or have others told you about Me?"
43_18_35: Pilate answered, "Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered You to me. What have You done?"
43_18_36: Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would have been fighting, so that I would not be handed over to the Jewish leaders. But as it is, My kingdom is not from here."
43_18_37: So Pilate said to Him, "So You are a king?" Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. For this reason I was born, and for this reason I came into the world — to testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to My voice."
43_18_38: Pilate said to Him, "What is truth?" And having said this, he went out again to the Jewish leaders and said to them, "I find no guilt in Him.
43_18_39: But it is your custom that I release one prisoner to you at the Passover. So do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
43_18_40: They cried out again, "Not this Man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.
43_19_1: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
43_19_2: The soldiers wove a crown out of thorns and placed it on His head — and they dressed Him in a purple robe.
43_19_3: And they kept coming up to Him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!" And they struck Him with their hands.
43_19_4: Pilate went out again and said to them, "Look — I am bringing Him out to you, so that you may know I find no guilt in Him."
43_19_5: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, "Here is the Man!"
43_19_6: When the chief priests and the officers saw Him, they cried out, "Crucify Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Take Him yourselves and crucify Him — for I find no guilt in Him."
43_19_7: The Jewish leaders answered him, "We have a law, and by that law He ought to die — because He made Himself out to be the Son of God."
43_19_8: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
43_19_9: and he went back into the headquarters and said to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus did not answer him.
43_19_10: So Pilate said to Him, "You will not speak to me? Do You not know that I have the authority to release You, and I have the authority to crucify You?"
43_19_11: Jesus answered him, "You would have no authority over Me at all, unless it had been given to you from above. For this reason, the one who handed Me over to you has the greater sin."
43_19_12: From then on, Pilate sought to release Him. But the Jewish leaders kept crying out, "If you release this Man, you are not a friend of Caesar. Anyone who makes himself out to be a king opposes Caesar."
43_19_13: So when Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Stone Pavement — in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
43_19_14: Now it was the day of preparation of the Passover. It was about the sixth hour. And he said to the Jewish leaders, "Here is your King!"
43_19_15: They cried out, "Take Him away! Take Him away! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar."
43_19_16: Then he handed Him over to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus.
43_19_17: And He, carrying His own cross, went out to the place called The Place of a Skull — in Hebrew, Golgotha —
43_19_18: where they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on either side, with Jesus in the middle.
43_19_19: Pilate also wrote an inscription and put it on the cross. It read: "JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS."
43_19_20: Many of the Jews read this inscription, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city. And it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
43_19_21: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write, 'The King of the Jews,' but rather, 'This Man said, I am King of the Jews.'"
43_19_22: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
43_19_23: The soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His outer garments and divided them into four parts — a part for each soldier — and also the tunic. Now the tunic was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
43_19_24: So they said to one another, "Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it shall be" — so that the Scripture might be fulfilled: 'They divided My garments among them, and for My clothing they cast lots.' So the soldiers did these things.
43_19_25: Standing by the cross of Jesus were His mother, His mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
43_19_26: When Jesus saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing beside her, He said to His mother, "Woman, behold your son!"
43_19_27: Then He said to the disciple, "Behold your mother!" And from that hour, the disciple took her into his own home.
43_19_28: After this, Jesus — knowing that all was now finished, and to fulfill the Scripture — said, "I thirst."
43_19_29: A jar of sour wine was standing there, so they put a sponge full of the sour wine on a hyssop branch and held it to His mouth.
43_19_30: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished." And bowing His head, He gave up His spirit.
43_19_31: Since it was the day of preparation, and so that the bodies would not remain on the cross on the Sabbath — for that Sabbath was a high day — the Jewish leaders asked Pilate that their legs be broken, and that they be taken away.
43_19_32: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who had been crucified with Him.
43_19_33: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
43_19_34: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear — and at once blood and water came out.
43_19_35: The one who saw it has testified — and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
43_19_36: For these things took place to fulfill the Scripture: 'Not one of His bones shall be broken.'
43_19_37: And again, another Scripture says: 'They will look on the One they have pierced.'
43_19_38: After this, Joseph of Arimathea — a disciple of Jesus, but secretly, for fear of the Jewish leaders — asked Pilate for permission to take away the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and took away His body.
43_19_39: Nicodemus also — the one who had first come to Him by night — came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds in weight.
43_19_40: So they took the body of Jesus and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the burial custom of the Jews.
43_19_41: Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb — in which no one had yet been laid.
43_19_42: So because it was the Jewish day of preparation, and the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
43_20_1: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and she saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
43_20_2: So she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him!"
43_20_3: So Peter and the other disciple went out and were going toward the tomb.
43_20_4: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and arrived at the tomb first.
43_20_5: And stooping down, he saw the linen cloths lying there — but he did not go in.
43_20_6: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there,
43_20_7: and the face cloth that had been on Jesus' head — not lying with the linen cloths, but folded up in a place by itself.
43_20_8: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. He saw — and he believed.
43_20_9: For as yet they did not know the Scripture — that He must rise from the dead.
43_20_10: Then the disciples went back to their homes.
43_20_11: But Mary stood outside at the tomb, weeping. And as she wept, she stooped down to look into the tomb,
43_20_12: and she saw two angels in white — seated, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had been lying.
43_20_13: They said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "They have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."
43_20_14: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there — but she did not know it was Jesus.
43_20_15: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you looking for?" Thinking He was the gardener, she said to Him, "Sir, if you have carried Him away, tell me where you have laid Him — and I will take Him away."
43_20_16: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, "Rabboni!" — which means 'Teacher.'
43_20_17: Jesus said to her, "Do not cling to Me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go to My brothers and tell them, 'I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.'"
43_20_18: Mary Magdalene came and announced to the disciples, "I have seen the Lord!" — and that He had said these things to her.
43_20_19: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the doors were locked where the disciples were, for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them. And He said to them, "Peace be with you."
43_20_20: Having said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
43_20_21: So Jesus said to them again, "Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, I also send you."
43_20_22: And having said this, He breathed on them and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
43_20_23: If you forgive the sins of any, their sins are forgiven them. If you withhold forgiveness from any, it is withheld."
43_20_24: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called the Twin, was not with them when Jesus came.
43_20_25: So the other disciples were saying to him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see in His hands the mark of the nails, and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into His side — I will never believe."
43_20_26: Eight days later, His disciples were again inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, though the doors were locked, and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you."
43_20_27: Then He said to Thomas, "Put your finger here, and see My hands. Reach your hand out and put it into My side. And do not be unbelieving — but believing."
43_20_28: Thomas answered and said to Him, "My Lord and my God!"
43_20_29: Jesus said to him, "Because you have seen Me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen — and yet have believed."
43_20_30: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
43_20_31: But these have been written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God — and so that by believing, you may have life in His name.
43_21_1: After these things, Jesus revealed Himself again to the disciples by the Sea of Tiberias — and He revealed Himself in this way.
43_21_2: Simon Peter, Thomas (called the Twin), Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.
43_21_3: Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They said to him, "We are going with you." So they went out and got into the boat — but that night they caught nothing.
43_21_4: Just as day was breaking, Jesus stood on the shore — but the disciples did not know it was Jesus.
43_21_5: So Jesus said to them, "Children, do you have any fish?" They answered Him, "No."
43_21_6: He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." So they cast it — and now they were not able to haul it in, because of the quantity of fish.
43_21_7: That disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he pulled his outer garment around him — for he was stripped for work — and threw himself into the sea.
43_21_8: The other disciples came in the little boat, dragging the net full of fish — for they were not far from the land, only about a hundred yards off.
43_21_9: When they got out on the land, they saw a charcoal fire laid there, with fish on it, and bread.
43_21_10: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish you just caught."
43_21_11: So Simon Peter went aboard and hauled the net to land — full of large fish, a hundred and fifty-three of them. And though there were so many, the net was not torn.
43_21_12: Jesus said to them, "Come, have breakfast." Now none of the disciples dared to ask Him, "Who are You?" — because they knew it was the Lord.
43_21_13: Jesus came, took the bread, and gave it to them. And He did the same with the fish.
43_21_14: This was now the third time Jesus was revealed to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
43_21_15: When they had finished breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me more than these?" Peter said to Him, "Yes, Lord — You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Feed My lambs."
43_21_16: He said to him again, a second time, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me?" Peter said to Him, "Yes, Lord — You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Take care of My sheep."
43_21_17: He said to him a third time, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me?" Peter was grieved because He had said to him the third time, "Do you love Me?" And he said to Him, "Lord, You know all things — You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Feed My sheep.
43_21_18: Truly, truly, I tell you — when you were young, you used to dress yourself and walk wherever you wanted. But when you grow old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you do not want to go.
43_21_19: He said this to show by what kind of death Peter would glorify God. And after saying this, He said to him, "Follow Me."
43_21_20: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them — the one who had also leaned back against Jesus at the supper and said, "Lord, who is the one who is going to betray You?"
43_21_21: When Peter saw him, he said to Jesus, "Lord, what about this man?"
43_21_22: Jesus said to him, "If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow Me."
43_21_23: So the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple was not going to die. Yet Jesus did not tell him that he was not going to die — but, "If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you?"
43_21_24: This is the disciple who is bearing witness to these things, and has written these things. And we know that his testimony is true.
43_21_25: There are also many other things that Jesus did. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that would be written.
44_1_1: The first account I composed, Theophilus, about all that Jesus began to do and teach,
44_1_2: until the day when He was taken up — after He had given orders by the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom He had chosen.
44_1_3: To these He also presented Himself alive, after His suffering, by many convincing proofs — appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking of the things concerning the kingdom of God.
44_1_4: And gathering them together, He commanded them not to leave Jerusalem — but to wait for what the Father had promised, "Which," He said, "you heard of from Me.
44_1_5: For John baptized with water — but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now."
44_1_6: So when they had come together, they were asking Him, saying, "Lord, is it at this time You are restoring the kingdom to Israel?"
44_1_7: He said to them, "It is not for you to know times or epochs which the Father has fixed by His own authority.
44_1_8: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you — and you shall be My witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and even to the remotest part of the earth."
44_1_9: And after He had said these things, He was lifted up while they were looking on — and a cloud received Him out of their sight.
44_1_10: And as they were gazing intently into the sky while He was going, behold — two men in white clothing stood beside them.
44_1_11: Who said, "Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who has been taken up from you into heaven, will come in just the same way as you have watched Him go into heaven."
44_1_12: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet — which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.
44_1_13: And when they had entered the city, they went up to the upper room where they were staying — Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
44_1_14: These all with one mind were continually devoting themselves to prayer — along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
44_1_15: At this time Peter stood up in the midst of the brothers (a gathering of about one hundred and twenty persons was there together) and said,
44_1_16: "Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled — which the Holy Spirit foretold by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus.
44_1_17: For he was counted among us, and received his share in this ministry."
44_1_18: (Now this man acquired a field with the price of his wickedness — and falling headlong, he burst open in the middle, and all his intestines gushed out.
44_1_19: And it became known to all who were living in Jerusalem — so that in their own language, that field was called Hakeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
44_1_20: "For it is written in the book of Psalms: 'Let his homestead be made desolate, and let no one dwell in it.' And, 'Let another man take his office.'
44_1_21: Therefore, it is necessary that of the men who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us —
44_1_22: beginning with the baptism of John until the day that He was taken up from us — one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection."
44_1_23: And so they put forward two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (who was also called Justus), and Matthias.
44_1_24: And they prayed and said, "You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men — show us which one of these two You have chosen,
44_1_25: to occupy this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas turned aside to go to his own place."
44_1_26: And they drew lots for them — and the lot fell to Matthias. And he was added to the eleven apostles.
44_2_1: And when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all together in one place.
44_2_2: And suddenly there came from heaven a noise like a violent rushing wind — and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
44_2_3: And there appeared to them tongues as of fire, distributing themselves — and they rested on each one of them.
44_2_4: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues — as the Spirit was giving them utterance.
44_2_5: Now there were Jews living in Jerusalem — devout men from every nation under heaven.
44_2_6: And when this sound occurred, the crowd came together — and were bewildered, because each one of them was hearing them speak in his own language.
44_2_7: And they were amazed and astonished, saying, "Why, are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
44_2_8: And how is it that we each hear them in our own language to which we were born?
44_2_9: Parthians and Medes and Elamites — and residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
44_2_10: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the districts of Libya around Cyrene, and visitors from Rome — both Jews and proselytes,
44_2_11: Cretans and Arabs — we hear them in our own tongues speaking of the mighty deeds of God."
44_2_12: And they all continued in amazement and great perplexity, saying to one another, "What does this mean?"
44_2_13: But others were mocking and saying, "They are full of sweet wine."
44_2_14: But Peter, taking his stand with the eleven, raised his voice and declared to them: "Men of Judea, and all you who live in Jerusalem — let this be known to you, and give heed to my words.
44_2_15: For these men are not drunk, as you suppose — for it is only the third hour of the day.
44_2_16: But this is what was spoken of through the prophet Joel:
44_2_17: 'And it shall be in the last days, God says, that I will pour forth of My Spirit upon all mankind. And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy. And your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams.
44_2_18: Even on My bondservants, both men and women, I will in those days pour forth of My Spirit, and they shall prophesy.
44_2_19: And I will grant wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth below — blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
44_2_20: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord shall come.
44_2_21: And it shall be that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'
44_2_22: Men of Israel, listen to these words: Jesus the Nazarene, a man attested to you by God with miracles and wonders and signs which God performed through Him in your midst — just as you yourselves know.
44_2_23: This Man, delivered over by the predetermined plan and foreknowledge of God, you nailed to a cross by the hands of godless men, and put Him to death.
44_2_24: But God raised Him up again — putting an end to the agony of death, since it was impossible for Him to be held in its power.
44_2_25: For David says of Him: 'I saw the Lord always in My presence — for He is at My right hand, so that I will not be shaken.
44_2_26: Therefore My heart was glad and My tongue exulted; moreover My flesh also will live in hope —
44_2_27: because You will not abandon My soul to Hades, nor allow Your Holy One to undergo decay.
44_2_28: You have made known to Me the ways of life. You will make Me full of gladness with Your presence.'
44_2_29: Brothers, I may confidently say to you regarding the patriarch David — that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
44_2_30: And so, because he was a prophet, and knew that God had sworn to him with an oath to seat one of his descendants on his throne —
44_2_31: he looked ahead and spoke of the resurrection of the Christ, that He was neither abandoned to Hades, nor did His flesh suffer decay.
44_2_32: This Jesus, God raised up again — to which we are all witnesses.
44_2_33: Therefore, having been exalted to the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit — He has poured forth this which you both see and hear.
44_2_34: For it was not David who ascended into heaven — but he himself says: 'The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at My right hand,
44_2_35: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.'
44_2_36: Therefore let all the house of Israel know for certain that God has made Him both Lord and Christ — this Jesus whom you crucified."
44_2_37: Now when they heard this, they were pierced to the heart — and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"
44_2_38: Peter said to them, "Repent, and let each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
44_2_39: For the promise is for you, and your children, and for all who are far off — as many as the Lord our God will call to Himself."
44_2_40: And with many other words he solemnly testified, and kept on exhorting them, saying, "Be saved from this perverse generation!"
44_2_41: So then, those who had received his word were baptized — and that day there were added about three thousand souls.
44_2_42: They were continually devoting themselves to the apostles' teaching, and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread, and to prayer.
44_2_43: Everyone kept feeling a sense of awe — and many wonders and signs were taking place through the apostles.
44_2_44: And all those who had believed were together — and had all things in common.
44_2_45: And they began selling their property and possessions, and were sharing them with all — as anyone might have need.
44_2_46: Day by day continuing with one mind in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house — they were taking their meals together with gladness and sincerity of heart.
44_2_47: Praising God, and having favor with all the people. And the Lord was adding to their number day by day those who were being saved.
44_3_1: Now Peter and John were going up to the temple at the ninth hour, the hour of prayer.
44_3_2: And a man who had been lame from his mother's womb was being carried along — whom they used to set down every day at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, in order to beg alms of those who were entering the temple.
44_3_3: When he saw Peter and John about to go into the temple, he began asking to receive alms.
44_3_4: But Peter, along with John, fixed his gaze on him and said, "Look at us!"
44_3_5: And he began to give them his attention — expecting to receive something from them.
44_3_6: But Peter said, "I do not possess silver and gold — but what I do have I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene — walk!"
44_3_7: And seizing him by the right hand, he raised him up. And immediately his feet and his ankles were strengthened.
44_3_8: And with a leap he stood upright, and began to walk. And he entered the temple with them — walking and leaping and praising God.
44_3_9: And all the people saw him walking and praising God.
44_3_10: And they were taking note of him as being the one who used to sit at the Beautiful Gate of the temple to beg alms — and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
44_3_11: While he was clinging to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them at the so-called portico of Solomon — full of amazement.
44_3_12: But when Peter saw this, he replied to the people: "Men of Israel, why are you amazed at this — or why do you gaze at us, as if by our own power or piety we had made him walk?
44_3_13: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus — the One whom you delivered up, and disowned in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to release Him.
44_3_14: But you disowned the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you.
44_3_15: But you put to death the Author of life — whom God raised from the dead, a fact to which we are witnesses.
44_3_16: And on the basis of faith in His name, it is the name of Jesus which has strengthened this man whom you see and know. And the faith which comes through Him has given him this perfect health in the presence of you all.
44_3_17: And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance — just as your rulers did also.
44_3_18: But the things which God announced beforehand by the mouth of all the prophets — that His Christ would suffer — He has thus fulfilled.
44_3_19: Therefore repent and return — so that your sins may be wiped away, in order that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord.
44_3_20: And that He may send Jesus, the Christ appointed for you,
44_3_21: whom heaven must receive until the period of restoration of all things — about which God spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from ancient time.
44_3_22: Moses said: 'The Lord God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your brothers. To Him you shall give heed in everything He says to you.
44_3_23: And it will be that every soul that does not heed that prophet shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.'
44_3_24: And likewise, all the prophets who have spoken — from Samuel and his successors onward — also announced these days.
44_3_25: It is you who are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant which God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham: 'And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.'
44_3_26: For you first, God raised up His Servant — and sent Him to bless you, by turning every one of you from your wicked ways."
44_4_1: As they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple guard, and the Sadducees, came up to them —
44_4_2: being greatly disturbed because they were teaching the people, and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
44_4_3: And they laid hands on them, and put them in jail until the next day — for it was already evening.
44_4_4: But many of those who had heard the message believed — and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
44_4_5: On the next day, their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
44_4_6: And Annas the high priest was there, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and all who were of high priestly descent.
44_4_7: And when they had placed them in the center, they began to inquire: "By what power, or in what name, have you done this?"
44_4_8: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: "Rulers and elders of the people —
44_4_9: if we are on trial today for a benefit done to a sick man, as to how this man has been made well —
44_4_10: let it be known to all of you, and to all the people of Israel: that by the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead — by this name this man stands here before you in good health.
44_4_11: He is the stone which was rejected by you, the builders — but which became the chief cornerstone.
44_4_12: And there is salvation in no one else — for there is no other name under heaven that has been given among men by which we must be saved."
44_4_13: Now as they observed the confidence of Peter and John, and understood that they were uneducated and untrained men, they were amazed — and began to recognize them as having been with Jesus.
44_4_14: And seeing the man who had been healed standing with them, they had nothing to say in reply.
44_4_15: But when they had ordered them to leave the Council, they began to confer with one another,
44_4_16: saying, "What shall we do with these men? For the fact that a noteworthy miracle has taken place through them is apparent to all who live in Jerusalem — and we cannot deny it.
44_4_17: But so that it will not spread any further among the people, let us warn them to speak no longer to any man in this name."
44_4_18: And when they had summoned them, they commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
