25_2_6: He has done violence to His tabernacle, As if it were a garden; He has destroyed His place of assembly; The LORD has caused The appointed feasts and Sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion. In His burning indignation He has spurned the king and the priest.
25_2_7: The Lord has spurned His altar, He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has given up the walls of her palaces Into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in the house of the LORD As on the day of a set feast.
25_2_8: The LORD has purposed to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out a line; He has not withdrawn His hand from destroying; Therefore He has caused the rampart and wall to lament; They languished together.
25_2_9: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations; The Law is no more, And her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
25_2_10: The elders of the daughter of Zion Sit on the ground and keep silence; They throw dust on their heads And gird themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem Bow their heads to the ground.
25_2_11: My eyes fail with tears, My heart is troubled; My bile is poured on the ground Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the children and the infants Faint in the streets of the city.
25_2_12: They say to their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” As they swoon like the wounded In the streets of the city, As their life is poured out In their mothers’ bosom.
25_2_13: How shall I console you? To what shall I liken you, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare with you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? For your ruin is spread wide as the sea; Who can heal you?
25_2_14: Your prophets have seen for you False and deceptive visions; They have not uncovered your iniquity, To bring back your captives, But have envisioned for you false prophecies and delusions.
25_2_15: All who pass by clap their hands at you; They hiss and shake their heads At the daughter of Jerusalem: “ Is this the city that is called ‘The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth’?”
25_2_16: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you; They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up! Surely this is the day we have waited for; We have found it, we have seen it! ”
25_2_17: The LORD has done what He purposed; He has fulfilled His word Which He commanded in days of old. He has thrown down and has not pitied, And He has caused an enemy to rejoice over you; He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
25_2_18: Their heart cried out to the Lord, “O wall of the daughter of Zion, Let tears run down like a river day and night; Give yourself no relief; Give your eyes no rest.
25_2_19: “Arise, cry out in the night, At the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift your hands toward Him For the life of your young children, Who faint from hunger at the head of every street.”
25_2_20: “See, O LORD, and consider! To whom have You done this? Should the women eat their offspring, The children they have cuddled? Should the priest and prophet be slain In the sanctuary of the Lord?
25_2_21: “Young and old lie On the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men Have fallen by the sword; You have slain them in the day of Your anger, You have slaughtered and not pitied.
25_2_22: “You have invited as to a feast day The terrors that surround me. In the day of the LORD’s anger There was no refugee or survivor. Those whom I have borne and brought up My enemies have destroyed.”
25_3_1: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.
25_3_2: He has led me and made me walk In darkness and not in light.
25_3_3: Surely He has turned His hand against me Time and time again throughout the day.
25_3_4: He has aged my flesh and my skin, And broken my bones.
25_3_5: He has besieged me And surrounded me with bitterness and woe.
25_3_6: He has set me in dark places Like the dead of long ago.
25_3_7: He has hedged me in so that I cannot get out; He has made my chain heavy.
25_3_8: Even when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.
25_3_9: He has blocked my ways with hewn stone; He has made my paths crooked.
25_3_10: He has been to me a bear lying in wait, Like a lion in ambush.
25_3_11: He has turned aside my ways and torn me in pieces; He has made me desolate.
25_3_12: He has bent His bow And set me up as a target for the arrow.
25_3_13: He has caused the arrows of His quiver To pierce my loins.
25_3_14: I have become the ridicule of all my people— Their taunting song all the day.
25_3_15: He has filled me with bitterness, He has made me drink wormwood.
25_3_16: He has also broken my teeth with gravel, And covered me with ashes.
25_3_17: You have moved my soul far from peace; I have forgotten prosperity.
25_3_18: And I said, “My strength and my hope Have perished from the LORD.”
25_3_19: Remember my affliction and roaming, The wormwood and the gall.
25_3_20: My soul still remembers And sinks within me.
25_3_21: This I recall to my mind, Therefore I have hope.
25_3_22: Through the LORD’s mercies we are not consumed, Because His compassions fail not.
25_3_23: They are new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
25_3_24: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “Therefore I hope in Him!”
25_3_25: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, To the soul who seeks Him.
25_3_26: It is good that one should hope and wait quietly For the salvation of the LORD.
25_3_27: It is good for a man to bear The yoke in his youth.
25_3_28: Let him sit alone and keep silent, Because God has laid it on him
25_3_29: Let him put his mouth in the dust— There may yet be hope.
25_3_30: Let him give his cheek to the one who strikes him, And be full of reproach.
25_3_31: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
25_3_32: Though He causes grief, Yet He will show compassion According to the multitude of His mercies.
25_3_33: For He does not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men.
25_3_34: To crush under one’s feet All the prisoners of the earth
25_3_35: To turn aside the justice due a man Before the face of the Most High
25_3_36: Or subvert a man in his cause— The Lord does not approve.
25_3_37: Who is he who speaks and it comes to pass, When the Lord has not commanded it?
25_3_38: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High That woe and well-being proceed?
25_3_39: Why should a living man complain, A man for the punishment of his sins?
25_3_40: Let us search out and examine our ways, And turn back to the LORD
25_3_41: Let us lift our hearts and hands To God in heaven.
25_3_42: We have transgressed and rebelled; You have not pardoned.
25_3_43: You have covered Yourself with anger And pursued us; You have slain and not pitied.
25_3_44: You have covered Yourself with a cloud, That prayer should not pass through.
25_3_45: You have made us an offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.
25_3_46: All our enemies Have opened their mouths against us.
25_3_47: Fear and a snare have come upon us, Desolation and destruction.
25_3_48: My eyes overflow with rivers of water For the destruction of the daughter of my people.
25_3_49: My eyes flow and do not cease, Without interruption
25_3_50: Till the LORD from heaven Looks down and sees.
25_3_51: My eyes bring suffering to my soul Because of all the daughters of my city.
25_3_52: My enemies without cause Hunted me down like a bird.
25_3_53: They silenced my life in the pit And threw stones at me.
25_3_54: The waters flowed over my head; I said, “I am cut off!”
25_3_55: I called on Your name, O LORD, From the lowest pit.
25_3_56: You have heard my voice: “Do not hide Your ear From my sighing, from my cry for help.”
25_3_57: You drew near on the day I called on You, And said, “Do not fear!”
25_3_58: O Lord, You have pleaded the case for my soul; You have redeemed my life.
25_3_59: O LORD, You have seen how I am wronged; Judge my case.
25_3_60: You have seen all their vengeance, All their schemes against me.
25_3_61: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, All their schemes against me
25_3_62: The lips of my enemies And their whispering against me all the day.
25_3_63: Look at their sitting down and their rising up; I am their taunting song.
25_3_64: Repay them, O LORD, According to the work of their hands.
25_3_65: Give them a veiled heart; Your curse be upon them!
25_3_66: In Your anger, Pursue and destroy them From under the heavens of the LORD.
25_4_1: How the gold has become dim! How changed the fine gold! The stones of the sanctuary are scattered At the head of every street.
25_4_2: The precious sons of Zion, Valuable as fine gold, How they are regarded as clay pots, The work of the hands of the potter!
25_4_3: Even the jackals present their breasts To nurse their young; But the daughter of my people is cruel, Like ostriches in the wilderness.
25_4_4: The tongue of the infant clings To the roof of its mouth for thirst; The young children ask for bread, But no one breaks it for them.
25_4_5: Those who ate delicacies Are desolate in the streets; Those who were brought up in scarlet Embrace ash heaps.
25_4_6: The punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people Is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, Which was overthrown in a moment, With no hand to help her!
25_4_7: Her Nazirites were brighter than snow And whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, Like sapphire in their appearance.
25_4_8: Now their appearance is blacker than soot; They go unrecognized in the streets; Their skin clings to their bones, It has become as dry as wood.
25_4_9: Those slain by the sword are better off Than those who die of hunger; For these pine away, Stricken for lack of the fruits of the field.
25_4_10: The hands of the compassionate women Have cooked their own children; They became food for them In the destruction of the daughter of my people.
25_4_11: The LORD has fulfilled His fury, He has poured out His fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion, And it has devoured its foundations.
25_4_12: The kings of the earth, And all inhabitants of the world, Would not have believed That the adversary and the enemy Could enter the gates of Jerusalem—
25_4_13: Because of the sins of her prophets And the iniquities of her priests, Who shed in her midst The blood of the just.
25_4_14: They wandered blind in the streets; They have defiled themselves with blood, So that no one would touch their garments.
25_4_15: They cried out to them, “Go away, unclean! Go away, go away, Do not touch us!” When they fled and wandered, Those among the nations said, “They shall no longer dwell here. ”
25_4_16: The face of the LORD scattered them; He no longer regards them. The people do not respect the priests Nor show favor to the elders.
25_4_17: Still our eyes failed us, Watching vainly for our help; In our watching we watched For a nation that could not save us.
25_4_18: They tracked our steps So that we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near; Our days were over, For our end had come.
25_4_19: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the heavens. They pursued us on the mountains And lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
25_4_20: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, Was caught in their pits, Of whom we said, “Under his shadow We shall live among the nations.”
25_4_21: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, You who dwell in the land of Uz! The cup shall also pass over to you And you shall become drunk and make yourself naked.
25_4_22: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; He will no longer send you into captivity. He will punish your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; He will uncover your sins!
25_5_1: Remember, O LORD, what has come upon us; Look, and behold our reproach!
25_5_2: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, And our houses to foreigners.
25_5_3: We have become orphans and waifs, Our mothers are like widows.
25_5_4: We pay for the water we drink, And our wood comes at a price.
25_5_5: They pursue at our heels; We labor and have no rest.
25_5_6: We have given our hand to the Egyptians And the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
25_5_7: Our fathers sinned and are no more, But we bear their iniquities.
25_5_8: Servants rule over us; There is none to deliver us from their hand.
25_5_9: We get our bread at the risk of our lives, Because of the sword in the wilderness.
25_5_10: Our skin is hot as an oven, Because of the fever of famine.
25_5_11: They ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah.
25_5_12: Princes were hung up by their hands, And elders were not respected.
25_5_13: Young men ground at the millstones; Boys staggered under loads of wood.
25_5_14: The elders have ceased gathering at the gate, And the young men from their music.
25_5_15: The joy of our heart has ceased; Our dance has turned into mourning.
25_5_16: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
25_5_17: Because of this our heart is faint; Because of these things our eyes grow dim
25_5_18: Because of Mount Zion which is desolate, With foxes walking about on it.
25_5_19: You, O LORD, remain forever; Your throne from generation to generation.
25_5_20: Why do You forget us forever, And forsake us for so long a time?
25_5_21: Turn us back to You, O LORD, and we will be restored; Renew our days as of old
25_5_22: Unless You have utterly rejected us, And are very angry with us!
26_1_1: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the River Chebar, that the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
26_1_2: On the fifth day of the month, which was in the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity
26_1_3: the word of the LORD came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was upon him there.
26_1_4: Then I looked, and behold, a whirlwind was coming out of the north, a great cloud with raging fire engulfing itself; and brightness was all around it and radiating out of its midst like the color of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
26_1_5: Also from within it came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.
26_1_6: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.
26_1_7: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the soles of calves’ feet. They sparkled like the color of burnished bronze.
26_1_8: The hands of a man were under their wings on their four sides; and each of the four had faces and wings.
26_1_9: Their wings touched one another. The creatures did not turn when they went, but each one went straight forward.
26_1_10: As for the likeness of their faces, each had the face of a man; each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, each of the four had the face of an ox on the left side, and each of the four had the face of an eagle.
26_1_11: Thus were their faces. Their wings stretched upward; two wings of each one touched one another, and two covered their bodies.
26_1_12: And each one went straight forward; they went wherever the spirit wanted to go, and they did not turn when they went.
26_1_13: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches going back and forth among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and out of the fire went lightning.
26_1_14: And the living creatures ran back and forth, in appearance like a flash of lightning.
26_1_15: Now as I looked at the living creatures, behold, a wheel was on the earth beside each living creature with its four faces.
26_1_16: The appearance of the wheels and their workings was like the color of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. The appearance of their workings was, as it were, a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
26_1_17: When they moved, they went toward any one of four directions; they did not turn aside when they went.
26_1_18: As for their rims, they were so high they were awesome; and their rims were full of eyes, all around the four of them.
26_1_19: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
26_1_20: Wherever the spirit wanted to go, they went, because there the spirit went; and the wheels were lifted together with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
26_1_21: When those went, these went; when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up together with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
26_1_22: The likeness of the firmament above the heads of the living creatures was like the color of an awesome crystal, stretched out over their heads.
26_1_23: And under the firmament their wings spread out straight, one toward another. Each one had two which covered one side, and each one had two which covered the other side of the body.
26_1_24: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a tumult like the noise of an army; and when they stood still, they let down their wings.
26_1_25: A voice came from above the firmament that was over their heads; whenever they stood, they let down their wings.
26_1_26: And above the firmament over their heads was the likeness of a throne, in appearance like a sapphire stone; on the likeness of the throne was a likeness with the appearance of a man high above it.
26_1_27: Also from the appearance of His waist and upward I saw, as it were, the color of amber with the appearance of fire all around within it; and from the appearance of His waist and downward I saw, as it were, the appearance of fire with brightness all around.
26_1_28: Like the appearance of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day, so was the appearance of the brightness all around it. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. So when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of One speaking.
26_2_1: And He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.”
26_2_2: Then the Spirit entered me when He spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard Him who spoke to me.
26_2_3: And He said to me: “Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.
26_2_4: For they are impudent and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD.’
26_2_5: As for them, whether they hear or whether they refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that a prophet has been among them.
26_2_6: “And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them nor be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you and you dwell among scorpions; do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
26_2_7: You shall speak My words to them, whether they hear or whether they refuse, for they are rebellious.
26_2_8: But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
26_2_9: Now when I looked, there was a hand stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
26_2_10: Then He spread it before me; and there was writing on the inside and on the outside, and written on it were lamentations and mourning and woe.
26_3_1: Moreover He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
26_3_2: So I opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat that scroll.
26_3_3: And He said to me, “Son of man, feed your belly, and fill your stomach with this scroll that I give you.” So I ate, and it was in my mouth like honey in sweetness.
26_3_4: Then He said to me: “Son of man, go to the house of Israel and speak with My words to them.
26_3_5: For you are not sent to a people of unfamiliar speech and of hard language, but to the house of Israel
26_3_6: not to many people of unfamiliar speech and of hard language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
26_3_7: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, because they will not listen to Me; for all the house of Israel are impudent and hard-hearted.
26_3_8: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their foreheads.
26_3_9: Like adamant stone, harder than flint, I have made your forehead; do not be afraid of them, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”
26_3_10: Moreover He said to me: “Son of man, receive into your heart all My words that I speak to you, and hear with your ears.
26_3_11: And go, get to the captives, to the children of your people, and speak to them and tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD,’ whether they hear, or whether they refuse.”
26_3_12: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a great thunderous voice: “Blessed is the glory of the LORD from His place!”
26_3_13: I also heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, and a great thunderous noise.
26_3_14: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
26_3_15: Then I came to the captives at Tel Abib, who dwelt by the River Chebar; and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
26_3_16: Now it came to pass at the end of seven days that the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_3_17: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; therefore hear a word from My mouth, and give them warning from Me:
26_3_18: When I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at your hand.
26_3_19: Yet, if you warn the wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
26_3_20: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die; because you did not give him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require at your hand.
26_3_21: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man that the righteous should not sin, and he does not sin, he shall surely live because he took warning; also you will have delivered your soul.”
26_3_22: Then the hand of the LORD was upon me there, and He said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and there I shall talk with you.”
26_3_23: So I arose and went out into the plain, and behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, like the glory which I saw by the River Chebar; and I fell on my face.
26_3_24: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and spoke with me and said to me: “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
26_3_25: And you, O son of man, surely they will put ropes on you and bind you with them, so that you cannot go out among them.
26_3_26: I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be mute and not be one to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious house.
26_3_27: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.
26_4_1: “You also, son of man, take a clay tablet and lay it before you, and portray on it a city, Jerusalem.
26_4_2: Lay siege against it, build a siege wall against it, and heap up a mound against it; set camps against it also, and place battering rams against it all around.
26_4_3: Moreover take for yourself an iron plate, and set it as an iron wall between you and the city. Set your face against it, and it shall be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.
26_4_4: “Lie also on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it. According to the number of the days that you lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
26_4_5: For I have laid on you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days; so you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
26_4_6: And when you have completed them, lie again on your right side; then you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days. I have laid on you a day for each year.
26_4_7: “Therefore you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem; your arm shall be uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.
26_4_8: And surely I will restrain you so that you cannot turn from one side to another till you have ended the days of your siege.
26_4_9: “Also take for yourself wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them into one vessel, and make bread of them for yourself. During the number of days that you lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days, you shall eat it.
26_4_10: And your food which you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat it.
26_4_11: You shall also drink water by measure, one-sixth of a hin; from time to time you shall drink.
26_4_12: And you shall eat it as barley cakes; and bake it using fuel of human waste in their sight.”
26_4_13: Then the LORD said, “So shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, where I will drive them.”
26_4_14: So I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Indeed I have never defiled myself from my youth till now; I have never eaten what died of itself or was torn by beasts, nor has abominable flesh ever come into my mouth.”
26_4_15: Then He said to me, “See, I am giving you cow dung instead of human waste, and you shall prepare your bread over it.”
26_4_16: Moreover He said to me, “Son of man, surely I will cut off the supply of bread in Jerusalem; they shall eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and shall drink water by measure and with dread
26_4_17: that they may lack bread and water, and be dismayed with one another, and waste away because of their iniquity.
26_5_1: “And you, son of man, take a sharp sword, take it as a barber’s razor, and pass it over your head and your beard; then take scales to weigh and divide the hair .
26_5_2: You shall burn with fire one-third in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are finished; then you shall take one-third and strike around it with the sword, and one-third you shall scatter in the wind: I will draw out a sword after them.
26_5_3: You shall also take a small number of them and bind them in the edge of your garment.
26_5_4: Then take some of them again and throw them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From there a fire will go out into all the house of Israel.
26_5_5: “Thus says the Lord GOD: ‘This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations and the countries all around her.
26_5_6: She has rebelled against My judgments by doing wickedness more than the nations, and against My statutes more than the countries that are all around her; for they have refused My judgments, and they have not walked in My statutes.’
26_5_7: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: ‘Because you have multiplied disobedience more than the nations that are all around you, have not walked in My statutes nor kept My judgments, nor even done according to the judgments of the nations that are all around you’—
26_5_8: therefore thus says the Lord GOD: ‘Indeed I, even I, am against you and will execute judgments in your midst in the sight of the nations.
26_5_9: And I will do among you what I have never done, and the like of which I will never do again, because of all your abominations.
26_5_10: Therefore fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments among you, and all of you who remain I will scatter to all the winds.
26_5_11: ‘Therefore, as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you; My eye will not spare, nor will I have any pity.
26_5_12: One-third of you shall die of the pestilence, and be consumed with famine in your midst; and one-third shall fall by the sword all around you; and I will scatter another third to all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
26_5_13: ‘Thus shall My anger be spent, and I will cause My fury to rest upon them, and I will be avenged; and they shall know that I, the LORD, have spoken it in My zeal, when I have spent My fury upon them.
26_5_14: Moreover I will make you a waste and a reproach among the nations that are all around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
26_5_15: ‘So it shall be a reproach, a taunt, a lesson, and an astonishment to the nations that are all around you, when I execute judgments among you in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I, the LORD, have spoken.
26_5_16: When I send against them the terrible arrows of famine which shall be for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, I will increase the famine upon you and cut off your supply of bread.
26_5_17: So I will send against you famine and wild beasts, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood shall pass through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.’ ”
26_6_1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
26_6_2: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them
26_6_3: and say, ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! Thus says the Lord GOD to the mountains, to the hills, to the ravines, and to the valleys: “Indeed I, even I, will bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
26_6_4: Then your altars shall be desolate, your incense altars shall be broken, and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
26_6_5: And I will lay the corpses of the children of Israel before their idols, and I will scatter your bones all around your altars.
26_6_6: In all your dwelling places the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, your idols may be broken and made to cease, your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
26_6_7: The slain shall fall in your midst, and you shall know that I am the LORD.
26_6_8: “Yet I will leave a remnant, so that you may have some who escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.
26_6_9: Then those of you who escape will remember Me among the nations where they are carried captive, because I was crushed by their adulterous heart which has departed from Me, and by their eyes which play the harlot after their idols; they will loathe themselves for the evils which they committed in all their abominations.
26_6_10: And they shall know that I am the LORD; I have not said in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.”
26_6_11: ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Pound your fists and stamp your feet, and say, ‘Alas, for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! For they shall fall by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.
26_6_12: He who is far off shall die by the pestilence, he who is near shall fall by the sword, and he who remains and is besieged shall die by the famine. Thus will I spend My fury upon them.
26_6_13: Then you shall know that I am the LORD, when their slain are among their idols all around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, under every green tree, and under every thick oak, wherever they offered sweet incense to all their idols.
26_6_14: So I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land desolate, yes, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblah, in all their dwelling places. Then they shall know that I am the LORD.’ ” ’ ”
26_7_1: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_7_2: “And you, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD to the land of Israel: ‘An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
26_7_3: Now the end has come upon you, And I will send My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways, And I will repay you for all your abominations.
26_7_4: My eye will not spare you, Nor will I have pity; But I will repay your ways, And your abominations will be in your midst; Then you shall know that I am the LORD!’
26_7_5: “Thus says the Lord GOD: ‘A disaster, a singular disaster; Behold, it has come!
26_7_6: An end has come, The end has come; It has dawned for you; Behold, it has come!
26_7_7: Doom has come to you, you who dwell in the land; The time has come, A day of trouble is near, And not of rejoicing in the mountains.
26_7_8: Now upon you I will soon pour out My fury, And spend My anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, And I will repay you for all your abominations.
26_7_9: ‘My eye will not spare, Nor will I have pity; I will repay you according to your ways, And your abominations will be in your midst. Then you shall know that I am the LORD who strikes.
26_7_10: ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it has come! Doom has gone out; The rod has blossomed, Pride has budded.
26_7_11: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness; None of them shall remain, None of their multitude, None of them; Nor shall there be wailing for them.
26_7_12: The time has come, The day draws near. ‘Let not the buyer rejoice, Nor the seller mourn, For wrath is on their whole multitude.
26_7_13: For the seller shall not return to what has been sold, Though he may still be alive; For the vision concerns the whole multitude, And it shall not turn back; No one will strengthen himself Who lives in iniquity.
26_7_14: ‘They have blown the trumpet and made everyone ready, But no one goes to battle; For My wrath is on all their multitude.
26_7_15: The sword is outside, And the pestilence and famine within. Whoever is in the field Will die by the sword; And whoever is in the city, Famine and pestilence will devour him.
26_7_16: ‘Those who survive will escape and be on the mountains Like doves of the valleys, All of them mourning, Each for his iniquity.
26_7_17: Every hand will be feeble, And every knee will be as weak as water.
26_7_18: They will also be girded with sackcloth; Horror will cover them; Shame will be on every face, Baldness on all their heads.
26_7_19: ‘They will throw their silver into the streets, And their gold will be like refuse; Their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them In the day of the wrath of the LORD; They will not satisfy their souls, Nor fill their stomachs, Because it became their stumbling block of iniquity.
26_7_20: ‘As for the beauty of his ornaments, He set it in majesty; But they made from it The images of their abominations— Their detestable things; Therefore I have made it Like refuse to them.
26_7_21: I will give it as plunder Into the hands of strangers, And to the wicked of the earth as spoil; And they shall defile it.
26_7_22: I will turn My face from them, And they will defile My secret place; For robbers shall enter it and defile it.
26_7_23: ‘Make a chain, For the land is filled with crimes of blood, And the city is full of violence.
26_7_24: Therefore I will bring the worst of the Gentiles, And they will possess their houses; I will cause the pomp of the strong to cease, And their holy places shall be defiled.
26_7_25: Destruction comes; They will seek peace, but there shall be none.
26_7_26: Disaster will come upon disaster, And rumor will be upon rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet; But the law will perish from the priest, And counsel from the elders.
26_7_27: ‘The king will mourn, The prince will be clothed with desolation, And the hands of the common people will tremble. I will do to them according to their way, And according to what they deserve I will judge them; Then they shall know that I am the LORD!’ ”
26_8_1: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house with the elders of Judah sitting before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me there.
26_8_2: Then I looked, and there was a likeness, like the appearance of fire—from the appearance of His waist and downward, fire; and from His waist and upward, like the appearance of brightness, like the color of amber.
26_8_3: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my hair; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, and brought me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the north gate of the inner court, where the seat of the image of jealousy was, which provokes to jealousy.
26_8_4: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the vision that I saw in the plain.
26_8_5: Then He said to me, “Son of man, lift your eyes now toward the north.” So I lifted my eyes toward the north, and there, north of the altar gate, was this image of jealousy in the entrance.
26_8_6: Furthermore He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel commits here, to make Me go far away from My sanctuary? Now turn again, you will see greater abominations.”
26_8_7: So He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, there was a hole in the wall.
26_8_8: Then He said to me, “Son of man, dig into the wall”; and when I dug into the wall, there was a door.
26_8_9: And He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations which they are doing there.”
26_8_10: So I went in and saw, and there—every sort of creeping thing, abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed all around on the walls.
26_8_11: And there stood before them seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and in their midst stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan. Each man had a censer in his hand, and a thick cloud of incense went up.
26_8_12: Then He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the room of his idols? For they say, ‘The LORD does not see us, the LORD has forsaken the land.’ ”
26_8_13: And He said to me, “Turn again, and you will see greater abominations that they are doing.”
26_8_14: So He brought me to the door of the north gate of the LORD’s house; and to my dismay, women were sitting there weeping for Tammuz.
26_8_15: Then He said to me, “Have you seen this, O son of man? Turn again, you will see greater abominations than these.”
26_8_16: So He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and there, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east, and they were worshiping the sun toward the east.
26_8_17: And He said to me, “Have you seen this, O son of man? Is it a trivial thing to the house of Judah to commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence; then they have returned to provoke Me to anger. Indeed they put the branch to their nose.
26_8_18: Therefore I also will act in fury. My eye will not spare nor will I have pity; and though they cry in My ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them.”
26_9_1: Then He called out in my hearing with a loud voice, saying, “Let those who have charge over the city draw near, each with a deadly weapon in his hand.”
26_9_2: And suddenly six men came from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with his battle-ax in his hand. One man among them was clothed with linen and had a writer’s inkhorn at his side. They went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
26_9_3: Now the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the cherub, where it had been, to the threshold of the temple. And He called to the man clothed with linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn at his side
26_9_4: and the LORD said to him, “Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the men who sigh and cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
26_9_5: To the others He said in my hearing, “Go after him through the city and kill; do not let your eye spare, nor have any pity.
26_9_6: Utterly slay old and young men, maidens and little children and women; but do not come near anyone on whom is the mark; and begin at My sanctuary.” So they began with the elders who were before the temple.
26_9_7: Then He said to them, “Defile the temple, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” And they went out and killed in the city.
26_9_8: So it was, that while they were killing them, I was left alone; and I fell on my face and cried out, and said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Will You destroy all the remnant of Israel in pouring out Your fury on Jerusalem?”
26_9_9: Then He said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of bloodshed, and the city full of perversity; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD does not see!’
26_9_10: And as for Me also, My eye will neither spare, nor will I have pity, but I will recompense their deeds on their own head.”
26_9_11: Just then, the man clothed with linen, who had the inkhorn at his side, reported back and said, “I have done as You commanded me.”
26_10_1: And I looked, and there in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubim, there appeared something like a sapphire stone, having the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
26_10_2: Then He spoke to the man clothed with linen, and said, “Go in among the wheels, under the cherub, fill your hands with coals of fire from among the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” And he went in as I watched.
26_10_3: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.
26_10_4: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and paused over the threshold of the temple; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
26_10_5: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even in the outer court, like the voice of Almighty God when He speaks.
26_10_6: Then it happened, when He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside the wheels.
26_10_7: And the cherub stretched out his hand from among the cherubim to the fire that was among the cherubim, and took some of it and put it into the hands of the man clothed with linen, who took it and went out.
26_10_8: The cherubim appeared to have the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
26_10_9: And when I looked, there were four wheels by the cherubim, one wheel by one cherub and another wheel by each other cherub; the wheels appeared to have the color of a beryl stone.
26_10_10: As for their appearance, all four looked alike—as it were, a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
26_10_11: When they went, they went toward any of their four directions; they did not turn aside when they went, but followed in the direction the head was facing. They did not turn aside when they went.
26_10_12: And their whole body, with their back, their hands, their wings, and the wheels that the four had, were full of eyes all around.
26_10_13: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “Wheel.”
26_10_14: Each one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, the second face the face of a man, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
26_10_15: And the cherubim were lifted up. This was the living creature I saw by the River Chebar.
26_10_16: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also did not turn from beside them.
26_10_17: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels stood still, and when one was lifted up, the other lifted itself up, for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
26_10_18: Then the glory of the LORD departed from the threshold of the temple and stood over the cherubim.
26_10_19: And the cherubim lifted their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight. When they went out, the wheels were beside them; and they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
26_10_20: This is the living creature I saw under the God of Israel by the River Chebar, and I knew they were cherubim.
26_10_21: Each one had four faces and each one four wings, and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
26_10_22: And the likeness of their faces was the same as the faces which I had seen by the River Chebar, their appearance and their persons. They each went straight forward.
26_11_1: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the East Gate of the LORD’s house, which faces eastward; and there at the door of the gate were twenty-five men, among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
26_11_2: And He said to me: “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and give wicked counsel in this city
26_11_3: who say, ‘ The time is not near to build houses; this city is the caldron, and we are the meat.’
26_11_4: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man!”
26_11_5: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said to me, “Speak! ‘Thus says the LORD: “Thus you have said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
26_11_6: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”
26_11_7: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Your slain whom you have laid in its midst, they are the meat, and this city is the caldron; but I shall bring you out of the midst of it.
26_11_8: You have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you,” says the Lord GOD.
26_11_9: “And I will bring you out of its midst, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and execute judgments on you.
26_11_10: You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel. Then you shall know that I am the LORD.
26_11_11: This city shall not be your caldron, nor shall you be the meat in its midst. I will judge you at the border of Israel.
26_11_12: And you shall know that I am the LORD; for you have not walked in My statutes nor executed My judgments, but have done according to the customs of the Gentiles which are all around you.” ’ ”
26_11_13: Now it happened, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Will You make a complete end of the remnant of Israel?”
26_11_14: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_11_15: “Son of man, your brethren, your relatives, your countrymen, and all the house of Israel in its entirety, are those about whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Get far away from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.’
26_11_16: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Although I have cast them far off among the Gentiles, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet I shall be a little sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.” ’
26_11_17: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “I will gather you from the peoples, assemble you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.” ’
26_11_18: And they will go there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.
26_11_19: Then I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them, and take the stony heart out of their flesh, and give them a heart of flesh
26_11_20: that they may walk in My statutes and keep My judgments and do them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
26_11_21: But as for those whose hearts follow the desire for their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their deeds on their own heads,” says the Lord GOD.
26_11_22: So the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was high above them.
26_11_23: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain, which is on the east side of the city.
26_11_24: Then the Spirit took me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to those in captivity. And the vision that I had seen went up from me.
26_11_25: So I spoke to those in captivity of all the things the LORD had shown me.
26_12_1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
26_12_2: “Son of man, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, which has eyes to see but does not see, and ears to hear but does not hear; for they are a rebellious house.
26_12_3: “Therefore, son of man, prepare your belongings for captivity, and go into captivity by day in their sight. You shall go from your place into captivity to another place in their sight. It may be that they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
26_12_4: By day you shall bring out your belongings in their sight, as though going into captivity; and at evening you shall go in their sight, like those who go into captivity.
26_12_5: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your belongings out through it.
26_12_6: In their sight you shall bear them on your shoulders and carry them out at twilight; you shall cover your face, so that you cannot see the ground, for I have made you a sign to the house of Israel.”
26_12_7: So I did as I was commanded. I brought out my belongings by day, as though going into captivity, and at evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought them out at twilight, and I bore them on my shoulder in their sight.
26_12_8: And in the morning the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_12_9: “Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
26_12_10: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are among them.” ’
26_12_11: Say, ‘I am a sign to you. As I have done, so shall it be done to them; they shall be carried away into captivity.’
26_12_12: And the prince who is among them shall bear his belongings on his shoulder at twilight and go out. They shall dig through the wall to carry them out through it. He shall cover his face, so that he cannot see the ground with his eyes.
26_12_13: I will also spread My net over him, and he shall be caught in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he shall not see it, though he shall die there.
26_12_14: I will scatter to every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his troops; and I will draw out the sword after them.
26_12_15: “Then they shall know that I am the LORD, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries.
26_12_16: But I will spare a few of their men from the sword, from famine, and from pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the Gentiles wherever they go. Then they shall know that I am the LORD.”
26_12_17: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_12_18: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and anxiety.
26_12_19: And say to the people of the land, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the land of Israel: “They shall eat their bread with anxiety, and drink their water with dread, so that her land may be emptied of all who are in it, because of the violence of all those who dwell in it.
26_12_20: Then the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall become desolate; and you shall know that I am the LORD.” ’ ”
26_12_21: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_12_22: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you people have about the land of Israel, which says, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?
26_12_23: Tell them therefore, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “I will lay this proverb to rest, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel.” ’ But say to them, ‘ “The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
26_12_24: For no more shall there be any false vision or flattering divination within the house of Israel.
26_12_25: For I am the LORD. I speak, and the word which I speak will come to pass; it will no more be postponed; for in your days, O rebellious house, I will say the word and perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’ ”
26_12_26: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_12_27: “Son of man, look, the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days from now, and he prophesies of times far off.’
26_12_28: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “None of My words will be postponed any more, but the word which I speak will be done,” says the Lord GOD.’ ”
26_13_1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_13_2: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the word of the LORD!’ ”
26_13_3: Thus says the Lord GOD: “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!
26_13_4: O Israel, your prophets are like foxes in the deserts.
26_13_5: You have not gone up into the gaps to build a wall for the house of Israel to stand in battle on the day of the LORD.
26_13_6: They have envisioned futility and false divination, saying, ‘Thus says the LORD!’ But the LORD has not sent them; yet they hope that the word may be confirmed.
26_13_7: Have you not seen a futile vision, and have you not spoken false divination? You say, ‘The LORD says,’ but I have not spoken.”
26_13_8: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Because you have spoken nonsense and envisioned lies, therefore I am indeed against you,” says the Lord GOD.
26_13_9: “My hand will be against the prophets who envision futility and who divine lies; they shall not be in the assembly of My people, nor be written in the record of the house of Israel, nor shall they enter into the land of Israel. Then you shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
26_13_10: “Because, indeed, because they have seduced My people, saying, ‘Peace!’ when there is no peace—and one builds a wall, and they plaster it with untempered mortar —
26_13_11: say to those who plaster it with untempered mortar, that it will fall. There will be flooding rain, and you, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall tear it down.
26_13_12: Surely, when the wall has fallen, will it not be said to you, ‘Where is the mortar with which you plastered it? ’ ”
26_13_13: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “I will cause a stormy wind to break forth in My fury; and there shall be a flooding rain in My anger, and great hailstones in fury to consume it.
26_13_14: So I will break down the wall you have plastered with untempered mortar, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered; it will fall, and you shall be consumed in the midst of it. Then you shall know that I am the LORD.
26_13_15: “Thus will I accomplish My wrath on the wall and on those who have plastered it with untempered mortar; and I will say to you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it
26_13_16: that is, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her when there is no peace,’ ” says the Lord GOD.
26_13_17: “Likewise, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; prophesy against them
26_13_18: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their sleeves and make veils for the heads of people of every height to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of My people, and keep yourselves alive?
26_13_19: And will you profane Me among My people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, killing people who should not die, and keeping people alive who should not live, by your lying to My people who listen to lies?”
26_13_20: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, I am against your magic charms by which you hunt souls there like birds. I will tear them from your arms, and let the souls go, the souls you hunt like birds.
26_13_21: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people out of your hand, and they shall no longer be as prey in your hand. Then you shall know that I am the LORD.
26_13_22: “Because with lies you have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and you have strengthened the hands of the wicked, so that he does not turn from his wicked way to save his life.
26_13_23: Therefore you shall no longer envision futility nor practice divination; for I will deliver My people out of your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.” ’ ”
26_14_1: Now some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
26_14_2: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_14_3: “Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their hearts, and put before them that which causes them to stumble into iniquity. Should I let Myself be inquired of at all by them?
26_14_4: “Therefore speak to them, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Everyone of the house of Israel who sets up his idols in his heart, and puts before him what causes him to stumble into iniquity, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him who comes, according to the multitude of his idols
26_14_5: that I may seize the house of Israel by their heart, because they are all estranged from Me by their idols.” ’
26_14_6: “Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Repent, turn away from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your abominations.
26_14_7: For anyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell in Israel, who separates himself from Me and sets up his idols in his heart and puts before him what causes him to stumble into iniquity, then comes to a prophet to inquire of him concerning Me, I the LORD will answer him by Myself.
26_14_8: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of My people. Then you shall know that I am the LORD.
26_14_9: “And if the prophet is induced to speak anything, I the LORD have induced that prophet, and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.
26_14_10: And they shall bear their iniquity; the punishment of the prophet shall be the same as the punishment of the one who inquired
26_14_11: that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me, nor be profaned anymore with all their transgressions, but that they may be My people and I may be their God,“ says the Lord GOD.’ ”
26_14_12: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying:
26_14_13: “Son of man, when a land sins against Me by persistent unfaithfulness, I will stretch out My hand against it; I will cut off its supply of bread, send famine on it, and cut off man and beast from it.
26_14_14: Even if these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only themselves by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.
26_14_15: “If I cause wild beasts to pass through the land, and they empty it, and make it so desolate that no man may pass through because of the beasts
26_14_16: even though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters; only they would be delivered, and the land would be desolate.
26_14_17: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land,’ and I cut off man and beast from it
26_14_18: even though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but only they themselves would be delivered.
26_14_19: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land and pour out My fury on it in blood, and cut off from it man and beast
26_14_20: even though Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only themselves by their righteousness.”
26_14_21: For thus says the Lord GOD: “How much more it shall be when I send My four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword and famine and wild beasts and pestilence—to cut off man and beast from it?
26_14_22: Yet behold, there shall be left in it a remnant who will be brought out, both sons and daughters; surely they will come out to you, and you will see their ways and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the disaster that I have brought upon Jerusalem, all that I have brought upon it.
26_14_23: And they will comfort you, when you see their ways and their doings; and you shall know that I have done nothing without cause that I have done in it,” says the Lord GOD.
26_15_1: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
26_15_2: “Son of man, how is the wood of the vine better than any other wood, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?
26_15_3: Is wood taken from it to make any object? Or can men make a peg from it to hang any vessel on?
26_15_4: Instead, it is thrown into the fire for fuel; the fire devours both ends of it, and its middle is burned. Is it useful for any work?
26_15_5: Indeed, when it was whole, no object could be made from it. How much less will it be useful for any work when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned?
26_15_6: “Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: ‘Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the inhabitants of Jerusalem
26_15_7: and I will set My face against them. They will go out from one fire, but another fire shall devour them. Then you shall know that I am the LORD, when I set My face against them.
26_15_8: Thus I will make the land desolate, because they have persisted in unfaithfulness,’ says the Lord GOD.”
26_16_1: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_16_2: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations
26_16_3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD to Jerusalem: “Your birth and your nativity are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
26_16_4: As for your nativity, on the day you were born your navel cord was not cut, nor were you washed in water to cleanse you; you were not rubbed with salt nor wrapped in swaddling cloths.
26_16_5: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things for you, to have compassion on you; but you were thrown out into the open field, when you yourself were loathed on the day you were born.
26_16_6: “And when I passed by you and saw you struggling in your own blood, I said to you in your blood, ‘Live!’ Yes, I said to you in your blood, ‘Live!’
26_16_7: I made you thrive like a plant in the field; and you grew, matured, and became very beautiful. Your breasts were formed, your hair grew, but you were naked and bare.
26_16_8: “When I passed by you again and looked upon you, indeed your time was the time of love; so I spread My wing over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I swore an oath to you and entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine,” says the Lord GOD.
26_16_9: “Then I washed you in water; yes, I thoroughly washed off your blood, and I anointed you with oil.
26_16_10: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of badger skin; I clothed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
26_16_11: I adorned you with ornaments, put bracelets on your wrists, and a chain on your neck.
26_16_12: And I put a jewel in your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
26_16_13: Thus you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate pastry of fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and succeeded to royalty.
26_16_14: Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through My splendor which I had bestowed on you,” says the Lord GOD.
26_16_15: “But you trusted in your own beauty, played the harlot because of your fame, and poured out your harlotry on everyone passing by who would have it.
26_16_16: You took some of your garments and adorned multicolored high places for yourself, and played the harlot on them. Such things should not happen, nor be.
26_16_17: You have also taken your beautiful jewelry from My gold and My silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself male images and played the harlot with them.
26_16_18: You took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you set My oil and My incense before them.
26_16_19: Also My food which I gave you—the pastry of fine flour, oil, and honey which I fed you—you set it before them as sweet incense; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.
26_16_20: “Moreover you took your sons and your daughters, whom you bore to Me, and these you sacrificed to them to be devoured. Were your acts of harlotry a small matter
26_16_21: that you have slain My children and offered them up to them by causing them to pass through the fire?
26_16_22: And in all your abominations and acts of harlotry you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, struggling in your blood.
26_16_23: “Then it was so, after all your wickedness—‘Woe, woe to you!’ says the Lord GOD—
26_16_24: that you also built for yourself a shrine, and made a high place for yourself in every street.
26_16_25: You built your high places at the head of every road, and made your beauty to be abhorred. You offered yourself to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your acts of harlotry.
26_16_26: You also committed harlotry with the Egyptians, your very fleshly neighbors, and increased your acts of harlotry to provoke Me to anger.
26_16_27: “Behold, therefore, I stretched out My hand against you, diminished your allotment, and gave you up to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd behavior.
26_16_28: You also played the harlot with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; indeed you played the harlot with them and still were not satisfied.
26_16_29: Moreover you multiplied your acts of harlotry as far as the land of the trader, Chaldea; and even then you were not satisfied.
26_16_30: “How degenerate is your heart!” says the Lord GOD, “seeing you do all these things, the deeds of a brazen harlot.
26_16_31: “You erected your shrine at the head of every road, and built your high place in every street. Yet you were not like a harlot, because you scorned payment.
26_16_32: You are an adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband.
26_16_33: Men make payment to all harlots, but you made your payments to all your lovers, and hired them to come to you from all around for your harlotry.
26_16_34: You are the opposite of other women in your harlotry, because no one solicited you to be a harlot. In that you gave payment but no payment was given you, therefore you are the opposite.”
26_16_35: ‘Now then, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD!
26_16_36: Thus says the Lord GOD: “Because your filthiness was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your harlotry with your lovers, and with all your abominable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them
26_16_37: surely, therefore, I will gather all your lovers with whom you took pleasure, all those you loved, and all those you hated; I will gather them from all around against you and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
26_16_38: And I will judge you as women who break wedlock or shed blood are judged; I will bring blood upon you in fury and jealousy.
26_16_39: I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your shrines and break down your high places. They shall also strip you of your clothes, take your beautiful jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
26_16_40: “They shall also bring up an assembly against you, and they shall stone you with stones and thrust you through with their swords.
26_16_41: They shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women; and I will make you cease playing the harlot, and you shall no longer hire lovers.
26_16_42: So I will lay to rest My fury toward you, and My jealousy shall depart from you. I will be quiet, and be angry no more.
26_16_43: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but agitated Me with all these things, surely I will also recompense your deeds on your own head,” says the Lord GOD. “And you shall not commit lewdness in addition to all your abominations.
26_16_44: “Indeed everyone who quotes proverbs will use this proverb against you: ‘Like mother, like daughter!’
26_16_45: You are your mother’s daughter, loathing husband and children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and children; your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
26_16_46: “Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells with her daughters to the north of you; and your younger sister, who dwells to the south of you, is Sodom and her daughters.
26_16_47: You did not walk in their ways nor act according to their abominations; but, as if that were too little, you became more corrupt than they in all your ways.
26_16_48: “ As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “neither your sister Sodom nor her daughters have done as you and your daughters have done.
26_16_49: Look, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughter had pride, fullness of food, and abundance of idleness; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
26_16_50: And they were haughty and committed abomination before Me; therefore I took them away as I saw fit.
26_16_51: “Samaria did not commit half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all the abominations which you have done.
26_16_52: You who judged your sisters, bear your own shame also, because the sins which you committed were more abominable than theirs; they are more righteous than you. Yes, be disgraced also, and bear your own shame, because you justified your sisters.
26_16_53: “When I bring back their captives, the captives of Sodom and her daughters, and the captives of Samaria and her daughters, then I will also bring back the captives of your captivity among them
26_16_54: that you may bear your own shame and be disgraced by all that you did when you comforted them.
26_16_55: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters return to their former state, then you and your daughters will return to your former state.
26_16_56: For your sister Sodom was not a byword in your mouth in the days of your pride
26_16_57: before your wickedness was uncovered. It was like the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria and all those around her, and of the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you everywhere.
26_16_58: You have paid for your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.
26_16_59: For thus says the Lord GOD: “I will deal with you as you have done, who despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
26_16_60: “Nevertheless I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
26_16_61: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your older and your younger sisters; for I will give them to you for daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.
26_16_62: And I will establish My covenant with you. Then you shall know that I am the LORD
26_16_63: that you may remember and be ashamed, and never open your mouth anymore because of your shame, when I provide you an atonement for all you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’ ”
26_17_1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_17_2: “Son of man, pose a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel
26_17_3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “A great eagle with large wings and long pinions, Full of feathers of various colors, Came to Lebanon And took from the cedar the highest branch.
26_17_4: He cropped off its topmost young twig And carried it to a land of trade; He set it in a city of merchants.
26_17_5: Then he took some of the seed of the land And planted it in a fertile field; He placed it by abundant waters And set it like a willow tree.
26_17_6: And it grew and became a spreading vine of low stature; Its branches turned toward him, But its roots were under it. So it became a vine, Brought forth branches, And put forth shoots.
26_17_7: “But there was another great eagle with large wings and many feathers; And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, And stretched its branches toward him, From the garden terrace where it had been planted, That he might water it.
26_17_8: It was planted in good soil by many waters, To bring forth branches, bear fruit, And become a majestic vine.” ’
26_17_9: “Say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Will it thrive? Will he not pull up its roots, Cut off its fruit, And leave it to wither? All of its spring leaves will wither, And no great power or many people Will be needed to pluck it up by its roots.
26_17_10: Behold, it is planted, Will it thrive? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the garden terrace where it grew.” ’ ”
26_17_11: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying
26_17_12: “Say now to the rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these things mean? ’ Tell them, ‘Indeed the king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and took its king and princes, and led them with him to Babylon.
26_17_13: And he took the king’s offspring, made a covenant with him, and put him under oath. He also took away the mighty of the land
26_17_14: that the kingdom might be brought low and not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
26_17_15: But he rebelled against him by sending his ambassadors to Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Can he break a covenant and still be delivered?
26_17_16: ‘ As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke—with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
26_17_17: Nor will Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company do anything in the war, when they heap up a siege mound and build a wall to cut off many persons.
26_17_18: Since he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, and in fact gave his hand and still did all these things, he shall not escape.’ ”
26_17_19: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “ As I live, surely My oath which he despised, and My covenant which he broke, I will recompense on his own head.
26_17_20: I will spread My net over him, and he shall be taken in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon and try him there for the treason which he committed against Me.
26_17_21: All his fugitives with all his troops shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered to every wind; and you shall know that I, the LORD, have spoken.”
26_17_22: Thus says the Lord GOD: “I will take also one of the highest branches of the high cedar and set it out. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and will plant it on a high and prominent mountain.
26_17_23: On the mountain height of Israel I will plant it; and it will bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a majestic cedar. Under it will dwell birds of every sort; in the shadow of its branches they will dwell.
26_17_24: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree and exalted the low tree, dried up the green tree and made the dry tree flourish; I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it. ”
26_18_1: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying
26_18_2: “What do you mean when you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
26_18_3: “ As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall no longer use this proverb in Israel.
26_18_4: “Behold, all souls are Mine; The soul of the father As well as the soul of the son is Mine; The soul who sins shall die.
26_18_5: But if a man is just And does what is lawful and right
26_18_6: If he has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor’s wife, Nor approached a woman during her impurity
26_18_7: If he has not oppressed anyone, But has restored to the debtor his pledge; Has robbed no one by violence, But has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing
26_18_8: If he has not exacted usury Nor taken any increase, But has withdrawn his hand from iniquity And executed true judgment between man and man
26_18_9: If he has walked in My statutes And kept My judgments faithfully— He is just; He shall surely live!” Says the Lord GOD.
26_18_10: “If he begets a son who is a robber Or a shedder of blood, Who does any of these things
26_18_11: And does none of those duties, But has eaten on the mountains Or defiled his neighbor’s wife
26_18_12: If he has oppressed the poor and needy, Robbed by violence, Not restored the pledge, Lifted his eyes to the idols, Or committed abomination
26_18_13: If he has exacted usury Or taken increase— Shall he then live? He shall not live! If he has done any of these abominations, He shall surely die; His blood shall be upon him.
26_18_14: “ If, however, he begets a son Who sees all the sins which his father has done, And considers but does not do likewise
26_18_15: Who has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor’s wife
26_18_16: Has not oppressed anyone, Nor withheld a pledge, Nor robbed by violence, But has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing
26_18_17: Who has withdrawn his hand from the poor And not received usury or increase, But has executed My judgments And walked in My statutes— He shall not die for the iniquity of his father; He shall surely live!
26_18_18: “ As for his father, Because he cruelly oppressed, Robbed his brother by violence, And did what is not good among his people, Behold, he shall die for his iniquity.
26_18_19: “Yet you say, ‘Why should the son not bear the guilt of the father?’ Because the son has done what is lawful and right, and has kept all My statutes and observed them, he shall surely live.
26_18_20: The soul who sins shall die. The son shall not bear the guilt of the father, nor the father bear the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon himself.
26_18_21: “But if a wicked man turns from all his sins which he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is lawful and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
26_18_22: None of the transgressions which he has committed shall be remembered against him; because of the righteousness which he has done, he shall live.
26_18_23: Do I have any pleasure at all that the wicked should die?” says the Lord GOD, “ and not that he should turn from his ways and live?
26_18_24: “But when a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? All the righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; because of the unfaithfulness of which he is guilty and the sin which he has committed, because of them he shall die.
