29_1_1: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
29_1_2: Hear this, you elders, And give ear, all you inhabitants of the land! Has anything like this happened in your days, Or even in the days of your fathers?
29_1_3: Tell your children about it, Let your children tell their children, And their children another generation.
29_1_4: What the chewing locust left, the swarming locust has eaten; What the swarming locust left, the crawling locust has eaten; And what the crawling locust left, the consuming locust has eaten.
29_1_5: Awake, you drunkards, and weep; And wail, all you drinkers of wine, Because of the new wine, For it has been cut off from your mouth.
29_1_6: For a nation has come up against My land, Strong, and without number; His teeth are the teeth of a lion, And he has the fangs of a fierce lion.
29_1_7: He has laid waste My vine, And ruined My fig tree; He has stripped it bare and thrown it away; Its branches are made white.
29_1_8: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth For the husband of her youth.
29_1_9: The grain offering and the drink offering Have been cut off from the house of the LORD; The priests mourn, who minister to the LORD.
29_1_10: The field is wasted, The land mourns; For the grain is ruined, The new wine is dried up, The oil fails.
29_1_11: Be ashamed, you farmers, Wail, you vinedressers, For the wheat and the barley; Because the harvest of the field has perished.
29_1_12: The vine has dried up, And the fig tree has withered; The pomegranate tree, The palm tree also, And the apple tree— All the trees of the field are withered; Surely joy has withered away from the sons of men.
29_1_13: Gird yourselves and lament, you priests; Wail, you who minister before the altar; Come, lie all night in sackcloth, You who minister to my God; For the grain offering and the drink offering Are withheld from the house of your God.
29_1_14: Consecrate a fast, Call a sacred assembly; Gather the elders And all the inhabitants of the land Into the house of the LORD your God, And cry out to the LORD.
29_1_15: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand; It shall come as destruction from the Almighty.
29_1_16: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, Joy and gladness from the house of our God?
29_1_17: The seed shrivels under the clods, Storehouses are in shambles; Barns are broken down, For the grain has withered.
29_1_18: How the animals groan! The herds of cattle are restless, Because they have no pasture; Even the flocks of sheep suffer punishment.
29_1_19: O LORD, to You I cry out; For fire has devoured the open pastures, And a flame has burned all the trees of the field.
29_1_20: The beasts of the field also cry out to You, For the water brooks are dried up, And fire has devoured the open pastures.
29_2_1: Blow the trumpet in Zion, And sound an alarm in My holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble; For the day of the LORD is coming, For it is at hand:
29_2_2: A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness, Like the morning clouds spread over the mountains. A people come, great and strong, The like of whom has never been; Nor will there ever be any such after them, Even for many successive generations.
29_2_3: A fire devours before them, And behind them a flame burns; The land is like the Garden of Eden before them, And behind them a desolate wilderness; Surely nothing shall escape them.
29_2_4: Their appearance is like the appearance of horses; And like swift steeds, so they run.
29_2_5: With a noise like chariots Over mountaintops they leap, Like the noise of a flaming fire that devours the stubble, Like a strong people set in battle array.
29_2_6: Before them the people writhe in pain; All faces are drained of color.
29_2_7: They run like mighty men, They climb the wall like men of war; Every one marches in formation, And they do not break ranks.
29_2_8: They do not push one another; Every one marches in his own column. Though they lunge between the weapons, They are not cut down.
29_2_9: They run to and fro in the city, They run on the wall; They climb into the houses, They enter at the windows like a thief.
29_2_10: The earth quakes before them, The heavens tremble; The sun and moon grow dark, And the stars diminish their brightness.
29_2_11: The LORD gives voice before His army, For His camp is very great; For strong is the One who executes His word. For the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; Who can endure it?
29_2_12: “Now, therefore,” says the LORD, “Turn to Me with all your heart, With fasting, with weeping, and with mourning.”
29_2_13: So rend your heart, and not your garments; Return to the LORD your God, For He is gracious and merciful, Slow to anger, and of great kindness; And He relents from doing harm.
29_2_14: Who knows if He will turn and relent, And leave a blessing behind Him— A grain offering and a drink offering For the LORD your God?
29_2_15: Blow the trumpet in Zion, Consecrate a fast, Call a sacred assembly
29_2_16: Gather the people, Sanctify the congregation, Assemble the elders, Gather the children and nursing babes; Let the bridegroom go out from his chamber, And the bride from her dressing room.
29_2_17: Let the priests, who minister to the LORD, Weep between the porch and the altar; Let them say, “Spare Your people, O LORD, And do not give Your heritage to reproach, That the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ ”
29_2_18: Then the LORD will be zealous for His land, And pity His people.
29_2_19: The LORD will answer and say to His people, “Behold, I will send you grain and new wine and oil, And you will be satisfied by them; I will no longer make you a reproach among the nations.
29_2_20: “But I will remove far from you the northern army, And will drive him away into a barren and desolate land, With his face toward the eastern sea And his back toward the western sea; His stench will come up, And his foul odor will rise, Because he has done monstrous things.”
29_2_21: Fear not, O land; Be glad and rejoice, For the LORD has done marvelous things!
29_2_22: Do not be afraid, you beasts of the field; For the open pastures are springing up, And the tree bears its fruit; The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.
29_2_23: Be glad then, you children of Zion, And rejoice in the LORD your God; For He has given you the former rain faithfully, And He will cause the rain to come down for you— The former rain, And the latter rain in the first month.
29_2_24: The threshing floors shall be full of wheat, And the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil.
29_2_25: “So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, The crawling locust, The consuming locust, And the chewing locust, My great army which I sent among you.
29_2_26: You shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, And praise the name of the LORD your God, Who has dealt wondrously with you; And My people shall never be put to shame.
29_2_27: Then you shall know that I am in the midst of Israel: I am the LORD your God And there is no other. My people shall never be put to shame.
29_2_28: “And it shall come to pass afterward That I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your old men shall dream dreams, Your young men shall see visions.
29_2_29: And also on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
29_2_30: “And I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth: Blood and fire and pillars of smoke.
29_2_31: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the coming of the great and awesome day of the LORD.
29_2_32: And it shall come to pass That whoever calls on the name of the LORD Shall be saved. For in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be deliverance, As the LORD has said, Among the remnant whom the LORD calls.
29_3_1: “For behold, in those days and at that time, When I bring back the captives of Judah and Jerusalem
29_3_2: I will also gather all nations, And bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; And I will enter into judgment with them there On account of My people, My heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; They have also divided up My land.
29_3_3: They have cast lots for My people, Have given a boy as payment for a harlot, And sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
29_3_4: “Indeed, what have you to do with Me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the coasts of Philistia? Will you retaliate against Me? But if you retaliate against Me, Swiftly and speedily I will return your retaliation upon your own head
29_3_5: Because you have taken My silver and My gold, And have carried into your temples My prized possessions.
29_3_6: Also the people of Judah and the people of Jerusalem You have sold to the Greeks, That you may remove them far from their borders.
29_3_7: “Behold, I will raise them Out of the place to which you have sold them, And will return your retaliation upon your own head.
29_3_8: I will sell your sons and your daughters Into the hand of the people of Judah, And they will sell them to the Sabeans, To a people far off; For the LORD has spoken.”
29_3_9: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Wake up the mighty men, Let all the men of war draw near, Let them come up.
29_3_10: Beat your plowshares into swords And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’ ”
29_3_11: Assemble and come, all you nations, And gather together all around. Cause Your mighty ones to go down there, O LORD.
29_3_12: “Let the nations be wakened, and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; For there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
29_3_13: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, go down; For the winepress is full, The vats overflow— For their wickedness is great.”
29_3_14: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
29_3_15: The sun and moon will grow dark, And the stars will diminish their brightness.
29_3_16: The LORD also will roar from Zion, And utter His voice from Jerusalem; The heavens and earth will shake; But the LORD will be a shelter for His people, And the strength of the children of Israel.
29_3_17: “So you shall know that I am the LORD your God, Dwelling in Zion My holy mountain. Then Jerusalem shall be holy, And no aliens shall ever pass through her again.”
29_3_18: And it will come to pass in that day That the mountains shall drip with new wine, The hills shall flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah shall be flooded with water; A fountain shall flow from the house of the LORD And water the Valley of Acacias.
29_3_19: “Egypt shall be a desolation, And Edom a desolate wilderness, Because of violence against the people of Judah, For they have shed innocent blood in their land.
29_3_20: But Judah shall abide forever, And Jerusalem from generation to generation.
29_3_21: For I will acquit them of the guilt of bloodshed, whom I had not acquitted; For the LORD dwells in Zion.”
30_1_1: The words of Amos, who was among the sheepbreeders of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
30_1_2: And he said: “The LORD roars from Zion, And utters His voice from Jerusalem; The pastures of the shepherds mourn, And the top of Carmel withers.”
30_1_3: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they have threshed Gilead with implements of iron.
30_1_4: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, Which shall devour the palaces of Ben-Hadad.
30_1_5: I will also break the gate bar of Damascus, And cut off the inhabitant from the Valley of Aven, And the one who holds the scepter from Beth Eden. The people of Syria shall go captive to Kir,” Says the LORD.
30_1_6: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they took captive the whole captivity To deliver them up to Edom.
30_1_7: But I will send a fire upon the wall of Gaza, Which shall devour its palaces.
30_1_8: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, And the one who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; I will turn My hand against Ekron, And the remnant of the Philistines shall perish,” Says the Lord GOD.
30_1_9: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Tyre, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, And did not remember the covenant of brotherhood.
30_1_10: But I will send a fire upon the wall of Tyre, Which shall devour its palaces.”
30_1_11: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because he pursued his brother with the sword, And cast off all pity; His anger tore perpetually, And he kept his wrath forever.
30_1_12: But I will send a fire upon Teman, Which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.”
30_1_13: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of the people of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they ripped open the women with child in Gilead, That they might enlarge their territory.
30_1_14: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, And it shall devour its palaces, Amid shouting in the day of battle, And a tempest in the day of the whirlwind.
30_1_15: Their king shall go into captivity, He and his princes together,” Says the LORD.
30_2_1: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because he burned the bones of the king of Edom to lime.
30_2_2: But I will send a fire upon Moab, And it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth; Moab shall die with tumult, With shouting and trumpet sound.
30_2_3: And I will cut off the judge from its midst, And slay all its princes with him,” Says the LORD.
30_2_4: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they have despised the law of the LORD, And have not kept His commandments. Their lies lead them astray, Lies which their fathers followed.
30_2_5: But I will send a fire upon Judah, And it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
30_2_6: Thus says the LORD: “For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they sell the righteous for silver, And the poor for a pair of sandals.
30_2_7: They pant after the dust of the earth which is on the head of the poor, And pervert the way of the humble. A man and his father go in to the same girl, To defile My holy name.
30_2_8: They lie down by every altar on clothes taken in pledge, And drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
30_2_9: “Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, Whose height was like the height of the cedars, And he was as strong as the oaks; Yet I destroyed his fruit above And his roots beneath.
30_2_10: Also it was I who brought you up from the land of Egypt, And led you forty years through the wilderness, To possess the land of the Amorite.
30_2_11: I raised up some of your sons as prophets, And some of your young men as Nazirites. Is it not so, O you children of Israel?” Says the LORD.
30_2_12: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, And commanded the prophets saying, ‘Do not prophesy!’
30_2_13: “Behold, I am weighed down by you, As a cart full of sheaves is weighed down.
30_2_14: Therefore flight shall perish from the swift, The strong shall not strengthen his power, Nor shall the mighty deliver himself
30_2_15: He shall not stand who handles the bow, The swift of foot shall not escape, Nor shall he who rides a horse deliver himself.
30_2_16: The most courageous men of might Shall flee naked in that day,” Says the LORD.
30_3_1: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying:
30_3_2: “You only have I known of all the families of the earth; Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
30_3_3: Can two walk together, unless they are agreed?
30_3_4: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he has no prey? Will a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
30_3_5: Will a bird fall into a snare on the earth, where there is no trap for it? Will a snare spring up from the earth, if it has caught nothing at all?
30_3_6: If a trumpet is blown in a city, will not the people be afraid? If there is calamity in a city, will not the LORD have done it?
30_3_7: Surely the Lord GOD does nothing, Unless He reveals His secret to His servants the prophets.
30_3_8: A lion has roared! Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken! Who can but prophesy?
30_3_9: “Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, And in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say: ‘Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; See great tumults in her midst, And the oppressed within her.
30_3_10: For they do not know to do right,’ Says the LORD, ‘Who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.’ ”
30_3_11: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “An adversary shall be all around the land; He shall sap your strength from you, And your palaces shall be plundered.”
30_3_12: Thus says the LORD: “As a shepherd takes from the mouth of a lion Two legs or a piece of an ear, So shall the children of Israel be taken out Who dwell in Samaria— In the corner of a bed and on the edge of a couch!
30_3_13: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob,” Says the Lord GOD, the God of hosts
30_3_14: “That in the day I punish Israel for their transgressions, I will also visit destruction on the altars of Bethel; And the horns of the altar shall be cut off And fall to the ground.
30_3_15: I will destroy the winter house along with the summer house; The houses of ivory shall perish, And the great houses shall have an end,” Says the LORD.
30_4_1: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, Who oppress the poor, Who crush the needy, Who say to your husbands, “Bring wine, let us drink!”
30_4_2: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness: “Behold, the days shall come upon you When He will take you away with fishhooks, And your posterity with fishhooks.
30_4_3: You will go out through broken walls, Each one straight ahead of her, And you will be cast into Harmon,” Says the LORD.
30_4_4: “Come to Bethel and transgress, At Gilgal multiply transgression; Bring your sacrifices every morning, Your tithes every three days.
30_4_5: Offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, Proclaim and announce the freewill offerings; For this you love, You children of Israel!” Says the Lord GOD.
30_4_6: “Also I gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And lack of bread in all your places; Yet you have not returned to Me,” Says the LORD.
30_4_7: “I also withheld rain from you, When there were still three months to the harvest. I made it rain on one city, I withheld rain from another city. One part was rained upon, And where it did not rain the part withered.
30_4_8: So two or three cities wandered to another city to drink water, But they were not satisfied; Yet you have not returned to Me,” Says the LORD.
30_4_9: “I blasted you with blight and mildew. When your gardens increased, Your vineyards, Your fig trees, And your olive trees, The locust devoured them; Yet you have not returned to Me,” Says the LORD.
30_4_10: “I sent among you a plague after the manner of Egypt; Your young men I killed with a sword, Along with your captive horses; I made the stench of your camps come up into your nostrils; Yet you have not returned to Me,” Says the LORD.
30_4_11: “I overthrew some of you, As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, And you were like a firebrand plucked from the burning; Yet you have not returned to Me,” Says the LORD.
30_4_12: “Therefore thus will I do to you, O Israel; Because I will do this to you, Prepare to meet your God, O Israel!”
30_4_13: For behold, He who forms mountains, And creates the wind, Who declares to man what his thought is, And makes the morning darkness, Who treads the high places of the earth— The LORD God of hosts is His name.
30_5_1: Hear this word which I take up against you, a lamentation, O house of Israel:
30_5_2: The virgin of Israel has fallen; She will rise no more. She lies forsaken on her land; There is no one to raise her up.
30_5_3: For thus says the Lord GOD: “The city that goes out by a thousand Shall have a hundred left, And that which goes out by a hundred Shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
30_5_4: For thus says the LORD to the house of Israel: “Seek Me and live
30_5_5: But do not seek Bethel, Nor enter Gilgal, Nor pass over to Beersheba; For Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, And Bethel shall come to nothing.
30_5_6: Seek the LORD and live, Lest He break out like fire in the house of Joseph, And devour it, With no one to quench it in Bethel—
30_5_7: You who turn justice to wormwood, And lay righteousness to rest in the earth!”
30_5_8: He made the Pleiades and Orion; He turns the shadow of death into morning And makes the day dark as night; He calls for the waters of the sea And pours them out on the face of the earth; The LORD is His name.
30_5_9: He rains ruin upon the strong, So that fury comes upon the fortress.
30_5_10: They hate the one who rebukes in the gate, And they abhor the one who speaks uprightly.
30_5_11: Therefore, because you tread down the poor And take grain taxes from him, Though you have built houses of hewn stone, Yet you shall not dwell in them; You have planted pleasant vineyards, But you shall not drink wine from them.
30_5_12: For I know your manifold transgressions And your mighty sins: Afflicting the just and taking bribes; Diverting the poor from justice at the gate.
30_5_13: Therefore the prudent keep silent at that time, For it is an evil time.
30_5_14: Seek good and not evil, That you may live; So the LORD God of hosts will be with you, As you have spoken.
30_5_15: Hate evil, love good; Establish justice in the gate. It may be that the LORD God of hosts Will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
30_5_16: Therefore the LORD God of hosts, the Lord, says this: “ There shall be wailing in all streets, And they shall say in all the highways, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They shall call the farmer to mourning, And skillful lamenters to wailing.
30_5_17: In all vineyards there shall be wailing, For I will pass through you,” Says the LORD.
30_5_18: Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! For what good is the day of the LORD to you? It will be darkness, and not light.
30_5_19: It will be as though a man fled from a lion, And a bear met him! Or as though he went into the house, Leaned his hand on the wall, And a serpent bit him!
30_5_20: Is not the day of the LORD darkness, and not light? Is it not very dark, with no brightness in it?
30_5_21: “I hate, I despise your feast days, And I do not savor your sacred assemblies.
30_5_22: Though you offer Me burnt offerings and your grain offerings, I will not accept them, Nor will I regard your fattened peace offerings.
30_5_23: Take away from Me the noise of your songs, For I will not hear the melody of your stringed instruments.
30_5_24: But let justice run down like water, And righteousness like a mighty stream.
30_5_25: “Did you offer Me sacrifices and offerings In the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
30_5_26: You also carried Sikkuth your king And Chiun, your idols, The star of your gods, Which you made for yourselves.
30_5_27: Therefore I will send you into captivity beyond Damascus,” Says the LORD, whose name is the God of hosts.
30_6_1: Woe to you who are at ease in Zion, And trust in Mount Samaria, Notable persons in the chief nation, To whom the house of Israel comes!
30_6_2: Go over to Calneh and see; And from there go to Hamath the great; Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Or is their territory greater than your territory?
30_6_3: Woe to you who put far off the day of doom, Who cause the seat of violence to come near
30_6_4: Who lie on beds of ivory, Stretch out on your couches, Eat lambs from the flock And calves from the midst of the stall
30_6_5: Who sing idly to the sound of stringed instruments, And invent for yourselves musical instruments like David
30_6_6: Who drink wine from bowls, And anoint yourselves with the best ointments, But are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
30_6_7: Therefore they shall now go captive as the first of the captives, And those who recline at banquets shall be removed.
30_6_8: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself, The LORD God of hosts says: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, And hate his palaces; Therefore I will deliver up the city And all that is in it.”
30_6_9: Then it shall come to pass, that if ten men remain in one house, they shall die.
30_6_10: And when a relative of the dead, with one who will burn the bodies, picks up the bodies to take them out of the house, he will say to one inside the house, “ Are there any more with you?” Then someone will say, “None.” And he will say, “Hold your tongue! For we dare not mention the name of the LORD.”
30_6_11: For behold, the LORD gives a command: He will break the great house into bits, And the little house into pieces.
30_6_12: Do horses run on rocks? Does one plow there with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into gall, And the fruit of righteousness into wormwood
30_6_13: You who rejoice over Lo Debar, Who say, “Have we not taken Karnaim for ourselves By our own strength?”
30_6_14: “But, behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel,” Says the LORD God of hosts; “And they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath To the Valley of the Arabah.”

30_7_6: So the LORD relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” said the Lord GOD.
30_7_7: Thus He showed me: Behold, the Lord stood on a wall made with a plumb line, with a plumb line in His hand.
30_7_8: And the LORD said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” And I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said: “Behold, I am setting a plumb line In the midst of My people Israel; I will not pass by them anymore.
30_7_9: The high places of Isaac shall be desolate, And the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste. I will rise with the sword against the house of Jeroboam.”
30_7_10: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.
30_7_11: For thus Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam shall die by the sword, And Israel shall surely be led away captive From their own land.’ ”
30_7_12: Then Amaziah said to Amos: “Go, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah. There eat bread, And there prophesy.
30_7_13: But never again prophesy at Bethel, For it is the king’s sanctuary, And it is the royal residence.”
30_7_14: Then Amos answered, and said to Amaziah: “I was no prophet, Nor was I a son of a prophet, But I was a sheepbreeder And a tender of sycamore fruit.
30_7_15: Then the LORD took me as I followed the flock, And the LORD said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
30_7_16: Now therefore, hear the word of the LORD: You say, ‘Do not prophesy against Israel, And do not spout against the house of Isaac.’
30_7_17: “Therefore thus says the LORD: ‘Your wife shall be a harlot in the city; Your sons and daughters shall fall by the sword; Your land shall be divided by survey line; You shall die in a defiled land; And Israel shall surely be led away captive From his own land.’ ”
30_8_1: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: Behold, a basket of summer fruit.
30_8_2: And He said, “Amos, what do you see?” So I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me: “The end has come upon My people Israel; I will not pass by them anymore.
30_8_3: And the songs of the temple Shall be wailing in that day,” Says the Lord GOD— “Many dead bodies everywhere, They shall be thrown out in silence.”
30_8_4: Hear this, you who swallow up the needy, And make the poor of the land fail
30_8_5: Saying: “When will the New Moon be past, That we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, That we may trade wheat? Making the ephah small and the shekel large, Falsifying the scales by deceit
30_8_6: That we may buy the poor for silver, And the needy for a pair of sandals— Even sell the bad wheat?”
30_8_7: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob: “Surely I will never forget any of their works.
30_8_8: Shall the land not tremble for this, And everyone mourn who dwells in it? All of it shall swell like the River, Heave and subside Like the River of Egypt.
30_8_9: “And it shall come to pass in that day,” says the Lord GOD, “That I will make the sun go down at noon, And I will darken the earth in broad daylight
30_8_10: I will turn your feasts into mourning, And all your songs into lamentation; I will bring sackcloth on every waist, And baldness on every head; I will make it like mourning for an only son, And its end like a bitter day.
30_8_11: “Behold, the days are coming,” says the Lord GOD, “That I will send a famine on the land, Not a famine of bread, Nor a thirst for water, But of hearing the words of the LORD.
30_8_12: They shall wander from sea to sea, And from north to east; They shall run to and fro, seeking the word of the LORD, But shall not find it.
30_8_13: “In that day the fair virgins And strong young men Shall faint from thirst.
30_8_14: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, Who say, ‘As your god lives, O Dan!’ And, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives!’ They shall fall and never rise again.”
30_9_1: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and He said: “Strike the doorposts, that the thresholds may shake, And break them on the heads of them all. I will slay the last of them with the sword. He who flees from them shall not get away, And he who escapes from them shall not be delivered.
30_9_2: “Though they dig into hell, From there My hand shall take them; Though they climb up to heaven, From there I will bring them down
30_9_3: And though they hide themselves on top of Carmel, From there I will search and take them; Though they hide from My sight at the bottom of the sea, From there I will command the serpent, and it shall bite them
30_9_4: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, From there I will command the sword, And it shall slay them. I will set My eyes on them for harm and not for good.”
30_9_5: The Lord GOD of hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts, And all who dwell there mourn; All of it shall swell like the River, And subside like the River of Egypt.
30_9_6: He who builds His layers in the sky, And has founded His strata in the earth; Who calls for the waters of the sea, And pours them out on the face of the earth— The LORD is His name.
30_9_7: “ Are you not like the people of Ethiopia to Me, O children of Israel?” says the LORD. “Did I not bring up Israel from the land of Egypt, The Philistines from Caphtor, And the Syrians from Kir?
30_9_8: “Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, And I will destroy it from the face of the earth; Yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” Says the LORD.
30_9_9: “For surely I will command, And will sift the house of Israel among all nations, As grain is sifted in a sieve; Yet not the smallest grain shall fall to the ground.
30_9_10: All the sinners of My people shall die by the sword, Who say, ‘The calamity shall not overtake nor confront us.’
30_9_11: “On that day I will raise up The tabernacle of David, which has fallen down, And repair its damages; I will raise up its ruins, And rebuild it as in the days of old
30_9_12: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, And all the Gentiles who are called by My name,” Says the LORD who does this thing.
30_9_13: “Behold, the days are coming,” says the LORD, “When the plowman shall overtake the reaper, And the treader of grapes him who sows seed; The mountains shall drip with sweet wine, And all the hills shall flow with it.
30_9_14: I will bring back the captives of My people Israel; They shall build the waste cities and inhabit them; They shall plant vineyards and drink wine from them; They shall also make gardens and eat fruit from them.
30_9_15: I will plant them in their land, And no longer shall they be pulled up From the land I have given them,” Says the LORD your God.
32_1_1: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying
32_1_2: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry out against it; for their wickedness has come up before Me.”
32_1_3: But Jonah arose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid the fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
32_1_4: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship was about to be broken up.
32_1_5: Then the mariners were afraid; and every man cried out to his god, and threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea, to lighten the load. But Jonah had gone down into the lowest parts of the ship, had lain down, and was fast asleep.
32_1_6: So the captain came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God; perhaps your God will consider us, so that we may not perish.”
32_1_7: And they said to one another, “Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this trouble has come upon us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
32_1_8: Then they said to him, “Please tell us! For whose cause is this trouble upon us? What is your occupation? And where do you come from? What is your country? And of what people are you?”
32_1_9: So he said to them, “I am a Hebrew; and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land. ”
32_1_10: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “Why have you done this?” For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
32_1_11: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you that the sea may be calm for us?”—for the sea was growing more tempestuous.
32_1_12: And he said to them, “Pick me up and throw me into the sea; then the sea will become calm for you. For I know that this great tempest is because of me.”
32_1_13: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to return to land, but they could not, for the sea continued to grow more tempestuous against them.
32_1_14: Therefore they cried out to the LORD and said, “We pray, O LORD, please do not let us perish for this man’s life, and do not charge us with innocent blood; for You, O LORD, have done as it pleased You.”
32_1_15: So they picked up Jonah and threw him into the sea, and the sea ceased from its raging.
32_1_16: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice to the LORD and took vows.
32_1_17: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
32_2_1: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD his God from the fish’s belly.
32_2_2: And he said: “I cried out to the LORD because of my affliction, And He answered me. “Out of the belly of Sheol I cried, And You heard my voice.
32_2_3: For You cast me into the deep, Into the heart of the seas, And the floods surrounded me; All Your billows and Your waves passed over me.
32_2_4: Then I said, ‘I have been cast out of Your sight; Yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.’
32_2_5: The waters surrounded me, even to my soul; The deep closed around me; Weeds were wrapped around my head.
32_2_6: I went down to the moorings of the mountains; The earth with its bars closed behind me forever; Yet You have brought up my life from the pit, O LORD, my God.
32_2_7: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD; And my prayer went up to You, Into Your holy temple.
32_2_8: “Those who regard worthless idols Forsake their own Mercy.
32_2_9: But I will sacrifice to You With the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay what I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.”
32_2_10: So the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
32_3_1: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah the second time, saying
32_3_2: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I tell you.”
32_3_3: So Jonah arose and went to Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, a three-day journey in extent.
32_3_4: And Jonah began to enter the city on the first day’s walk. Then he cried out and said, “Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!”
32_3_5: So the people of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest to the least of them.
32_3_6: Then word came to the king of Nineveh; and he arose from his throne and laid aside his robe, covered himself with sackcloth and sat in ashes.
32_3_7: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published throughout Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything; do not let them eat, or drink water.
32_3_8: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily to God; yes, let every one turn from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
32_3_9: Who can tell if God will turn and relent, and turn away from His fierce anger, so that we may not perish?
32_3_10: Then God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God relented from the disaster that He had said He would bring upon them, and He did not do it.
32_4_1: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he became angry.
32_4_2: So he prayed to the LORD, and said, “Ah, LORD, was not this what I said when I was still in my country? Therefore I fled previously to Tarshish; for I know that You are a gracious and merciful God, slow to anger and abundant in lovingkindness, One who relents from doing harm.
32_4_3: Therefore now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live!”
32_4_4: Then the LORD said, “ Is it right for you to be angry?”
32_4_5: So Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city. There he made himself a shelter and sat under it in the shade, till he might see what would become of the city.
32_4_6: And the LORD God prepared a plant and made it come up over Jonah, that it might be shade for his head to deliver him from his misery. So Jonah was very grateful for the plant.
32_4_7: But as morning dawned the next day God prepared a worm, and it so damaged the plant that it withered.
32_4_8: And it happened, when the sun arose, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he grew faint. Then he wished death for himself, and said, “ It is better for me to die than to live.”
32_4_9: Then God said to Jonah, “ Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?” And he said, “ It is right for me to be angry, even to death!”
32_4_10: But the LORD said, “You have had pity on the plant for which you have not labored, nor made it grow, which came up in a night and perished in a night.
32_4_11: And should I not pity Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred and twenty thousand persons who cannot discern between their right hand and their left—and much livestock?”
33_1_1: The word of the LORD that came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
33_1_2: Hear, all you peoples! Listen, O earth, and all that is in it! Let the Lord GOD be a witness against you, The Lord from His holy temple.
33_1_3: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His place; He will come down And tread on the high places of the earth.
33_1_4: The mountains will melt under Him, And the valleys will split Like wax before the fire, Like waters poured down a steep place.
33_1_5: All this is for the transgression of Jacob And for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Are they not Jerusalem?
33_1_6: “Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of ruins in the field, Places for planting a vineyard; I will pour down her stones into the valley, And I will uncover her foundations.
33_1_7: All her carved images shall be beaten to pieces, And all her pay as a harlot shall be burned with the fire; All her idols I will lay desolate, For she gathered it from the pay of a harlot, And they shall return to the pay of a harlot.”
33_1_8: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals And a mourning like the ostriches
33_1_9: For her wounds are incurable. For it has come to Judah; It has come to the gate of My people— To Jerusalem.
33_1_10: Tell it not in Gath, Weep not at all; In Beth Aphrah Roll yourself in the dust.
33_1_11: Pass by in naked shame, you inhabitant of Shaphir; The inhabitant of Zaanan does not go out. Beth Ezel mourns; Its place to stand is taken away from you.
33_1_12: For the inhabitant of Maroth pined for good, But disaster came down from the LORD To the gate of Jerusalem.
33_1_13: O inhabitant of Lachish, Harness the chariot to the swift steeds (She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion), For the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
33_1_14: Therefore you shall give presents to Moresheth Gath; The houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
33_1_15: I will yet bring an heir to you, O inhabitant of Mareshah; The glory of Israel shall come to Adullam.
33_1_16: Make yourself bald and cut off your hair, Because of your precious children; Enlarge your baldness like an eagle, For they shall go from you into captivity.
33_2_1: Woe to those who devise iniquity, And work out evil on their beds! At morning light they practice it, Because it is in the power of their hand.
33_2_2: They covet fields and take them by violence, Also houses, and seize them. So they oppress a man and his house, A man and his inheritance.
33_2_3: Therefore thus says the LORD: “Behold, against this family I am devising disaster, From which you cannot remove your necks; Nor shall you walk haughtily, For this is an evil time.
33_2_4: In that day one shall take up a proverb against you, And lament with a bitter lamentation, saying: ‘We are utterly destroyed! He has changed the heritage of my people; How He has removed it from me! To a turncoat He has divided our fields.’ ”
33_2_5: Therefore you will have no one to determine boundaries by lot In the assembly of the LORD.
33_2_6: “Do not prattle,” you say to those who prophesy. So they shall not prophesy to you; They shall not return insult for insult.
33_2_7: You who are named the house of Jacob: “Is the Spirit of the LORD restricted? Are these His doings? Do not My words do good To him who walks uprightly?
33_2_8: “Lately My people have risen up as an enemy— You pull off the robe with the garment From those who trust you, as they pass by, Like men returned from war.
33_2_9: The women of My people you cast out From their pleasant houses; From their children You have taken away My glory forever.
33_2_10: “Arise and depart, For this is not your rest; Because it is defiled, it shall destroy, Yes, with utter destruction.
33_2_11: If a man should walk in a false spirit And speak a lie, saying, ‘I will prophesy to you of wine and drink,’ Even he would be the prattler of this people.
33_2_12: “I will surely assemble all of you, O Jacob, I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together like sheep of the fold, Like a flock in the midst of their pasture; They shall make a loud noise because of so many people.
33_2_13: The one who breaks open will come up before them; They will break out, Pass through the gate, And go out by it; Their king will pass before them, With the LORD at their head.”
33_3_1: And I said: “Hear now, O heads of Jacob, And you rulers of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know justice?
33_3_2: You who hate good and love evil; Who strip the skin from My people, And the flesh from their bones
33_3_3: Who also eat the flesh of My people, Flay their skin from them, Break their bones, And chop them in pieces Like meat for the pot, Like flesh in the caldron.”
33_3_4: Then they will cry to the LORD, But He will not hear them; He will even hide His face from them at that time, Because they have been evil in their deeds.
33_3_5: Thus says the LORD concerning the prophets Who make my people stray; Who chant “Peace” While they chew with their teeth, But who prepare war against him Who puts nothing into their mouths:
33_3_6: “Therefore you shall have night without vision, And you shall have darkness without divination; The sun shall go down on the prophets, And the day shall be dark for them.
33_3_7: So the seers shall be ashamed, And the diviners abashed; Indeed they shall all cover their lips; For there is no answer from God.”
33_3_8: But truly I am full of power by the Spirit of the LORD, And of justice and might, To declare to Jacob his transgression And to Israel his sin.
33_3_9: Now hear this, You heads of the house of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel, Who abhor justice And pervert all equity
33_3_10: Who build up Zion with bloodshed And Jerusalem with iniquity:
33_3_11: Her heads judge for a bribe, Her priests teach for pay, And her prophets divine for money. Yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Is not the LORD among us? No harm can come upon us.”
33_3_12: Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed like a field, Jerusalem shall become heaps of ruins, And the mountain of the temple Like the bare hills of the forest.
33_4_1: Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the LORD’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And peoples shall flow to it.
33_4_2: Many nations shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go forth, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
33_4_3: He shall judge between many peoples, And rebuke strong nations afar off; They shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war anymore.
33_4_4: But everyone shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree, And no one shall make them afraid; For the mouth of the LORD of hosts has spoken.
33_4_5: For all people walk each in the name of his god, But we will walk in the name of the LORD our God Forever and ever.
33_4_6: “In that day,” says the LORD, “I will assemble the lame, I will gather the outcast And those whom I have afflicted
33_4_7: I will make the lame a remnant, And the outcast a strong nation; So the LORD will reign over them in Mount Zion From now on, even forever.
33_4_8: And you, O tower of the flock, The stronghold of the daughter of Zion, To you shall it come, Even the former dominion shall come, The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.”
33_4_9: Now why do you cry aloud? Is there no king in your midst? Has your counselor perished? For pangs have seized you like a woman in labor.
33_4_10: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, Like a woman in birth pangs. For now you shall go forth from the city, You shall dwell in the field, And to Babylon you shall go. There you shall be delivered; There the LORD will redeem you From the hand of your enemies.
33_4_11: Now also many nations have gathered against you, Who say, “Let her be defiled, And let our eye look upon Zion.”
33_4_12: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD, Nor do they understand His counsel; For He will gather them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
33_4_13: “Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; For I will make your horn iron, And I will make your hooves bronze; You shall beat in pieces many peoples; I will consecrate their gain to the LORD, And their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.”
33_5_1: Now gather yourself in troops, O daughter of troops; He has laid siege against us; They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
33_5_2: “But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, Though you are little among the thousands of Judah, Yet out of you shall come forth to Me The One to be Ruler in Israel, Whose goings forth are from of old, From everlasting.”
33_5_3: Therefore He shall give them up, Until the time that she who is in labor has given birth; Then the remnant of His brethren Shall return to the children of Israel.
33_5_4: And He shall stand and feed His flock In the strength of the LORD, In the majesty of the name of the LORD His God; And they shall abide, For now He shall be great To the ends of the earth
33_5_5: And this One shall be peace. When the Assyrian comes into our land, And when he treads in our palaces, Then we will raise against him Seven shepherds and eight princely men.
33_5_6: They shall waste with the sword the land of Assyria, And the land of Nimrod at its entrances; Thus He shall deliver us from the Assyrian, When he comes into our land And when he treads within our borders.
33_5_7: Then the remnant of Jacob Shall be in the midst of many peoples, Like dew from the LORD, Like showers on the grass, That tarry for no man Nor wait for the sons of men.
33_5_8: And the remnant of Jacob Shall be among the Gentiles, In the midst of many peoples, Like a lion among the beasts of the forest, Like a young lion among flocks of sheep, Who, if he passes through, Both treads down and tears in pieces, And none can deliver.
33_5_9: Your hand shall be lifted against your adversaries, And all your enemies shall be cut off.
33_5_10: “And it shall be in that day,” says the LORD, “That I will cut off your horses from your midst And destroy your chariots.
33_5_11: I will cut off the cities of your land And throw down all your strongholds.
33_5_12: I will cut off sorceries from your hand, And you shall have no soothsayers.
33_5_13: Your carved images I will also cut off, And your sacred pillars from your midst; You shall no more worship the work of your hands
33_5_14: I will pluck your wooden images from your midst; Thus I will destroy your cities.
33_5_15: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury On the nations that have not heard.”
33_6_1: Hear now what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, And let the hills hear your voice.
33_6_2: Hear, O you mountains, the LORD’s complaint, And you strong foundations of the earth; For the LORD has a complaint against His people, And He will contend with Israel.
33_6_3: “O My people, what have I done to you? And how have I wearied you? Testify against Me.
33_6_4: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, I redeemed you from the house of bondage; And I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
33_6_5: O My people, remember now What Balak king of Moab counseled, And what Balaam the son of Beor answered him, From Acacia Grove to Gilgal, That you may know the righteousness of the LORD.”
33_6_6: With what shall I come before the LORD, And bow myself before the High God? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, With calves a year old?
33_6_7: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, Ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
33_6_8: He has shown you, O man, what is good; And what does the LORD require of you But to do justly, To love mercy, And to walk humbly with your God?
33_6_9: The LORD’s voice cries to the city— Wisdom shall see Your name: “Hear the rod! Who has appointed it?
33_6_10: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness In the house of the wicked, And the short measure that is an abomination?
33_6_11: Shall I count pure those with the wicked scales, And with the bag of deceitful weights?
33_6_12: For her rich men are full of violence, Her inhabitants have spoken lies, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
33_6_13: “Therefore I will also make you sick by striking you, By making you desolate because of your sins.
33_6_14: You shall eat, but not be satisfied; Hunger shall be in your midst. You may carry some away, but shall not save them; And what you do rescue I will give over to the sword.
33_6_15: “You shall sow, but not reap; You shall tread the olives, but not anoint yourselves with oil; And make sweet wine, but not drink wine.
33_6_16: For the statutes of Omri are kept; All the works of Ahab’s house are done; And you walk in their counsels, That I may make you a desolation, And your inhabitants a hissing. Therefore you shall bear the reproach of My people.”
33_7_1: Woe is me! For I am like those who gather summer fruits, Like those who glean vintage grapes; There is no cluster to eat Of the first-ripe fruit which my soul desires.
33_7_2: The faithful man has perished from the earth, And there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; Every man hunts his brother with a net.
33_7_3: That they may successfully do evil with both hands— The prince asks for gifts, The judge seeks a bribe, And the great man utters his evil desire; So they scheme together.
33_7_4: The best of them is like a brier; The most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge; The day of your watchman and your punishment comes; Now shall be their perplexity.
33_7_5: Do not trust in a friend; Do not put your confidence in a companion; Guard the doors of your mouth From her who lies in your bosom.
33_7_6: For son dishonors father, Daughter rises against her mother, Daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; A man’s enemies are the men of his own household.
33_7_7: Therefore I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation; My God will hear me.
33_7_8: Do not rejoice over me, my enemy; When I fall, I will arise; When I sit in darkness, The LORD will be a light to me.
33_7_9: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, Because I have sinned against Him, Until He pleads my case And executes justice for me. He will bring me forth to the light; I will see His righteousness.
33_7_10: Then she who is my enemy will see, And shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; Now she will be trampled down Like mud in the streets.
33_7_11: In the day when your walls are to be built, In that day the decree shall go far and wide.
33_7_12: In that day they shall come to you From Assyria and the fortified cities, From the fortress to the River, From sea to sea, And mountain to mountain.
33_7_13: Yet the land shall be desolate Because of those who dwell in it, And for the fruit of their deeds.
33_7_14: Shepherd Your people with Your staff, The flock of Your heritage, Who dwell solitarily in a woodland, In the midst of Carmel; Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, As in days of old.
33_7_15: “As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt, I will show them wonders.”
33_7_16: The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; They shall put their hand over their mouth; Their ears shall be deaf.
33_7_17: They shall lick the dust like a serpent; They shall crawl from their holes like snakes of the earth. They shall be afraid of the LORD our God, And shall fear because of You.
33_7_18: Who is a God like You, Pardoning iniquity And passing over the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He does not retain His anger forever, Because He delights in mercy.
33_7_19: He will again have compassion on us, And will subdue our iniquities. You will cast all our sins Into the depths of the sea.
33_7_20: You will give truth to Jacob And mercy to Abraham, Which You have sworn to our fathers From days of old.
34_1_1: The burden against Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
34_1_2: God is jealous, and the LORD avenges; The LORD avenges and is furious. The LORD will take vengeance on His adversaries, And He reserves wrath for His enemies
34_1_3: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, And will not at all acquit the wicked. The LORD has His way In the whirlwind and in the storm, And the clouds are the dust of His feet.
34_1_4: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, And dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither, And the flower of Lebanon wilts.
34_1_5: The mountains quake before Him, The hills melt, And the earth heaves at His presence, Yes, the world and all who dwell in it.
34_1_6: Who can stand before His indignation? And who can endure the fierceness of His anger? His fury is poured out like fire, And the rocks are thrown down by Him.
34_1_7: The LORD is good, A stronghold in the day of trouble; And He knows those who trust in Him.
34_1_8: But with an overflowing flood He will make an utter end of its place, And darkness will pursue His enemies.
34_1_9: What do you conspire against the LORD? He will make an utter end of it. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
34_1_10: For while tangled like thorns, And while drunken like drunkards, They shall be devoured like stubble fully dried.
34_1_11: From you comes forth one Who plots evil against the LORD, A wicked counselor.
34_1_12: Thus says the LORD: “Though they are safe, and likewise many, Yet in this manner they will be cut down When he passes through. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more
34_1_13: For now I will break off his yoke from you, And burst your bonds apart.”
34_1_14: The LORD has given a command concerning you: “Your name shall be perpetuated no longer. Out of the house of your gods I will cut off the carved image and the molded image. I will dig your grave, For you are vile.”
34_1_15: Behold, on the mountains The feet of him who brings good tidings, Who proclaims peace! O Judah, keep your appointed feasts, Perform your vows. For the wicked one shall no more pass through you; He is utterly cut off.
34_2_1: He who scatters has come up before your face. Man the fort! Watch the road! Strengthen your flanks! Fortify your power mightily.
34_2_2: For the LORD will restore the excellence of Jacob Like the excellence of Israel, For the emptiers have emptied them out And ruined their vine branches.
34_2_3: The shields of his mighty men are made red, The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots come with flaming torches In the day of his preparation, And the spears are brandished.
34_2_4: The chariots rage in the streets, They jostle one another in the broad roads; They seem like torches, They run like lightning.
34_2_5: He remembers his nobles; They stumble in their walk; They make haste to her walls, And the defense is prepared.
34_2_6: The gates of the rivers are opened, And the palace is dissolved.
34_2_7: It is decreed: She shall be led away captive, She shall be brought up; And her maidservants shall lead her as with the voice of doves, Beating their breasts.
34_2_8: Though Nineveh of old was like a pool of water, Now they flee away. “Halt! Halt!” they cry; But no one turns back.
34_2_9: Take spoil of silver! Take spoil of gold! There is no end of treasure, Or wealth of every desirable prize.
34_2_10: She is empty, desolate, and waste! The heart melts, and the knees shake; Much pain is in every side, And all their faces are drained of color.
34_2_11: Where is the dwelling of the lions, And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion walked, the lioness and lion’s cub, And no one made them afraid?
34_2_12: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, Killed for his lionesses, Filled his caves with prey, And his dens with flesh.
34_2_13: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of hosts, “I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions; I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall be heard no more.”
34_3_1: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. Its victim never departs.
34_3_2: The noise of a whip And the noise of rattling wheels, Of galloping horses, Of clattering chariots!
34_3_3: Horsemen charge with bright sword and glittering spear. There is a multitude of slain, A great number of bodies, Countless corpses— They stumble over the corpses—
34_3_4: Because of the multitude of harlotries of the seductive harlot, The mistress of sorceries, Who sells nations through her harlotries, And families through her sorceries.
34_3_5: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of hosts; “I will lift your skirts over your face, I will show the nations your nakedness, And the kingdoms your shame.
34_3_6: I will cast abominable filth upon you, Make you vile, And make you a spectacle.
34_3_7: It shall come to pass that all who look upon you Will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will bemoan her?’ Where shall I seek comforters for you?”
34_3_8: Are you better than No Amon That was situated by the River, That had the waters around her, Whose rampart was the sea, Whose wall was the sea?
34_3_9: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, And it was boundless; Put and Lubim were your helpers.
34_3_10: Yet she was carried away, She went into captivity; Her young children also were dashed to pieces At the head of every street; They cast lots for her honorable men, And all her great men were bound in chains.
34_3_11: You also will be drunk; You will be hidden; You also will seek refuge from the enemy.
34_3_12: All your strongholds are fig trees with ripened figs: If they are shaken, They fall into the mouth of the eater.
34_3_13: Surely, your people in your midst are women! The gates of your land are wide open for your enemies; Fire shall devour the bars of your gates.
34_3_14: Draw your water for the siege! Fortify your strongholds! Go into the clay and tread the mortar! Make strong the brick kiln!
34_3_15: There the fire will devour you, The sword will cut you off; It will eat you up like a locust. Make yourself many—like the locust! Make yourself many— like the swarming locusts!
34_3_16: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of heaven. The locust plunders and flies away.
34_3_17: Your commanders are like swarming locusts, And your generals like great grasshoppers, Which camp in the hedges on a cold day; When the sun rises they flee away, And the place where they are is not known.
34_3_18: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; Your nobles rest in the dust. Your people are scattered on the mountains, And no one gathers them.
34_3_19: Your injury has no healing, Your wound is severe. All who hear news of you Will clap their hands over you, For upon whom has not your wickedness passed continually?
35_1_1: The burden which the prophet Habakkuk saw.
35_1_2: O LORD, how long shall I cry, And You will not hear? Even cry out to You, “Violence!” And You will not save.
35_1_3: Why do You show me iniquity, And cause me to see trouble? For plundering and violence are before me; There is strife, and contention arises.
35_1_4: Therefore the law is powerless, And justice never goes forth. For the wicked surround the righteous; Therefore perverse judgment proceeds.
35_1_5: “Look among the nations and watch— Be utterly astounded! For I will work a work in your days Which you would not believe, though it were told you.
35_1_6: For indeed I am raising up the Chaldeans, A bitter and hasty nation Which marches through the breadth of the earth, To possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
35_1_7: They are terrible and dreadful; Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
35_1_8: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, And more fierce than evening wolves. Their chargers charge ahead; Their cavalry comes from afar; They fly as the eagle that hastens to eat.
35_1_9: “They all come for violence; Their faces are set like the east wind. They gather captives like sand.
35_1_10: They scoff at kings, And princes are scorned by them. They deride every stronghold, For they heap up earthen mounds and seize it.
35_1_11: Then his mind changes, and he transgresses; He commits offense, Ascribing this power to his god.”
35_1_12: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O LORD, You have appointed them for judgment; O Rock, You have marked them for correction.
35_1_13: You are of purer eyes than to behold evil, And cannot look on wickedness. Why do You look on those who deal treacherously, And hold Your tongue when the wicked devours A person more righteous than he?
35_1_14: Why do You make men like fish of the sea, Like creeping things that have no ruler over them?
35_1_15: They take up all of them with a hook, They catch them in their net, And gather them in their dragnet. Therefore they rejoice and are glad.
35_1_16: Therefore they sacrifice to their net, And burn incense to their dragnet; Because by them their share is sumptuous And their food plentiful.
35_1_17: Shall they therefore empty their net, And continue to slay nations without pity?
35_2_1: I will stand my watch And set myself on the rampart, And watch to see what He will say to me, And what I will answer when I am corrected.
35_2_2: Then the LORD answered me and said: “Write the vision And make it plain on tablets, That he may run who reads it.
35_2_3: For the vision is yet for an appointed time; But at the end it will speak, and it will not lie. Though it tarries, wait for it; Because it will surely come, It will not tarry.
35_2_4: “Behold the proud, His soul is not upright in him; But the just shall live by his faith.
35_2_5: “Indeed, because he transgresses by wine, He is a proud man, And he does not stay at home. Because he enlarges his desire as hell, And he is like death, and cannot be satisfied, He gathers to himself all nations And heaps up for himself all peoples.
35_2_6: “Will not all these take up a proverb against him, And a taunting riddle against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases What is not his—how long? And to him who loads himself with many pledges’?
35_2_7: Will not your creditors rise up suddenly? Will they not awaken who oppress you? And you will become their booty.
35_2_8: Because you have plundered many nations, All the remnant of the people shall plunder you, Because of men’s blood And the violence of the land and the city, And of all who dwell in it.
35_2_9: “Woe to him who covets evil gain for his house, That he may set his nest on high, That he may be delivered from the power of disaster!
35_2_10: You give shameful counsel to your house, Cutting off many peoples, And sin against your soul.
35_2_11: For the stone will cry out from the wall, And the beam from the timbers will answer it.
35_2_12: “Woe to him who builds a town with bloodshed, Who establishes a city by iniquity!
35_2_13: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts That the peoples labor to feed the fire, And nations weary themselves in vain?
35_2_14: For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea.
35_2_15: “Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbor, Pressing him to your bottle, Even to make him drunk, That you may look on his nakedness!
35_2_16: You are filled with shame instead of glory. You also—drink! And be exposed as uncircumcised! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will be turned against you, And utter shame will be on your glory.
35_2_17: For the violence done to Lebanon will cover you, And the plunder of beasts which made them afraid, Because of men’s blood And the violence of the land and the city, And of all who dwell in it.
35_2_18: “What profit is the image, that its maker should carve it, The molded image, a teacher of lies, That the maker of its mold should trust in it, To make mute idols?
35_2_19: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ To silent stone, ‘Arise! It shall teach!’ Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, Yet in it there is no breath at all.
35_2_20: “But the LORD is in His holy temple. Let all the earth keep silence before Him.”
35_3_1: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, on Shigionoth.
35_3_2: O LORD, I have heard Your speech and was afraid; O LORD, revive Your work in the midst of the years! In the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember mercy.
35_3_3: God came from Teman, The Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, And the earth was full of His praise.
35_3_4: His brightness was like the light; He had rays flashing from His hand, And there His power was hidden.
35_3_5: Before Him went pestilence, And fever followed at His feet.
35_3_6: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations. And the everlasting mountains were scattered, The perpetual hills bowed. His ways are everlasting.
35_3_7: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian trembled.
35_3_8: O LORD, were You displeased with the rivers, Was Your anger against the rivers, Was Your wrath against the sea, That You rode on Your horses, Your chariots of salvation?
35_3_9: Your bow was made quite ready; Oaths were sworn over Your arrows. Selah You divided the earth with rivers.
35_3_10: The mountains saw You and trembled; The overflowing of the water passed by. The deep uttered its voice, And lifted its hands on high.
35_3_11: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation; At the light of Your arrows they went, At the shining of Your glittering spear.
35_3_12: You marched through the land in indignation; You trampled the nations in anger.
35_3_13: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, For salvation with Your Anointed. You struck the head from the house of the wicked, By laying bare from foundation to neck. Selah
35_3_14: You thrust through with his own arrows The head of his villages. They came out like a whirlwind to scatter me; Their rejoicing was like feasting on the poor in secret.
35_3_15: You walked through the sea with Your horses, Through the heap of great waters.
35_3_16: When I heard, my body trembled; My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entered my bones; And I trembled in myself, That I might rest in the day of trouble. When he comes up to the people, He will invade them with his troops.
35_3_17: Though the fig tree may not blossom, Nor fruit be on the vines; Though the labor of the olive may fail, And the fields yield no food; Though the flock may be cut off from the fold, And there be no herd in the stalls—
35_3_18: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
35_3_19: The LORD God is my strength; He will make my feet like deer’s feet, And He will make me walk on my high hills. To the Chief Musician. With my stringed instruments.
36_1_1: The word of the LORD which came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
36_1_2: “I will utterly consume everything From the face of the land,” Says the LORD
36_1_3: “I will consume man and beast; I will consume the birds of the heavens, The fish of the sea, And the stumbling blocks along with the wicked. I will cut off man from the face of the land,” Says the LORD.
36_1_4: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah, And against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off every trace of Baal from this place, The names of the idolatrous priests with the pagan priests—
36_1_5: Those who worship the host of heaven on the housetops; Those who worship and swear oaths by the LORD, But who also swear by Milcom
36_1_6: Those who have turned back from following the LORD, And have not sought the LORD, nor inquired of Him.”
36_1_7: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD; For the day of the LORD is at hand, For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has invited His guests.
36_1_8: “And it shall be, In the day of the LORD’s sacrifice, That I will punish the princes and the king’s children, And all such as are clothed with foreign apparel.
36_1_9: In the same day I will punish All those who leap over the threshold, Who fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
36_1_10: “And there shall be on that day,” says the LORD, “The sound of a mournful cry from the Fish Gate, A wailing from the Second Quarter, And a loud crashing from the hills.
36_1_11: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh! For all the merchant people are cut down; All those who handle money are cut off.
36_1_12: “And it shall come to pass at that time That I will search Jerusalem with lamps, And punish the men Who are settled in complacency, Who say in their heart, ‘The LORD will not do good, Nor will He do evil.’
36_1_13: Therefore their goods shall become booty, And their houses a desolation; They shall build houses, but not inhabit them; They shall plant vineyards, but not drink their wine.”
36_1_14: The great day of the LORD is near; It is near and hastens quickly. The noise of the day of the LORD is bitter; There the mighty men shall cry out.
36_1_15: That day is a day of wrath, A day of trouble and distress, A day of devastation and desolation, A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness
36_1_16: A day of trumpet and alarm Against the fortified cities And against the high towers.
36_1_17: “I will bring distress upon men, And they shall walk like blind men, Because they have sinned against the LORD; Their blood shall be poured out like dust, And their flesh like refuse.”
36_1_18: Neither their silver nor their gold Shall be able to deliver them In the day of the LORD’s wrath; But the whole land shall be devoured By the fire of His jealousy, For He will make speedy riddance Of all those who dwell in the land.
36_2_1: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, O undesirable nation
36_2_2: Before the decree is issued, Or the day passes like chaff, Before the LORD’s fierce anger comes upon you, Before the day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you!
36_2_3: Seek the LORD, all you meek of the earth, Who have upheld His justice. Seek righteousness, seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden In the day of the LORD’s anger.
36_2_4: For Gaza shall be forsaken, And Ashkelon desolate; They shall drive out Ashdod at noonday, And Ekron shall be uprooted.
36_2_5: Woe to the inhabitants of the seacoast, The nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you; So there shall be no inhabitant.”
36_2_6: The seacoast shall be pastures, With shelters for shepherds and folds for flocks.
36_2_7: The coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; They shall feed their flocks there; In the houses of Ashkelon they shall lie down at evening. For the LORD their God will intervene for them, And return their captives.
36_2_8: “I have heard the reproach of Moab, And the insults of the people of Ammon, With which they have reproached My people, And made arrogant threats against their borders.
36_2_9: Therefore, as I live,” Says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, “Surely Moab shall be like Sodom, And the people of Ammon like Gomorrah— Overrun with weeds and saltpits, And a perpetual desolation. The residue of My people shall plunder them, And the remnant of My people shall possess them.”
36_2_10: This they shall have for their pride, Because they have reproached and made arrogant threats Against the people of the LORD of hosts.
36_2_11: The LORD will be awesome to them, For He will reduce to nothing all the gods of the earth; People shall worship Him, Each one from his place, Indeed all the shores of the nations.
36_2_12: “You Ethiopians also, You shall be slain by My sword.”
36_2_13: And He will stretch out His hand against the north, Destroy Assyria, And make Nineveh a desolation, As dry as the wilderness.
36_2_14: The herds shall lie down in her midst, Every beast of the nation. Both the pelican and the bittern Shall lodge on the capitals of her pillars; Their voice shall sing in the windows; Desolation shall be at the threshold; For He will lay bare the cedar work.
36_2_15: This is the rejoicing city That dwelt securely, That said in her heart, “I am it, and there is none besides me.” How has she become a desolation, A place for beasts to lie down! Everyone who passes by her Shall hiss and shake his fist.
36_3_1: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, To the oppressing city!
36_3_2: She has not obeyed His voice, She has not received correction; She has not trusted in the LORD, She has not drawn near to her God.
36_3_3: Her princes in her midst are roaring lions; Her judges are evening wolves That leave not a bone till morning.
36_3_4: Her prophets are insolent, treacherous people; Her priests have polluted the sanctuary, They have done violence to the law.
36_3_5: The LORD is righteous in her midst, He will do no unrighteousness. Every morning He brings His justice to light; He never fails, But the unjust knows no shame.
36_3_6: “I have cut off nations, Their fortresses are devastated; I have made their streets desolate, With none passing by. Their cities are destroyed; There is no one, no inhabitant.
36_3_7: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me, You will receive instruction’— So that her dwelling would not be cut off, Despite everything for which I punished her. But they rose early and corrupted all their deeds.
36_3_8: “Therefore wait for Me,” says the LORD, “Until the day I rise up for plunder; My determination is to gather the nations To My assembly of kingdoms, To pour on them My indignation, All My fierce anger; All the earth shall be devoured With the fire of My jealousy.
36_3_9: “For then I will restore to the peoples a pure language, That they all may call on the name of the LORD, To serve Him with one accord.
36_3_10: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My worshipers, The daughter of My dispersed ones, Shall bring My offering.
36_3_11: In that day you shall not be shamed for any of your deeds In which you transgress against Me; For then I will take away from your midst Those who rejoice in your pride, And you shall no longer be haughty In My holy mountain.
36_3_12: I will leave in your midst A meek and humble people, And they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
36_3_13: The remnant of Israel shall do no unrighteousness And speak no lies, Nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; For they shall feed their flocks and lie down, And no one shall make them afraid.”
36_3_14: Sing, O daughter of Zion! Shout, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!
36_3_15: The LORD has taken away your judgments, He has cast out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is in your midst; You shall see disaster no more.
36_3_16: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem: “Do not fear; Zion, let not your hands be weak.
36_3_17: The LORD your God in your midst, The Mighty One, will save; He will rejoice over you with gladness, He will quiet you with His love, He will rejoice over you with singing.”
36_3_18: “I will gather those who sorrow over the appointed assembly, Who are among you, To whom its reproach is a burden.
36_3_19: Behold, at that time I will deal with all who afflict you; I will save the lame, And gather those who were driven out; I will appoint them for praise and fame In every land where they were put to shame.
36_3_20: At that time I will bring you back, Even at the time I gather you; For I will give you fame and praise Among all the peoples of the earth, When I return your captives before your eyes,” Says the LORD.
37_1_1: In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying
37_1_2: “Thus speaks the LORD of hosts, saying: ‘This people says, “The time has not come, the time that the LORD’s house should be built.” ’ ”
37_1_3: Then the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet, saying
37_1_4: “ Is it time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, and this temple to lie in ruins?”
37_1_5: Now therefore, thus says the LORD of hosts: “Consider your ways!
